Into every troubled breast;
Let us all in Thee inherit,
Let us find that second rest.
Take away our bent to sinning,
Alpha and Omega be;
End of faith, as its beginning,
Set our hearts at liberty.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Come, Almighty to deliver,
Let us all Thy life receive;
Suddenly return, and never,
Nevermore Thy temples leave.
Thee we would be always blessing,
Serve Thee as Thy hosts above,
Pray, and praise Thee without ceasing,
Glory in Thy perfect love.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Finish, then, Thy new creation;
Pure and spotless let us be.
Let us see Thy great salvation
Perfectly restored in Thee;
Changed from glory into glory,
Till in heav'n we take our place,
Till we cast our crowns before Thee,
Lost in wonder, love, and praise.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O soul, are you weary and troubled?
No light in the darkness you see?
There's light for a look at the Savior,
And life more abundant and free!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Through death into life everlasting
He passed, and we follow Him there;
O'er us sin no more hath dominion—
For more than conqu'rors we are!

verses.label: Verse 3

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Turn your eyes upon Jesus,
Look full in His wonderful face,
And the things of earth will grow strangely dim
In the light of His glory and grace.

songs.title: O for a Thousand Tongues to Sing
songs.author: Charles Wesley, 1739

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O for a thousand tongues to sing
My great Redeemer's praise,
The glories of my God and King,
The triumphs of His grace!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
My gracious Master and my God,
Assist me to proclaim,
To spread through all the earth abroad
The honors of Thy name.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Jesus! the name that charms our fears,
That bids our sorrows cease;
'Tis music in the sinner's ears,
'Tis life and health and peace.

verses.label: Verse 4
Verse 5
Verse 1
verses.text:
Come, Thou Almighty King,
Help us Thy name to sing,
Help us to praise!
Father, all glorious,
O'er all victorious,
Come and reign over us,
Ancient of Days!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Come, Thou Incarnate Word,
Gird on Thy mighty sword,
Our pray'r attend!
Come and Thy people bless,
And give Thy Word success;
Spirit of holiness,
On us descend!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Come, Holy Comforter,
Thy sacred witness bear
In this glad hour!
Thou who almighty art,
Now rule in every heart,
And ne'er from us depart,
Spirit of pow'r!

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
To Thee, great One in Three,
The highest praises be,
Hence evermore!
Thy sov'reign majesty
May we in glory see,
And to eternity
Love and adore!

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4

songs.title: Christ the Lord Is Risen Today
songs.author: Charles Wesley, 1739

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Christ the Lord is ris'n today, Alleluia!
Sons of men and angels say, Alleluia!
Raise your joys and triumphs high, Alleluia!
Sing, ye heav'ns, and earth reply, Alleluia!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Love's redeeming work is done, Alleluia!
Fought the fight, the battle won, Alleluia!
Death in vain forbids Him rise, Alleluia!
Christ hath opened paradise, Alleluia!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Lives again our glorious King, Alleluia!
Where, O death, is now thy sting? Alleluia!
Dying once, He all doth save, Alleluia!
Where thy victory, O grave? Alleluia!

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Soar we now where Christ hath led, Alleluia!
Foll'wing our exalted Head, Alleluia!
Made like Him, like Him we rise, Alleluia!
Ours the cross, the grave, the skies, Alleluia!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Glory to God in the highest,
Glory to God in the highest,
Glory to God, glory to God,
Glory to God in the highest!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Peace upon earth and good will to men,
Peace upon earth and good will to men,
Peace upon earth, peace upon earth,
Peace upon earth and good will to men!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
For all the saints who from their labors rest,
Who Thee by faith before the world confessed,
Thy name, O Jesus, be forever blest:
Alleluia! Alleluia!

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
O may Thy soldiers, faithful, true, and bold,
Fight as the saints who nobly fought of old,
And win with them the victor's crown of gold:
Alleluia! Alleluia!

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
From earth's wide bounds, from ocean's farthest coast,
Through gates of pearl streams in the countless host,
Singing to Father, Son, and Holy Ghost:
Alleluia! Alleluia!

songs.title: Praise the Lord Who Reigns Above
songs.author: Charles Wesley, 1743

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
God—in whom they move and live—
Let every creature sing,
Glory to their Maker give
And homage to their King;
Hallowed be Thy name beneath,
As in heav'n on earth adored;
Praise the Lord in every breath,
Let all things praise the Lord.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
My hope is built on nothing less
Than Jesus' blood and righteousness;
I dare not trust the sweetest frame,
But wholly lean on Jesus' name.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
When darkness veils His lovely face,
I rest on His unchanging grace;
In every high and stormy gale
My anchor holds within the veil.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
His oath, His covenant, His blood
Support me in the whelming flood;
When all around my soul gives way,
He then is all my hope and stay.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
When He shall come with trumpet sound,
O may I then in Him be found;
Dressed in His righteousness alone,
Faultless to stand before the throne.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
On Christ the solid Rock I stand,
All other ground is sinking sand,
All other ground is sinking sand.

verses.label: Doxology
Verse 1
verses.text:
Holy is the Lord, holy is the Lord,
Holy is the Lord God Almighty!
Holy is the Lord, holy is the Lord,
Holy is the Lord God Almighty!
Who was, and is, and is to come,
Holy is the Lord God Almighty!

songs.title: I Stand Amazed in the Presence
songs.author: Charles H. Gabriel, 1905

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I stand amazed in the presence
Of Jesus the Nazarene,
And wonder how He could love me,
A sinner, condemned, unclean.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
For me it was in the garden
He prayed: "Not My will, but Thine;"
He had no tears for His own griefs,
But sweat-drops of blood for mine.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
He took my sins and my sorrows,
He made them His very own;
He bore the burden to Calvary
And suffered and died alone.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
When with the ransomed in glory
His face I at last shall see,
'Twill be my joy through the ages
To sing of His love for me.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
How marvelous! How wonderful!
And my song shall ever be:
How marvelous! How wonderful!
Is my Savior's love for me!

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
I'll love Thee in life, I will love Thee in death,
And praise Thee as long as Thou lendest me breath;
And say when the death-dew lies cold on my brow:
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
In mansions of glory and endless delight,
I'll ever adore Thee in heaven so bright;
I'll sing with the glittering crown on my brow:
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.

songs.title: Savior, Like a Shepherd Lead Us
songs.author: Dorothy A. Thrupp, 1836

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Savior, like a shepherd lead us,
Much we need Thy tender care;
In Thy pleasant pastures feed us,
For our use Thy folds prepare:
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
Thou hast bought us, Thine we are;
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
Thou hast bought us, Thine we are.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
We are Thine, do Thou befriend us,
Be the guardian of our way;
Keep Thy flock, from sin defend us,
Seek us when we go astray:
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
Hear, O hear us when we pray;
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
Hear, O hear us when we pray.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Thou hast promised to receive us,
Poor and sinful though we be;
Thou hast mercy to relieve us,
Grace to cleanse, and pow'r to free:
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
Early let us turn to Thee;
Blessed Jesus, blessed Jesus,
Early let us turn to Thee.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
It may be at morn, when the day is awaking,
When sunlight through darkness and shadow is breaking,
That Jesus will come in the fullness of glory,
To receive from the world His own.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
It may be at midday, it may be at twilight,
It may be, perchance, that the blackness of midnight
Will burst into light in the blaze of His glory,
When Jesus receives His own.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O joy! O delight! should we go without dying,
No sickness, no sadness, no dread and no crying,
Caught up through the clouds with our Lord into glory,
When Jesus receives His own.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
O Lord Jesus, how long, how long
Ere we shout the glad song—
Christ returneth! Hallelujah!
Hallelujah! Amen, hallelujah! Amen.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Were you there when they crucified my Lord?
Were you there when they crucified my Lord?
Oh! Sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when they crucified my Lord?

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Were you there when they nailed Him to the tree?
Were you there when they nailed Him to the tree?
Oh! Sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when they nailed Him to the tree?

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Were you there when they laid Him in the tomb?
Were you there when they laid Him in the tomb?
Oh! Sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when they laid Him in the tomb?

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Were you there when He rose up from the dead?
Were you there when He rose up from the dead?
Oh! Sometimes I feel like shouting glory, glory, glory.
Were you there when He rose up from the dead?

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
Verse 1
verses.text:
I hear the Savior say,
"Thy strength indeed is small;
Child of weakness, watch and pray,
Find in Me thine all in all."

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Lord, now indeed I find
Thy pow'r and Thine alone
Can change the leper's spots
And melt the heart of stone.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
For nothing good have I
Whereby Thy grace to claim;
I'll wash my garments white
In the blood of Calv'ry's Lamb.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
And when, before the throne,
I stand in Him complete,
"Jesus died my soul to save,"
My lips shall still repeat.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Jesus paid it all,
All to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain,
He washed it white as snow.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Beneath the cross of Jesus
I fain would take my stand,
The shadow of a mighty rock
Within a weary land;
A home within the wilderness,
A rest upon the way,
From the burning of the noontide heat
And the burden of the day.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Upon that cross of Jesus
Mine eye at times can see
The very dying form of One
Who suffered there for me;
And from my stricken heart with tears
Two wonders I confess:
The wonders of redeeming love
And my unworthiness.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I take, O cross, thy shadow
For my abiding place;
I ask no other sunshine than
The sunshine of His face;
Content to let the world go by,
To know no gain nor loss,
My sinful self my only shame,
My glory all the cross.

songs.title: Come, Every Soul by Sin Oppressed
songs.author: John H. Stockton, 1874

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Come, every soul by sin oppressed,
There's mercy with the Lord,
And He will surely give you rest
By trusting in His Word.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
For Jesus shed His precious blood
Rich blessings to bestow;
Plunge now into the crimson flood
That washes white as snow.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Yes, Jesus is the Truth, the Way,
That leads you into rest;
Believe in Him without delay
And you are fully blest.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Only trust Him, only trust Him,
Only trust Him now;
He will save you, He will save you,
He will save you now.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Jesus is tenderly calling thee home,
Calling today, calling today;
Why from the sunshine of love wilt thou roam,
Farther and farther away?

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Calling today, calling today,
Jesus is calling, is tenderly calling today.

songs.title: Have You Any Room for Jesus
songs.author: C.C. Williams, 1878

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Have you any room for Jesus,
He who bore your load of sin?
As He knocks and asks admission,
Sinner, will you let Him in?

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Room for pleasure, room for business,
But for Christ the Crucified,
Not a place that He can enter,
In the heart for which He died?

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Have you any room for Jesus,
As in grace He calls again?
O today is time accepted,
Tomorrow you may call in vain.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Room for Jesus, King of glory!
Hasten now His Word obey;
Swing the heart's door widely open,
Bid Him enter while you may.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Why do you wait, dear brother,
O why do you tarry so long?
Your Savior is waiting to give you
A place in His sanctified throng.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
What do you hope, dear brother,
To gain by a further delay?
There's no one to save you but Jesus,
There's no other way but His way.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Do you not feel, dear brother,
His Spirit now striving within?
O why not accept His salvation
And throw off the burden of sin?

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Why not? Why not?
Why not come to Him now?

songs.title: Open My Eyes That I May See
songs.author: Clara H. Scott, 1895

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Open my eyes that I may see
Glimpses of truth Thou hast for me;
Place in my hands the wonderful key
That shall unclasp and set me free.
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready, my God, Thy will to see;
Open my eyes, illumine me,
Spirit divine!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Open my ears that I may hear
Voices of truth Thou sendest clear;
And while the wave-notes fall on my ear,
Everything false will disappear.
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready, my God, Thy will to see;
Open my ears, illumine me,
Spirit divine!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Open my mouth and let me bear
Gladly the warm truth everywhere;
Open my heart and let me prepare
Love with Thy children thus to share.
Silently now I wait for Thee,
Ready, my God, Thy will to see;
Open my heart, illumine me,
Spirit divine!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Lord, speak to me that I may speak
In living echoes of Thy tone;
As Thou hast sought, so let me seek
Thy erring children, lost and lone.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
O strengthen me that while I stand
Firm on the Rock and strong in Thee,
I may stretch out a loving hand
To wrestlers with the troubled sea.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O teach me, Lord, that I may teach
The precious things Thou dost impart;
And wing my words that they may reach
The hidden depths of many a heart.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
O fill me with Thy fullness, Lord,
Until my very heart o'erflow
In kindling thought and glowing word,
Thy love to tell, Thy praise to show.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Purer in heart, O God,
Help me to be;
May I devote my life
Wholly to Thee.
Watch Thou my wayward feet,
Guide me with counsel sweet;
Purer in heart,
Help me to be.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Purer in heart, O God,
Help me to be;
Teach me to do Thy will
Most lovingly.
Be Thou my friend and guide,
Let me with Thee abide;
Purer in heart,
Help me to be.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Purer in heart, O God,
Help me to be;
Until Thy holy face
One day I see.
Keep me from secret sin,
Reign Thou my soul within;
Purer in heart,
Help me to be.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I am Thine, O Lord, I have heard Thy voice,
And it told Thy love to me;
But I long to rise in the arms of faith
And be closer drawn to Thee.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Consecrate me now to Thy service, Lord,
By the pow'r of grace divine;
Let my soul look up with a steadfast hope,
And my will be lost in Thine.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O the pure delight of a single hour
That before Thy throne I spend,
When I kneel in prayer, and with Thee, my God,
I commune as friend with friend!

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
There are depths of love that I cannot know
Till I cross the narrow sea;
There are heights of joy that I may not reach
Till I rest in peace with Thee.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Draw me nearer, nearer, blessed Lord,
To the cross where Thou hast died;
Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer, blessed Lord,
To Thy precious, bleeding side.

songs.title: Safe in the Arms of Jesus
songs.author: Fanny J. Crosby, 1868

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe on His gentle breast,
There by His love o'ershaded,
Sweetly my soul shall rest.
Hark! 'tis the voice of angels,
Borne in a song to me,
Over the fields of glory,
Over the jasper sea.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe from corroding care,
Safe from the world's temptations,
Sin cannot harm me there.
Free from the blight of sorrow,
Free from my doubts and fears;
Only a few more trials,
Only a few more tears.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Jesus, my heart's dear refuge,
Jesus has died for me;
Firm on the Rock of ages
Ever my trust shall be.
Here let me wait with patience,
Wait till the night is o'er;
Wait till I see the morning
Break on the golden shore.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Safe in the arms of Jesus,
Safe on His gentle breast,
There by His love o'ershaded,
Sweetly my soul shall rest.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Soft as the voice of an angel,
Breathing a lesson unheard,
Hope with a gentle persuasion
Whispers her comforting word:
Wait till the darkness is over,
Wait till the tempest is done,
Hope for the sunshine tomorrow,
After the shower is gone.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
If, in the dusk of the twilight,
Dim be the region afar,
Will not the deepening darkness
Brighten the glimmering star?
Then when the night is upon us,
Why should the heart sink away?
When the dark midnight is over,
Watch for the breaking of day.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Whispering hope, O how welcome thy voice,
Making my heart in its sorrow rejoice.

songs.title: My Faith Has Found a Resting Place
songs.author: Lidie H. Edmunds, c.1891

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
My faith has found a resting place,
Not in device or creed;
I trust the ever living One,
His wounds for me shall plead.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Enough for me that Jesus saves,
This ends my fear and doubt;
A sinful soul I come to Him,
He'll never cast me out.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
My heart is leaning on the Word,
The written Word of God;
Salvation by my Savior's name,
Salvation through His blood.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
My great Physician heals the sick,
The lost He came to save;
For me His precious blood He shed,
For me His life He gave.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I need no other argument,
I need no other plea;
It is enough that Jesus died,
And that He died for me.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
There's not a friend like the lowly Jesus,
No, not one! No, not one!
None else could heal all our soul's diseases,
No, not one! No, not one!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
No friend like Him is so high and holy,
No, not one! No, not one!
And yet no friend is so meek and lowly,
No, not one! No, not one!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
There's not an hour that He is not near us,
No, not one! No, not one!
No night so dark but His love can cheer us,
No, not one! No, not one!

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Did ever saint find this Friend forsake him?
No, not one! No, not one!
Or sinner find that He would not take him?
No, not one! No, not one!

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Jesus knows all about our struggles,
He will guide till the day is done;
There's not a friend like the lowly Jesus,
No, not one! No, not one!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Like a river glorious is God's perfect peace,
Over all victorious in its bright increase;
Perfect, yet it floweth fuller every day,
Perfect, yet it groweth deeper all the way.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Hidden in the hollow of His blessed hand,
Never foe can follow, never traitor stand;
Not a surge of worry, not a shade of care,
Not a blast of hurry touch the spirit there.

verses.label: Verse 3

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Stayed upon Jehovah, hearts are fully blest;
Finding, as He promised, perfect peace and rest.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Jesus, Lover of my soul,
Let me to Thy bosom fly,
While the nearer waters roll,
While the tempest still is high;
Hide me, O my Savior, hide,
Till the storm of life is past;
Safe into the haven guide,
O receive my soul at last!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Other refuge have I none,
Hangs my helpless soul on Thee;
Leave, ah, leave me not alone,
Still support and comfort me.
All my trust on Thee is stayed,
All my help from Thee I bring;
Cover my defenseless head
With the shadow of Thy wing.

verses.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
verses.text:
Plenteous grace with Thee is found,
Grace to cover all my sin;
Let the healing streams abound,
Make and keep me pure within.
Thou of life the fountain art,
Freely let me take of Thee;
Spring Thou up within my heart,
Rise to all eternity.

songs.title: I Know Whom I Have Believed
songs.author: Daniel W. Whittle, 1883

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I know not why God's wondrous grace
To me He hath made known,
Nor why, unworthy, Christ in love
Redeemed me for His own.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I know not how this saving faith
To me He did impart,
Nor how believing in His Word
Wrought peace within my heart.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I know not how the Spirit moves,
Convincing men of sin,
Revealing Jesus through the Word,
Creating faith in Him.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
I know not what of good or ill
May be reserved for me,
Of weary ways or golden days
Before His face I see.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
But "I know whom I have believed,
And am persuaded that He is able
To keep that which I've committed
Unto Him against that day."

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
My soul in sad exile was out on life's sea,
So burdened with sin and distressed,
Till I heard a sweet voice saying, "Make Me your choice,"
And I entered the Haven of Rest.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I yielded myself to His tender embrace,
And faith taking hold of the Word,
My fetters fell off and I anchored my soul;
The Haven of Rest is my Lord.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
The song of my soul, since the Lord made me whole,
Has been the old story so blest,
Of Jesus who'll save whosoever will have
A home in the Haven of Rest.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I've anchored my soul in the Haven of Rest,
I'll sail the wide seas no more;
The tempest may sweep o'er the wild, stormy deep,
In Jesus I'm safe evermore.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
Never a trial that He is not there,
Never a burden that He doth not bear,
Never a sorrow that He doth not share—
Moment by moment, I'm under His care.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Never a heartache, and never a groan,
Never a teardrop and never a moan;
Never a danger but there on the throne—
Moment by moment He thinks of His own.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Never a weakness that He doth not feel,
Never a sickness that He cannot heal;
Moment by moment, in woe or in weal,
Jesus my Savior abides with me still.

chorus.label: Chorus

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
What Child is this who, laid to rest,
On Mary's lap is sleeping?
Whom angels greet with anthems sweet
While shepherds watch are keeping?

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Why lies He in such mean estate
Where ox and ass are feeding?
Good Christians, fear, for sinners here
The silent Word is pleading.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
So bring Him incense, gold, and myrrh,
Come peasant, king to own Him;
The King of kings salvation brings,
Let loving hearts enthrone Him.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
This, this is Christ the King,
Whom shepherds guard and angels sing;
Haste, haste to bring Him laud,
The Babe, the Son of Mary.

songs.title: O Come, O Come, Emmanuel
songs.author: Latin, 9th c.; tr. John Mason Neale, 1851

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O come, O come, Emmanuel,
And ransom captive Israel
That mourns in lonely exile here
Until the Son of God appear.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
O come, Thou Dayspring, come and cheer
Our spirits by Thine advent here;
Disperse the gloomy clouds of night
And death's dark shadows put to flight.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O come, Thou Key of David, come,
And open wide our heav'nly home;
Make safe the way that leads on high,
And close the path to misery.

verses.label: Verse 4

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Rejoice! Rejoice! Emmanuel
Shall come to thee, O Israel.

songs.title: Good Christian Men, Rejoice
songs.author: Latin, 14th c.; tr. John Mason Neale, 1853

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Good Christian men, rejoice
With heart and soul and voice;
Give ye heed to what we say:
Jesus Christ is born today!
Ox and ass before Him bow,
And He is in the manger now.
Christ is born today!
Christ is born today!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Good Christian men, rejoice
With heart and soul and voice;
Now ye hear of endless bliss:
Jesus Christ was born for this!
He hath oped the heav'nly door,
And man is blessed evermore.
Christ was born for this!
Christ was born for this!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Good Christian men, rejoice
With heart and soul and voice;
Now ye need not fear the grave:
Jesus Christ was born to save!
Calls you one and calls you all
To gain His everlasting hall.
Christ was born to save!
Christ was born to save!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
We three kings of Orient are,
Bearing gifts we traverse afar
Field and fountain, moor and mountain,
Following yonder star.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Born a King on Bethlehem's plain,
Gold I bring to crown Him again,
King forever, ceasing never
Over us all to reign.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Frankincense to offer have I,
Incense owns a Deity nigh;
Prayer and praising all men raising,
Worship Him, God most high.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Myrrh is mine; its bitter perfume
Breathes a life of gathering gloom;
Sorrowing, sighing, bleeding, dying,
Sealed in the stone-cold tomb.

verses.label: Verse 5
verses.text:
Glorious now behold Him arise,
King and God and sacrifice;
Alleluia, alleluia,
Earth to heav'n replies.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
O star of wonder, star of night,
Star with royal beauty bright,
Westward leading, still proceeding,
Guide us to thy perfect light.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Living for Jesus a life that is true,
Striving to please Him in all that I do;
Yielding allegiance, glad-hearted and free,
This is the pathway of blessing for me.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Living for Jesus who died in my place,
Bearing on Calvary my sin and disgrace;
Such love constrains me to answer His call,
Follow His leading and give Him my all.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Living for Jesus through earth's little while,
My dearest treasure the light of His smile;
Seeking the lost ones He died to redeem,
Bringing the weary to find rest in Him.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
O Jesus, Lord and Savior,
I give myself to Thee;
For Thou, in Thy atonement,
Didst give Thyself for me.
I own no other Master,
My heart shall be Thy throne;
My life I give, henceforth to live,
O Christ, for Thee alone.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Take up thy cross, the Savior said,
If thou wouldst My disciple be;
Deny thyself, the world forsake,
And humbly follow after Me.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Take up thy cross, let not its weight
Fill thy weak spirit with alarm;
His strength shall bear thy spirit up,
And brace thy heart and nerve thine arm.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Take up thy cross, nor heed the shame,
And let thy foolish pride be still;
Thy Lord refused not e'en to die
Upon a cross on Calv'ry's hill.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Take up thy cross and follow Christ,
Nor think till death to lay it down;
For only he who bears the cross
May hope to wear the glorious crown.

songs.title: Lord, I Want to Be a Christian
songs.author: African American Spiritual
songs.tune: I WANT TO BE A CHRISTIAN

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Lord, I want to be a Christian in my heart, in my heart;
Lord, I want to be a Christian in my heart.
In my heart, in my heart,
Lord, I want to be a Christian in my heart.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Lord, I want to be more loving in my heart, in my heart;
Lord, I want to be more loving in my heart.
In my heart, in my heart,
Lord, I want to be more loving in my heart.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Lord, I want to be more holy in my heart, in my heart;
Lord, I want to be more holy in my heart.
In my heart, in my heart,
Lord, I want to be more holy in my heart.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Lord, I want to be like Jesus in my heart, in my heart;
Lord, I want to be like Jesus in my heart.
In my heart, in my heart,
Lord, I want to be like Jesus in my heart.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Sweetly, Lord, have we heard Thee calling,
Come, follow Me!
And we see where Thy footprints falling
Lead us to Thee.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Though they lead o'er the cold, dark mountains,
Seeking His sheep;
Or along by Siloam's fountains,
Helping the weak.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
If they lead through the temple holy,
Preaching the Word;
Or in homes of the poor and lowly,
Serving the Lord.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Then at last, when on high He sees us,
Our journey done,
We will rest where the steps of Jesus
End at His throne.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Footprints of Jesus that make the pathway glow;
We will follow the steps of Jesus where'er they go.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
In the morning when I rise,
In the morning when I rise,
In the morning when I rise,
Give me Jesus.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Dark midnight was my cry,
Dark midnight was my cry,
Dark midnight was my cry,
Give me Jesus.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Just about the break of day,
Just about the break of day,
Just about the break of day,
Give me Jesus.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Oh, when I come to die,
Oh, when I come to die,
Oh, when I come to die,
Give me Jesus.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Give me Jesus,
Give me Jesus;
You may have all this world,
Give me Jesus.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
My life, my love I give to Thee,
Thou Lamb of God who died for me;
O may I ever faithful be,
My Savior and my God!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I now believe Thou dost receive,
For Thou hast died that I might live;
And now henceforth I'll trust in Thee,
My Savior and my God!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O Thou who died on Calvary,
To save my soul and make me free,
I'll consecrate my life to Thee,
My Savior and my God!

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I'll live for Him who died for me,
How happy then my life shall be!
I'll live for Him who died for me,
My Savior and my God!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Trying to walk in the steps of the Savior,
Trying to follow our Savior and King;
Shaping our lives by His blessed example,
Happy, how happy, the songs that we bring.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Pressing more closely to Him who is leading,
When we are tempted to turn from the way;
Trusting the arm that is strong to defend us,
Happy, how happy, our praises each day.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Walking in footsteps of gentle forbearance,
Foot-steps of faithfulness, mercy and love;
Looking to Him for the grace freely promised,
Happy, how happy, our journey above.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
How beautiful to walk in the steps of the Savior,
Stepping in the light, stepping in the light;
How beautiful to walk in the steps of the Savior,
Led in paths of light.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Far away in the depths of my spirit tonight
Rolls a melody sweeter than psalm;
In celestial strains it unceasingly falls
O'er my soul like an infinite calm.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
What a treasure I have in this wonderful peace,
Buried deep in the heart of my soul;
So secure that no power can mine it away
While the years of eternity roll.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I am resting tonight in this wonderful peace,
Resting sweetly in Jesus' control;
For I'm kept from all danger by night and by day,
And His glory is flooding my soul.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Peace, peace, wonderful peace,
Coming down from the Father above;
Sweep over my spirit forever, I pray,
In fathomless billows of love.

songs.title: I've Got Peace Like a River
songs.author: Traditional Spiritual

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I've got peace like a river,
I've got peace like a river,
I've got peace like a river in my soul.
I've got peace like a river,
I've got peace like a river,
I've got peace like a river in my soul.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I've got joy like a fountain,
I've got joy like a fountain,
I've got joy like a fountain in my soul.
I've got joy like a fountain,
I've got joy like a fountain,
I've got joy like a fountain in my soul.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I've got love like an ocean,
I've got love like an ocean,
I've got love like an ocean in my soul.
I've got love like an ocean,
I've got love like an ocean,
I've got love like an ocean in my soul.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Standing somewhere in the shadows you'll find Jesus,
He's the friend who always cares and understands;
Standing somewhere in the shadows you will find Him,
And you'll know Him by the nail prints in His hands.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Life is filled with dark shadows,
And our burdens seem too great to bear;
But the Savior will go with you
All the way beyond, if you'll only trust and dare.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I'm working on a building,
I'm working on a building,
I'm working on a building
For my Lord, for my Lord.
It's a holy ghost building,
It's a holy ghost building,
It's a holy ghost building
For my Lord, for my Lord.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
If I was a liar (I wouldn't work on the building),
But I'm a truth-teller (I'm working on the building);
I'm working on the building
For my Lord, for my Lord.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
If I was a sinner (I wouldn't work on the building),
But I'm a believer (I'm working on the building);
I'm working on the building
For my Lord, for my Lord.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I've got a home in glory land that outshines the sun,
I've got a home in glory land that outshines the sun,
I've got a home in glory land that outshines the sun,
Way beyond the blue.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I took Jesus as my Savior, you take Him too,
I took Jesus as my Savior, you take Him too,
I took Jesus as my Savior, you take Him too,
Way beyond the blue.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Do Lord, O do Lord, O do remember me,
Do Lord, O do Lord, O do remember me,
Do Lord, O do Lord, O do remember me,
Way beyond the blue.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Let us break bread together on our knees,
Let us break bread together on our knees;
When I fall on my knees with my face to the rising sun,
O Lord, have mercy on me.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Let us drink wine together on our knees,
Let us drink wine together on our knees;
When I fall on my knees with my face to the rising sun,
O Lord, have mercy on me.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Let us praise God together on our knees,
Let us praise God together on our knees;
When I fall on my knees with my face to the rising sun,
O Lord, have mercy on me.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Kum ba yah, my Lord, kum ba yah!
Kum ba yah, my Lord, kum ba yah!
Kum ba yah, my Lord, kum ba yah!
O Lord, kum ba yah.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Someone's crying, Lord, kum ba yah!
Someone's crying, Lord, kum ba yah!
Someone's crying, Lord, kum ba yah!
O Lord, kum ba yah.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Someone's singing, Lord, kum ba yah!
Someone's singing, Lord, kum ba yah!
Someone's singing, Lord, kum ba yah!
O Lord, kum ba yah.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Someone's praying, Lord, kum ba yah!
Someone's praying, Lord, kum ba yah!
Someone's praying, Lord, kum ba yah!
O Lord, kum ba yah.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Down at the cross where my Savior died,
Down where for cleansing from sin I cried,
There to my heart was the blood applied;
Glory to His name!

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4

chorus.label: Chorus

songs.title: He Is Able to Deliver Thee
songs.author: William A. Ogden, 1887

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
'Tis the grandest theme, let the tidings roll
To the guilty heart, to the sinful soul;
Look to God in faith, He will make thee whole:
"Our God is able to deliver thee."

chorus.label: Chorus

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
Thy precious will, O conquering Savior,
Doth now embrace and compass me;
All discords hushed, my peace a river,
My soul a prisoned bird set free.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Sweet will of God, still fold me closer
Till I am wholly lost in Thee;
Sweet will of God, still fold me closer
Till I am wholly lost in Thee.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I'm pressing on the upward way,
New heights I'm gaining every day;
Still praying as I'm onward bound,
"Lord, plant my feet on higher ground."

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
My heart has no desire to stay
Where doubts arise and fears dismay;
Though some may dwell where these abound,
My prayer, my aim, is higher ground.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I want to live above the world,
Though Satan's darts at me are hurled;
For faith has caught the joyful sound,
The song of saints on higher ground.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
I want to scale the utmost height
And catch a gleam of glory bright;
But still I'll pray till heav'n I've found,
"Lord, plant my feet on higher ground."

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Lord, lift me up and let me stand,
By faith, on heaven's table land,
A higher plane than I have found;
Lord, plant my feet on higher ground.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I have found a friend in Jesus, He's everything to me,
He's the fairest of ten thousand to my soul;
The Lily of the Valley, in Him alone I see
All I need to cleanse and make me fully whole.
In sorrow He's my comfort, in trouble He's my stay,
He tells me every care on Him to roll.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
He will never, never leave me nor yet forsake me here,
While I live by faith and do His blessed will;
A wall of fire about me, I've nothing now to fear,
With His manna He my hungry soul shall fill.
Then sweeping up to glory to see His blessed face,
Where rivers of delight shall ever roll.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
He's the Lily of the Valley, the Bright and Morning Star,
He's the fairest of ten thousand to my soul.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
On Jordan's stormy banks I stand
And cast a wishful eye
To Canaan's fair and happy land
Where my possessions lie.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
O'er all those wide extended plains
Shines one eternal day;
There God the Son forever reigns
And scatters night away.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
No chilling winds nor pois'nous breath
Can reach that healthful shore;
Sickness and sorrow, pain and death
Are felt and feared no more.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
When shall I reach that happy place
And be forever blest?
When shall I see my Father's face
And in His bosom rest?

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I am bound for the promised land,
I am bound for the promised land;
O who will come and go with me?
I am bound for the promised land.

songs.title: We Shall See His Lovely Face
songs.author: Tillit S. Teddlie, 1916

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Some glad morning we shall see Jesus in the air,
Coming after those He loves, telling all to meet Him there;
Every nation, every tribe, saved by His wondrous grace,
In that glorious resurrection morn.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
All our sorrows then be past, all our trials o'er,
We shall never sin again, pain and death are no more;
With our Savior we shall dwell on that celestial shore,
In that glorious resurrection morn.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Now we see through glass so dark, then we'll see Him clear,
Then we'll know as we are known, doubt will disappear;
In His presence we shall bask in that eternal year,
In that glorious resurrection morn.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
We shall see His lovely face,
Some bright golden morn;
We shall see His lovely face,
Some bright golden morn.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Lord, as of old at Pentecost
Thou didst Thy power display,
With cleansing, purifying flame
Descend on us today.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
For mighty works for Thee, O Lord,
Our feeble efforts fail;
O breathe upon us now, we pray,
That love might still prevail.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
All self consume, all sin destroy!
With earnest humble prayer,
All sloth, all coldness drive away;
Thy longing children hear.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Lord, send the old-time power,
The Pentecostal power!
Thy floodgates of blessing on us throw open wide!
Lord, send the old-time power,
The Pentecostal power,
That sinners be converted and Thy name glorified!

songs.title: I Will Sing of My Redeemer
songs.author: Philip P. Bliss, 1876

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I will sing of my Redeemer
And His wondrous love to me;
On the cruel cross He suffered,
From the curse to set me free.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I will tell the wondrous story,
How my lost estate to save,
In His boundless love and mercy,
He the ransom freely gave.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I will praise my dear Redeemer,
His triumphant power I'll tell,
How the victory He giveth
Over sin and death and hell.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
I will sing of my Redeemer
And His heav'nly love to me;
He from death to life hath brought me,
Son of God, with Him to be.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Sing, O sing of my Redeemer,
With His blood He purchased me;
On the cross He sealed my pardon,
Paid the debt and made me free.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
In the bright sunlight, ever rejoicing,
Pressing my way to mansions above;
Singing His praises, gladly I'm walking,
Walking in sunlight, sunlight of love.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Heavenly sunlight, heavenly sunlight,
Flooding my soul with glory divine;
Hallelujah, I am rejoicing,
Singing His praises, Jesus is mine.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O they tell me of a home far beyond the skies,
O they tell me of a home far away;
O they tell me of a home where no storm clouds rise,
O they tell me of an unclouded day.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
O they tell me of a home where my friends have gone,
O they tell me of that land far away;
Where the tree of life in eternal bloom
Sheds its fragrance through the unclouded day.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O they tell me of a King in His beauty there,
And they tell me that mine eyes shall behold
Where He sits on the throne that is whiter than snow,
In the city that is made of gold.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
O they tell me that He smiles on His children there,
And His smile drives their sorrows all away;
And they tell me that no tears ever come again
In that lovely land of unclouded day.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
O the land of cloudless day,
O the land of an unclouded day;
O they tell me of a home where no storm clouds rise,
O they tell me of an unclouded day.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Far away the noise of strife upon my ear is falling,
Then I know the sins of earth beset on every hand;
Doubt and fear and things of earth in vain to me are calling,
None of these shall move me from Beulah Land.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Far below the storm of doubt upon the world is beating,
Sons of men in battle long the enemy withstand;
Safe am I within the castle of God's Word retreating,
Nothing then can reach me—'tis Beulah Land.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Viewing here the works of God, I sink in contemplation
Hearing now His blessed voice I see the way He planned;
Dwelling in the Spirit, here I learn of full salvation,
Gladly will I tarry in Beulah Land.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I'm living on the mountain underneath a cloudless sky,
I'm drinking at the fountain that never shall run dry;
O yes! I'm feasting on the manna from a bountiful supply,
For I am dwelling in Beulah Land.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
Anywhere with Jesus I am not alone,
Other friends may fail me, He is still my own;
Though His hand may lead me over dreary ways,
Anywhere with Jesus is a house of praise.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Anywhere with Jesus over land and sea,
Telling souls in darkness of salvation free;
Ready as He summons me to go or stay,
Anywhere with Jesus when He points the way.

verses.label: Verse 4

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Anywhere, anywhere, fear I cannot know;
Anywhere with Jesus I can safely go.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 1
verses.text:
There's a call comes ringing o'er the restless wave,
"Send the light! Send the light!"
There are souls to rescue, there are souls to save,
Send the light! Send the light!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
We have heard the Macedonian call today,
"Send the light! Send the light!"
And a golden off'ring at the cross we lay,
Send the light! Send the light!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Let us pray that grace may everywhere abound,
"Send the light! Send the light!"
And a Christlike spirit everywhere be found,
Send the light! Send the light!

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Let us not grow weary in the work of love,
"Send the light! Send the light!"
Let us gather jewels for a crown above,
Send the light! Send the light!

chorus.label: Chorus

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
Throw out the lifeline with hand quick and strong;
Why do you tarry, why linger so long?
See! he is sinking; O hasten today—
And out with the lifeline and save him, away!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Throw out the lifeline to danger-fraught men,
Sinking in anguish where you've never been;
Winds of temptation and billows of woe
Will soon hurl them out where the dark waters flow.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Throw out the lifeline! Throw out the lifeline!
Someone is drifting away;
Throw out the lifeline! Throw out the lifeline!
Someone is sinking today.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
Strong to meet the foe, marching on we go,
While our cause we know must prevail;
Shield and banner bright, gleaming in the light,
Batting for the right we ne'er can fail.

verses.label: Verse 3

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Rouse, then, soldiers, rally round the banner,
Ready, steady, pass the word along;
Onward, forward, shout aloud hosanna,
Christ is Captain of the mighty throng.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
We read of a place that's called heaven,
It's made for the pure and the free;
These truths in God's Word He has given,
How beautiful heaven must be.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
In heaven no drooping nor pining,
No wishing for elsewhere to be;
God's light is forever there shining,
How beautiful heaven must be.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Pure waters of life there are flowing
And all who will drink may be free;
Rare jewels of splendor are glowing,
How beautiful heaven must be.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
The angels so sweetly are singing,
Up there by the beautiful sea;
The chords of the white harps are ringing,
How beautiful heaven must be.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
How beautiful heaven must be,
Sweet home of the happy and free;
Fair haven of rest for the weary,
How beautiful heaven must be.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I'd rather have Jesus than silver or gold,
I'd rather be His than have riches untold;
I'd rather have Jesus than houses or lands,
I'd rather be led by His nail-pierced hands.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I'd rather have Jesus than men's applause,
I'd rather be faithful to His dear cause;
I'd rather have Jesus than worldwide fame,
I'd rather be true to His holy name.

verses.label: Verse 3

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Than to be the king of a vast domain
Or be held in sin's dread sway;
I'd rather have Jesus than anything
This world affords today.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
'Tis the blessed hour of prayer, when our hearts lowly bend,
And we gather to Jesus, our Savior and Friend;
If we come to Him in faith, His protection to share,
What a balm for the weary! O how sweet to be there!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
'Tis the blessed hour of prayer, when the Savior draws near,
With a tender compassion His children to hear;
When He tells us we may cast at His feet every care,
What a balm for the weary! O how sweet to be there!

verses.label: Verse 3

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Blessed hour of prayer, blessed hour of prayer;
What a balm for the weary! O how sweet to be there!

songs.title: Must Jesus Bear the Cross Alone
songs.author: Thomas Shepherd, 1693

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Must Jesus bear the cross alone
And all the world go free?
No, there's a cross for everyone,
And there's a cross for me.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
How happy are the saints above
Who once went sorrowing here;
But now they taste unmingled love
And joy without a tear.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
The consecrated cross I'll bear
Till death shall set me free;
And then go home my crown to wear,
For there's a crown for me.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
Nothing between, like pride or station,
Self or friends shall not intervene;
Though it may cost me much tribulation,
I am resolved! There's nothing between.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Nothing between, e'en many hard trials,
Though the whole world against me convene;
Watching with prayer and much self-denial,
I'll triumph at last, with nothing between.

chorus.label: Chorus

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Christ has for sin atonement made,
What a wonderful Savior!
We are redeemed! The price is paid;
What a wonderful Savior!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I praise Him for the cleansing blood,
What a wonderful Savior!
That reconciled my soul to God;
What a wonderful Savior!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
He cleansed my heart from all its sin,
What a wonderful Savior!
And now He reigns and rules therein;
What a wonderful Savior!

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
He walks beside me in the way,
What a wonderful Savior!
And keeps me faithful day by day;
What a wonderful Savior!

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
What a wonderful Savior is Jesus, my Jesus!
What a wonderful Savior is Jesus, my Lord!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Marvelous grace of our loving Lord,
Grace that exceeds our sin and our guilt!
Yonder on Calvary's mount outpoured—
There where the blood of the Lamb was spilt.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Sin and despair like the sea waves cold,
Threaten the soul with infinite loss;
Grace that is greater, yes, grace untold,
Points to the Refuge, the mighty cross.

verses.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
verses.text:
Marvelous, infinite, matchless grace,
Freely bestowed on all who believe!
You that are longing to see His face,
Will you this moment His grace receive?

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Grace, grace, God's grace,
Grace that will pardon and cleanse within;
Grace, grace, God's grace,
Grace that is greater than all our sin.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I am resolved no longer to linger,
Charmed by the world's delight;
Things that are higher, things that are nobler,
These have allured my sight.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
I am resolved to follow the Savior,
Faithful and true each day;
Hark! 'tis the Savior calling to servants,
"Follow Me—follow, follow."

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
I am resolved, and who will go with me?
Come, friends, without delay;
Taught by the Bible, led by the Spirit,
We'll walk the heav'nly way.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I will hasten to Him,
Hasten so glad and free;
Jesus, greatest, highest,
I will come to Thee.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Till we meet, till we meet,
Till we meet at Jesus' feet;
Till we meet, till we meet,
God be with you till we meet again.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
There shall be showers of blessing:
This is the promise of love;
There shall be seasons refreshing,
Sent from the Savior above.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
There shall be showers of blessing—
Precious reviving again;
Over the hills and the valleys,
Sound of abundance of rain.

verses.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
verses.text:
There shall be showers of blessing:
O that today they might fall,
Now as to God we're confessing,
Now as on Jesus we call!

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Showers of blessing,
Showers of blessing we need;
Mercy drops round us are falling,
But for the showers we plead.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I've found a friend, O such a Friend!
He loved me ere I knew Him;
He drew me with the cords of love
And thus He bound me to Him.
And 'round my heart still closely twine
Those ties which naught can sever,
For I am His and He is mine,
Forever and forever.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I've found a Friend, O such a Friend!
He bled, He died to save me;
And not alone the gift of life,
But His own self He gave me.
Naught that I have mine own I call,
I hold it for the Giver;
My heart, my strength, my life, my all,
Are His, and His forever.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Saved by His power divine,
Saved to new life sublime!
Life now is sweet and my joy is complete,
For I'm saved, saved, saved!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
King of my life I crown Thee now,
Thine shall the glory be;
Lest I forget Thy thorn-crowned brow,
Lead me to Calvary.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Show me the tomb where Thou wast laid,
Tenderly mourned and wept;
Angels in robes of light arrayed
Guarded Thee whilst Thou slept.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Let me like Mary, through the gloom,
Come with a gift to Thee;
Show to me now the empty tomb,
Lead me to Calvary.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
May I be willing, Lord, to bear
Daily my cross for Thee;
Even Thy cup of grief to share,
Thou hast borne all for me.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Lest I forget Gethsemane,
Lest I forget Thine agony,
Lest I forget Thy love for me,
Lead me to Calvary.

songs.title: All Creatures of Our God and King
songs.author: Francis of Assisi, 1225; tr. William H. Draper

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
All creatures of our God and King,
Lift up your voice and with us sing,
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Thou burning sun with golden beam,
Thou silver moon with softer gleam,
O praise Him, O praise Him,
Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Thou rushing wind that art so strong,
Ye clouds that sail in heav'n along,
O praise Him! Alleluia!
Thou rising morn, in praise rejoice,
Ye lights of evening, find a voice,
O praise Him, O praise Him,
Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
And all ye men of tender heart,
Forgiving others, take your part,
O sing ye, alleluia!
Ye who long pain and sorrow bear,
Praise God and on Him cast your care,
O praise Him, O praise Him,
Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia!

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Let all things their Creator bless,
And worship Him in humbleness,
O praise Him! Alleluia!
Praise, praise the Father, praise the Son,
And praise the Spirit, Three in One,
O praise Him, O praise Him,
Alleluia, alleluia, alleluia!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
When I saw the cleansing fountain
Open wide for all my sin,
I obeyed the Spirit's wooing
When He said, "Wilt thou be clean?"

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Though the way seems straight and narrow,
All I claimed was swept away;
My ambitions, plans and wishes
At my feet in ashes lay.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Then God's fire upon the altar
Of my heart was set aflame;
I shall never cease to praise Him—
Glory, glory to His name!

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Blessed be the name of Jesus!
I'm so glad He took me in;
He's forgiven my transgressions,
He has cleansed my heart from sin.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I will praise Him! I will praise Him!
Praise the Lamb for sinners slain;
Give Him glory, all ye people,
For His blood can wash away each stain.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
The love of God is greater far
Than tongue or pen can ever tell;
It goes beyond the highest star
And reaches to the lowest hell.
The guilty pair, bowed down with care,
God gave His Son to win;
His erring child He reconciled
And pardoned from his sin.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
O love of God, how rich and pure!
How measureless and strong!
It shall forevermore endure—
The saints' and angels' song.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I have found His grace is all complete,
He supplieth every need;
While I sit and learn at Jesus' feet,
I am free, yes, free indeed.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I have found the pleasure I once craved,
It is joy and peace within;
What a wondrous blessing! I am saved
From the awful gulf of sin.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I have found that hope so bright and clear,
Living in the realm of grace;
O the Savior's presence is so near,
I can see His smiling face.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
I have found the joy no tongue can tell,
How its waves of glory roll!
It is like a great o'erflowing well,
Springing up within my soul.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
It is joy unspeakable and full of glory,
Full of glory, full of glory;
It is joy unspeakable and full of glory,
O the half has never yet been told.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
There's a song my heart is singing,
Song of praise, sweet praise to Jesus;
All my soul with joy is ringing,
Praise to Jesus, glorious name.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Once I wandered in transgression,
Bound in sin and full of sorrow;
Now I walk in sweet possession
Of His grace that's new each morrow.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
In the night of guilt and danger,
Groping blindly in my sinning,
He—no more to me a stranger—
Sought me, saved me, sin forgiving.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
He ransomed me,
He ransomed me,
With His own precious blood He ransomed me;
From sin set free, this song shall be
Forever—He ransomed me.

songs.title: Glorious Things of Thee Are Spoken
songs.author: John Newton, 1779

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Glorious things of thee are spoken,
Zion, city of our God;
He whose word cannot be broken
Formed thee for His own abode.
On the Rock of Ages founded,
What can shake thy sure repose?
With salvation's walls surrounded,
Thou may'st smile at all thy foes.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
See! the streams of living waters,
Springing from eternal love,
Well supply thy sons and daughters
And all fear of want remove.
Who can faint while such a river
Ever flows their thirst t'assuage?
Grace, which like the Lord the giver,
Never fails from age to age.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Round each habitation hov'ring,
See the cloud and fire appear
For a glory and a cov'ring,
Showing that the Lord is near.
Thus deriving from their banner
Light by night and shade by day,
Safe they feed upon the manna
Which He gives them when they pray.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Savior, if of Zion's city
I through grace a member am,
Let the world deride or pity,
I will glory in Thy name.
Fading is the worldling's pleasure,
All his boasted pomp and show;
Solid joys and lasting treasure
None but Zion's children know.

songs.title: A Shelter in the Time of Storm
songs.author: Vernon J. Charlesworth, 1880

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
The Lord's our Rock, in Him we hide,
A shelter in the time of storm;
Secure whatever ill betide,
A shelter in the time of storm.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
A shade by day, defense by night,
A shelter in the time of storm;
No fears alarm, no foes affright,
A shelter in the time of storm.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
The raging storms may round us beat,
A shelter in the time of storm;
We'll never leave our safe retreat,
A shelter in the time of storm.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
O Rock divine, O Refuge dear,
A shelter in the time of storm;
Be Thou our helper ever near,
A shelter in the time of storm.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
O Jesus is a Rock in a weary land,
A weary land, a weary land;
O Jesus is a Rock in a weary land,
A shelter in the time of storm.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4

songs.title: O Master Let Me Walk with Thee
songs.author: Washington Gladden, 1879

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O Master, let me walk with Thee
In lowly paths of service free;
Tell me Thy secret; help me bear
The strain of toil, the fret of care.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Help me the slow of heart to move
By some clear, winning word of love;
Teach me the wayward feet to stay,
And guide them in the homeward way.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Teach me Thy patience; still with Thee
In closer, dearer company,
In work that keeps faith sweet and strong,
In trust that triumphs over wrong.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
In hope that sends a shining ray
Far down the future's broad'ning way;
In peace that only Thou canst give,
With Thee, O Master, let me live.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
We are climbing Jacob's ladder,
We are climbing Jacob's ladder,
We are climbing Jacob's ladder,
Soldiers of the cross.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Every round goes higher, higher,
Every round goes higher, higher,
Every round goes higher, higher,
Soldiers of the cross.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Sinner, do you love my Jesus?
Sinner, do you love my Jesus?
Sinner, do you love my Jesus?
Soldiers of the cross.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
If you love Him, why not serve Him?
If you love Him, why not serve Him?
If you love Him, why not serve Him?
Soldiers of the cross.

verses.label: Verse 5
verses.text:
We are climbing higher, higher,
We are climbing higher, higher,
We are climbing higher, higher,
Soldiers of the cross.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I looked over Jordan and what did I see,
Comin' for to carry me home?
A band of angels comin' after me,
Comin' for to carry me home.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
If you get there before I do,
Comin' for to carry me home,
Tell all my friends I'm comin' there too,
Comin' for to carry me home.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I'm sometimes up and sometimes down,
Comin' for to carry me home,
But still my soul feels heav'nly bound,
Comin' for to carry me home.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Swing low, sweet chariot,
Comin' for to carry me home;
Swing low, sweet chariot,
Comin' for to carry me home.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Deep river, my home is over Jordan;
Deep river, Lord, I want to cross over into campground.
O don't you want to go to that gospel feast,
That promised land where all is peace?
O deep river, Lord, I want to cross over into campground.

songs.title: He's Got the Whole World in His Hands
songs.author: Traditional Spiritual

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
He's got the whole world in His hands,
He's got the whole world in His hands,
He's got the whole world in His hands,
He's got the whole world in His hands.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
He's got the wind and the rain in His hands,
He's got the wind and the rain in His hands,
He's got the wind and the rain in His hands,
He's got the whole world in His hands.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
He's got the little bitty baby in His hands,
He's got the little bitty baby in His hands,
He's got the little bitty baby in His hands,
He's got the whole world in His hands.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
He's got you and me, brother, in His hands,
He's got you and me, sister, in His hands,
He's got you and me, brother, in His hands,
He's got the whole world in His hands.

songs.title: O God Our Help in Ages Past
songs.author: Isaac Watts, 1719

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O God, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come,
Our shelter from the stormy blast,
And our eternal home!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Under the shadow of Thy throne
Still may we dwell secure;
Sufficient is Thine arm alone,
And our defense is sure.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Before the hills in order stood
Or earth received her frame,
From everlasting Thou art God,
To endless years the same.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
A thousand ages in Thy sight
Are like an evening gone;
Short as the watch that ends the night
Before the rising sun.

verses.label: Verse 5
verses.text:
O God, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come,
Be Thou our guard while troubles last
And our eternal home.

songs.title: To Canaan's Land I'm on My Way
songs.author: Traditional

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
To Canaan's land I'm on my way,
Where the soul never dies;
My darkest night will turn to day,
Where the soul never dies.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
A rose is blooming there for me,
Where the soul never dies;
And I will spend eternity,
Where the soul never dies.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
No sad farewells, no tear-dimmed eyes,
Where the soul never dies;
And God the Son forever reigns,
Where the soul never dies.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Where the soul of man never dies,
Dear friends, there'll be no sad goodbyes,
Where the soul of man never dies.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
My heart was distressed 'neath Jehovah's dread frown,
And low in the pit where my sins dragged me down;
I cried to the Lord from the deep miry clay,
Who tenderly brought me out to golden day.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
His love never faileth, His mercy is sure,
His Word is eternal and stands ever pure;
He walks by my side and His presence is free,
Who lovingly guardeth and keepeth me.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
He brought me out of the miry clay,
He set my feet on the Rock to stay;
He puts a song in my soul today,
A song of praise, hallelujah!

songs.title: When We All Get to Heaven
songs.author: Eliza E. Hewitt, 1898

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Sing the wondrous love of Jesus,
Sing His mercy and His grace;
In the mansions bright and blessed
He'll prepare for us a place.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
While we walk the pilgrim pathway,
Clouds will overspread the sky;
But when trav'ling days are over,
Not a shadow, not a sigh.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Let us then be true and faithful,
Trusting, serving every day;
Just one glimpse of Him in glory
Will the toils of life repay.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Onward to the prize before us!
Soon His beauty we'll behold;
Soon the pearly gates will open,
We shall tread the streets of gold.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
When we all get to heaven,
What a day of rejoicing that will be!
When we all see Jesus,
We'll sing and shout the victory!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Praise Him! Praise Him! Jesus, our blessed Redeemer!
Sing, O Earth, His wonderful love proclaim!
Hail Him! Hail Him! Highest archangels in glory;
Strength and honor give to His holy name!
Like a shepherd Jesus will guard His children,
In His arms He carries them all day long:

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Praise Him! Praise Him! Jesus, our blessed Redeemer!
For our sins He suffered, and bled, and died.
He our Rock, our hope of eternal salvation,
Hail Him! Hail Him! Jesus the Crucified.
Sound His praises! Jesus who bore our sorrows,
Love unbounded, wonderful, deep and strong:

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Praise Him! Praise Him! Jesus, our blessed Redeemer!
Heav'nly portals loud with hosannas ring!
Jesus, Savior, reigneth forever and ever;
Crown Him! Crown Him! Prophet and Priest and King!
Christ is coming, over the world victorious,
Pow'r and glory unto the Lord belong:

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Praise Him! Praise Him! Tell of His excellent greatness;
Praise Him! Praise Him! Ever in joyful song!

songs.title: Jesus, the Very Thought of Thee
songs.author: Bernard of Clairvaux, 12th c.; tr. Edward Caswall

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Jesus, the very thought of Thee
With sweetness fills my breast;
But sweeter far Thy face to see
And in Thy presence rest.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Nor voice can sing, nor heart can frame,
Nor can the mem'ry find
A sweeter sound than Thy blest name,
O Savior of mankind!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O hope of every contrite heart,
O joy of all the meek,
To those who fall, how kind Thou art!
How good to those who seek!

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
And those who find Thee find a bliss
Nor tongue nor pen can show;
The love of Jesus, what it is
None but His loved ones know.

verses.label: Verse 5
verses.text:
Jesus, our only joy be Thou,
As Thou our prize wilt be;
Jesus, be Thou our glory now,
And through eternity.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O Jesus, I have promised
To serve Thee to the end;
Be Thou forever near me,
My Master and my Friend;
I shall not fear the battle
If Thou art by my side,
Nor wander from the pathway
If Thou wilt be my guide.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
O let me hear Thee speaking
In accents clear and still,
Above the storms of passion,
The murmurs of self-will;
O speak to reassure me,
To hasten or control;
O speak, and make me listen,
Thou guardian of my soul.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
O Jesus, Thou hast promised
To all who follow Thee
That where Thou art in glory
There shall Thy servant be;
And, Jesus, I have promised
To serve Thee to the end;
O give me grace to follow,
My Master and my Friend.

songs.title: When We Walk with the Lord
songs.author: John H. Sammis, 1887

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
When we walk with the Lord
In the light of His Word,
What a glory He sheds on our way!
While we do His good will,
He abides with us still,
And with all who will trust and obey.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Not a shadow can rise,
Not a cloud in the skies,
But His smile quickly drives it away;
Not a doubt or a fear,
Not a sigh or a tear,
Can abide while we trust and obey.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Not a burden we bear,
Not a sorrow we share,
But our toil He doth richly repay;
Not a grief or a loss,
Not a frown or a cross,
But is blest if we trust and obey.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Then in fellowship sweet
We will sit at His feet,
Or we'll walk by His side in the way;
What He says we will do,
Where He sends we will go,
Never fear, only trust and obey.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Trust and obey, for there's no other way
To be happy in Jesus, but to trust and obey.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Rescue the perishing, care for the dying,
Snatch them in pity from sin and the grave;
Weep o'er the erring one, lift up the fallen,
Tell them of Jesus the mighty to save.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
Down in the human heart, crushed by the tempter,
Feelings lie buried that grace can restore;
Touched by a loving heart, wakened by kindness,
Chords that are broken will vibrate once more.

verses.label: Verse 4

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Rescue the perishing, care for the dying;
Jesus is merciful, Jesus will save.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Sowing in the morning, sowing seeds of kindness,
Sowing in the noontide and the dewy eve;
Waiting for the harvest, and the time of reaping,
We shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Sowing in the sunshine, sowing in the shadows,
Fearing neither clouds nor winter's chilling breeze;
By and by the harvest, and the labor ended,
We shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Going forth with weeping, sowing for the Master,
Though the loss sustained our spirit often grieves;
When our weeping's over, He will bid us welcome,
We shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Bringing in the sheaves, bringing in the sheaves,
We shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves;
Bringing in the sheaves, bringing in the sheaves,
We shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Sing them over again to me,
Wonderful words of Life;
Let me more of their beauty see,
Wonderful words of Life.
Words of life and beauty,
Teach me faith and duty:

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Christ, the blessed One, gives to all
Wonderful words of Life;
Sinner, list to the loving call,
Wonderful words of Life.
All so freely given,
Wooing us to heaven:

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Sweetly echo the gospel call,
Wonderful words of Life;
Offer pardon and peace to all,
Wonderful words of Life.
Jesus, only Savior,
Sanctify forever:

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Beautiful words, wonderful words,
Wonderful words of Life;
Beautiful words, wonderful words,
Wonderful words of Life.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I have a song I love to sing,
Since I have been redeemed,
Of my Redeemer, Savior, King,
Since I have been redeemed.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I have a Christ who satisfies,
Since I have been redeemed,
To do His will my highest prize,
Since I have been redeemed.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I have a witness bright and clear,
Since I have been redeemed,
Driving away all doubt and fear,
Since I have been redeemed.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
I have a home prepared for me,
Since I have been redeemed,
Where I shall dwell eternally,
Since I have been redeemed.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Since I have been redeemed,
Since I have been redeemed,
Since I have been redeemed,
I will glory in His name;
Since I have been redeemed,
I will glory in my Savior's name.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
How I praise Thee, precious Savior,
That Thy love laid hold of me;
Thou hast saved and cleansed and filled me
That I might Thy channel be.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Just a channel full of blessing,
To the thirsty hearts around;
To tell out Thy full salvation,
All Thy loving message sound.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Emptied that Thou shouldest fill me,
A clean vessel in Thy hand;
With no power but as Thou givest
Graciously with each command.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Witnessing Thy pow'r to save me,
Setting free from self and sin;
Thou who bought me to possess me,
In Thy fullness, Lord, come in.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Channels only, blessed Master,
But with all Thy wondrous pow'r
Flowing through us, Thou canst use us
Every day and every hour.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Standing on the promises of Christ my King,
Through eternal ages let His praises ring;
Glory in the highest I will shout and sing,
Standing on the promises of God.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Standing on the promises that cannot fail,
When the howling storms of doubt and fear assail,
By the living Word of God I shall prevail,
Standing on the promises of God.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Standing on the promises of Christ the Lord,
Bound to Him eternally by love's strong cord,
Overcoming daily with the Spirit's sword,
Standing on the promises of God.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Standing on the promises I cannot fall,
List'ning every moment to the Spirit's call,
Resting in my Savior as my all in all,
Standing on the promises of God.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Standing, standing,
Standing on the promises of God my Savior;
Standing, standing,
I'm standing on the promises of God.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Sweet hour of prayer! Sweet hour of prayer!
That calls me from a world of care,
And bids me at my Father's throne
Make all my wants and wishes known.
In seasons of distress and grief,
My soul has often found relief,
And oft escaped the tempter's snare
By thy return, sweet hour of prayer!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Sweet hour of prayer! Sweet hour of prayer!
The joys I feel, the bliss I share
Of those whose anxious spirits burn
With strong desires for thy return!
With such I hasten to the place
Where God my Savior shows His face,
And gladly take my station there,
And wait for thee, sweet hour of prayer!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Sweet hour of prayer! Sweet hour of prayer!
Thy wings shall my petition bear
To Him whose truth and faithfulness
Engage the waiting soul to bless.
And since He bids me seek His face,
Believe His Word and trust His grace,
I'll cast on Him my every care,
And wait for thee, sweet hour of prayer!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Blessed assurance, Jesus is mine!
O what a foretaste of glory divine!
Heir of salvation, purchase of God,
Born of His Spirit, washed in His blood.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Perfect submission, perfect delight,
Visions of rapture now burst on my sight;
Angels descending bring from above
Echoes of mercy, whispers of love.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Perfect submission, all is at rest,
I in my Savior am happy and blest;
Watching and waiting, looking above,
Filled with His goodness, lost in His love.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
This is my story, this is my song,
Praising my Savior all the day long;
This is my story, this is my song,
Praising my Savior all the day long.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Amazing grace! how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me!
I once was lost but now am found,
Was blind but now I see.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear,
And grace my fears relieved;
How precious did that grace appear
The hour I first believed.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Thro' many dangers, toils and snares
I have already come;
'Tis grace hath brought me safe thus far,
And grace will lead me home.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
The Lord has promised good to me,
His Word my hope secures;
He will my shield and portion be
As long as life endures.

verses.label: Verse 5
verses.text:
When we've been there ten thousand years,
Bright shining as the sun,
We've no less days to sing God's praise
Than when we first begun.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
When upon life's billows you are tempest-tossed,
When you are discouraged, thinking all is lost,
Count your many blessings, name them one by one,
And it will surprise you what the Lord hath done.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Are you ever burdened with a load of care?
Does the cross seem heavy you are called to bear?
Count your many blessings, every doubt will fly,
And you will be singing as the days go by.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
When you look at others with their lands and gold,
Think that Christ has promised you His wealth untold;
Count your many blessings, money cannot buy
Your reward in heaven, nor your home on high.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
So amid the conflict, whether great or small,
Do not be discouraged, God is over all;
Count your many blessings, angels will attend,
Help and comfort give you to your journey's end.

chorus.label: Chorus

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
