Join in a song with sweet accord,
And thus surround the throne,
And thus surround the throne.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Let those refuse to sing
Who never knew our God;
But children of the heav'nly King,
But children of the heav'nly King,
May speak their joys abroad,
May speak their joys abroad.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
The hill of Zion yields
A thousand sacred sweets,
Before we reach the heav'nly fields,
Before we reach the heav'nly fields,
Or walk the golden streets,
Or walk the golden streets.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
We're marching to Zion,
Beautiful, beautiful Zion;
We're marching upward to Zion,
The beautiful city of God.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Sun of my soul, Thou Savior dear,
It is not night if Thou be near;
O may no earthborn cloud arise
To hide Thee from Thy servant's eyes.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
When the soft dews of kindly sleep
My weary eyelids gently steep,
Be my last thought: how sweet to rest
Forever on my Savior's breast.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Abide with me from morn till eve,
For without Thee I cannot live;
Abide with me when night is nigh,
For without Thee I dare not die.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Come near and bless us when we wake,
Ere through the world our way we take;
Till in the ocean of Thy love
We lose ourselves in heav'n above.

songs.title: God Leads His Dear Children Along
songs.author: G.A. Young, 1903

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
In shady, green pastures, so rich and so sweet,
God leads His dear children along;
Where the water's cool flow bathes the weary one's feet,
God leads His dear children along.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Sometimes on the mount where the sun shines so bright,
God leads His dear children along;
Sometimes in the valley in the darkest of night,
God leads His dear children along.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Though sorrows befall us and evils oppose,
God leads His dear children along;
Through grace we can conquer, defeat all our foes,
God leads His dear children along.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Some through the waters, some through the flood,
Some through the fire, but all through the blood;
Some through great sorrow, but God gives a song
In the night season and all the day long.

songs.title: What a Friend We Have in Jesus
songs.author: Joseph M. Scriven, 1855

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
What a friend we have in Jesus,
All our sins and griefs to bear!
What a privilege to carry
Everything to God in prayer!
O what peace we often forfeit,
O what needless pain we bear,
All because we do not carry
Everything to God in prayer!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Have we trials and temptations?
Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be discouraged;
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Can we find a friend so faithful
Who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our every weakness;
Take it to the Lord in prayer.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Are we weak and heavy-laden,
Cumbered with a load of care?
Precious Savior, still our refuge;
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Do thy friends despise, forsake thee?
Take it to the Lord in prayer!
In His arms He'll take and shield thee;
Thou wilt find a solace there.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3

chorus.label: Chorus

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O Zion, haste, thy mission high fulfilling,
To tell to all the world that God is Light;
That He who made all nations is not willing
One soul should perish, lost in shades of night.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Proclaim to every people, tongue, and nation
That God in whom they live and move is love;
Tell how He stooped to save His lost creation
And died on earth that man might live above.

verses.label: Verse 3

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Publish glad tidings, tidings of peace,
Tidings of Jesus, redemption and release.

songs.title: Brethren We Have Met to Worship
songs.author: George Atkins, c.1819

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Brethren, we have met to worship
And adore the Lord our God;
Will you pray with all your power,
While we try to preach the Word?
All is vain unless the Spirit
Of the Holy One comes down;
Brethren, pray, and holy manna
Will be showered all around.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Brethren, see poor sinners round you
Slumbering on the brink of woe;
Death is coming, hell is moving,
Can you bear to let them go?
See our fathers and our mothers,
And our children sinking down;
Brethren, pray, and holy manna
Will be showered all around.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Sisters, will you join and help us?
Moses' sister aided him;
Will you help the trembling mourners
Who are struggling hard with sin?
Tell them all about the Savior,
Tell them that He will be found;
Sisters, pray, and holy manna
Will be showered all around.

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
Alabaré, alabaré,
alabará a mi Señor;
Alabaré, alabaré,
alabará a mi Señor.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
Juan vio el número de los redimidos
y todos alababan al Señor;
unos oraban, otros cantaban,
y todos alababan al Señor.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
Todos reunidos le alabamos,
cantando al Señor con alegría;
gloria a Dios y a Cristo el Señor,
y juntos cantemos Aleluya.

songs.title: Cantaré al Señor
songs.titleEn: I Will Sing to the Lord
songs.author: Traducción del Salmo 104, tradicional

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
Cantaré al Señor por la eternidad,
mi Dios es mi Rey para siempre;
cantaré al Señor con toda mi alma
mientras yo viva y respire.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
Que sea grata a Dios mi oración,
me gozaré en Su presencia;
que Su nombre sea eternamente bendito
por Su grande misericordia.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
Bendice alma mía al Señor
y bendigan Su santo nombre;
todo lo que hay dentro de mí
bendiga a Dios sin cesar.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Simply trusting every day,
Trusting through a stormy way;
Even when my faith is small,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Brightly doth His Spirit shine
Into this poor heart of mine;
While He leads I cannot fall,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Singing if my way is clear,
Praying if the path be drear;
If in danger, for Him call,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Trusting Him while life shall last,
Trusting Him till earth be past;
Till within the jasper wall,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Trusting as the moments fly,
Trusting as the days go by;
Trusting Him whate'er befall,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Kneel at the cross, Christ will meet you there,
Come while He waits for you;
List to His voice, leave with Him your care,
And begin life anew.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Kneel at the cross, there is room for all
Who would His glory share;
Bliss there awaits, harm can ne'er befall
Those who are anchored there.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Kneel at the cross, give your idols up,
Look unto realms above;
Turn not away to life's sparkling cup,
Trust only in His love.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Kneel at the cross, leave every care,
Kneel at the cross, Jesus will meet you there.

songs.title: We Have Heard the Joyful Sound
songs.author: Priscilla J. Owens, 1882

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
We have heard the joyful sound:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Spread the tidings all around:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Bear the news to every land,
Climb the steeps and cross the waves;
Onward, tis our Lord's command;
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Sing above the battle strife:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
By His death and endless life,
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Sing it softly through the gloom,
When the heart for mercy craves;
Sing in triumph o'er the tomb:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Give the winds a mighty voice:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Let the nations now rejoice:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Shout salvation full and free;
Highest hills and deepest caves;
This our song of victory:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Low in the grave He lay, Jesus my Savior,
Waiting the coming day, Jesus my Lord!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Vainly they watch His bed, Jesus my Savior;
Vainly they seal the dead, Jesus my Lord!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Death cannot keep its prey, Jesus my Savior;
He tore the bars away, Jesus my Lord!

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Up from the grave He arose,
With a mighty triumph o'er His foes;
He arose a Victor from the dark domain,
And He lives forever with His saints to reign.
He arose! He arose!
Hallelujah! Christ arose!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
To the work! to the work! we are servants of God,
Let us follow the path that our Master has trod;
With the balm of His counsel our strength to renew,
Let us do with our might what our hands find to do.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
To the work! to the work! there is labor for all,
For the kingdom of darkness and error shall fall;
And the name of Jehovah exalted shall be,
In the loud swelling chorus, salvation is free!

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Toiling on, toiling on,
Toiling on, toiling on;
Let us hope, let us watch,
And labor till the Master comes.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
See how He loves you, how gentle His call,
See how He pleads with the wayward and small;
Think of the mercy that showers on all,
Tenderly saying, Come!

verses.label: Verse 3

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Joyful, joyful will the meeting be,
When from sin our hearts are pure and free;
And we shall gather, Savior, with Thee,
In our eternal home.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
On the resurrection morning,
Soul and body meet again;
No more sorrow, no more weeping,
No more pain, no more pain.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Here awhile they must be parted,
And the flesh its Sabbath keep,
Waiting in a holy stillness,
Wrapped in sleep, wrapped in sleep.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
So the followers of Jesus
For that morning watch and wait,
When they'll meet Him at His coming,
At the gate, at the gate.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Soul and body reunited,
Thenceforth nothing can divide,
Waking up in Christ's own likeness,
Satisfied, satisfied.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Jesus calls us o'er the tumult
Of our life's wild, restless sea;
Day by day His sweet voice soundeth,
Saying, Christian, follow Me.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
As, of old, Saint Andrew heard it
By the Galilean lake,
Turned from home, and toil, and kindred,
Leaving all for His dear sake.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Jesus calls us from the worship
Of the vain world's golden store,
From each idol that would keep us,
Saying, Christian, love Me more.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
In our joys and in our sorrows,
Days of toil and hours of ease,
Still He calls, in cares and pleasures,
That we love Him more than these.

verses.label: Verse 5
verses.text:
Jesus calls us! By Thy mercies,
Savior, may we hear Thy call,
Give our hearts to Thine obedience,
Serve and love Thee best of all.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
We shall overcome,
We shall overcome,
We shall overcome someday;
Oh, deep in my heart
I do believe
We shall overcome someday.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
We are not afraid,
We are not afraid,
We are not afraid today;
Oh, deep in my heart
I do believe
We shall overcome someday.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
We shall walk in peace,
We shall walk in peace,
We shall walk in peace someday;
Oh, deep in my heart
I do believe
We shall overcome someday.

songs.title: I Will Arise and Go to Jesus
songs.author: Joseph Hart, 1759

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Come, ye sinners, poor and needy,
Weak and wounded, sick and sore;
Jesus ready stands to save you,
Full of pity, love, and power.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Come, ye thirsty, come, and welcome,
God's free bounty glorify;
True belief and true repentance,
Every grace that brings you nigh.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Come, ye weary, heavy-laden,
Lost and ruined by the fall;
If you tarry till you're better,
You will never come at all.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I will arise and go to Jesus,
He will embrace me in His arms;
In the arms of my dear Savior,
O there are ten thousand charms.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Jesus, keep me near the cross,
There a precious fountain,
Free to all, a healing stream,
Flows from Calvary's mountain.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Near the cross, a trembling soul,
Love and mercy found me;
There the Bright and Morning Star
Sheds its beams around me.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Near the cross! O Lamb of God,
Bring its scenes before me;
Help me walk from day to day
With its shadow o'er me.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Near the cross I'll watch and wait,
Hoping, trusting ever,
Till I reach the golden strand
Just beyond the river.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
In the cross, in the cross,
Be my glory ever;
Till my raptured soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3

chorus.label: Chorus

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness!
Bow down before Him, His glory proclaim;
With gold of obedience and incense of lowliness,
Kneel and adore Him: the Lord is His name!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Low at His feet lay thy burden of carefulness:
High on His heart He will bear it for thee,
Comfort thy sorrows, and answer thy prayerfulness,
Guiding thy steps as may best for thee be.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Fear not to enter His courts in the slenderness
Of the poor wealth thou wouldst reckon as thine;
Truth in its beauty, and love in its tenderness,
These are the offerings to lay on His shrine.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
My country, tis of thee,
Sweet land of liberty,
Of thee I sing;
Land where my fathers died,
Land of the pilgrims pride,
From every mountainside
Let freedom ring!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
My native country, thee,
Land of the noble free,
Thy name I love;
I love thy rocks and rills,
Thy woods and templed hills;
My heart with rapture thrills,
Like that above.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Our fathers God to Thee,
Author of liberty,
To Thee we sing;
Long may our land be bright
With freedom's holy light;
Protect us by Thy might,
Great God, our King!

songs.title: Let the Lower Lights Be Burning
songs.author: Philip P. Bliss, 1871

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Brightly beams our Father's mercy
From His lighthouse evermore,
But to us He gives the keeping
Of the lights along the shore.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Dark the night of sin has settled,
Loud the angry billows roar;
Eager eyes are watching, longing,
For the lights along the shore.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Trim your feeble lamp, my brother,
Some poor sailor, tempest-tossed,
Trying now to make the harbor,
In the darkness may be lost.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Let the lower lights be burning!
Send a gleam across the wave!
Some poor fainting, struggling seaman
You may rescue, you may save.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Up Calvary's mountain, one dreadful morn,
Walked Christ my Savior, weary and worn;
Facing for sinners death on the cross,
That He might save them from endless loss.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
No one but Jesus ever loved me so,
None other offers life that will endure;
Oh, how I love Him! Oh, how I love Him!
Jesus the Savior, precious and pure!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O how I love Him, Savior and Friend,
How can my praises ever find end!
Through years unnumbered on heaven's shore,
My tongue shall praise Him forevermore.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Blessed Redeemer! Precious Redeemer!
Seems now I see Him on Calvary's tree;
Wounded and bleeding, for sinners pleading,
Blind and unheeding, dying for me!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Each little flower that opens,
Each little bird that sings,
He made their glowing colors,
He made their tiny wings.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
The purple-headed mountain,
The river running by,
The sunset and the morning
That brightens up the sky.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
The cold wind in the winter,
The pleasant summer sun,
The ripe fruits in the garden,
He made them every one.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
He gave us eyes to see them,
And lips that we might tell
How great is God Almighty,
Who has made all things well.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
All things bright and beautiful,
All creatures great and small,
All things wise and wonderful,
The Lord God made them all.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Since I was baptized in Jesus name,
New life within my heart has come;
Buried with Him in watery grave,
Raised to walk in life brand new.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
The old man died upon that day,
The new man rose to walk His way;
Forgiven, cleansed, and set apart,
God's Spirit dwelling in my heart.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I rise to walk in newness now,
To Christ my Lord I make my vow;
In death and resurrection joined,
Forever with His will aligned.

songs.title: Lo He Comes with Clouds Descending
songs.author: Charles Wesley, 1758

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Lo! He comes with clouds descending,
Once for favored sinners slain;
Thousand thousand saints attending
Swell the triumph of His train:
Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
God appears on earth to reign.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Every eye shall now behold Him
Robed in dreadful majesty;
Those who set at naught and sold Him,
Pierced and nailed Him to the tree,
Deeply wailing, deeply wailing, deeply wailing,
Shall the true Messiah see.

verses.label: Verse 3
Verse 1
verses.text:
Praise ye the Father! for His lovingkindness,
Tenderly cares He for His erring children;
Praise Him, ye angels, praise Him in the heavens,
Praise ye Jehovah!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Praise ye the Savior! great is His compassion,
Graciously cares He for His chosen people;
Young men and maidens, ye old men and children,
Praise ye the Savior!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Praise ye the Spirit! Comforter of Israel,
Sent of the Father and the Son to bless us;
Praise ye the Triune God! Father, Son, and Spirit,
Praise ye the Triune God!

songs.title: We Shall See the King Someday
songs.author: Luther G. Presley, 1915

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I am dwelling on the mountain
Where the golden sunlight gleams
O'er a land whose wondrous beauty
Far exceeds my fondest dreams;
Where the air is pure, ethereal,
Laden with the breath of flowers
That are blooming at my feet.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I can see far down the mountain
Where I wandered weary years,
Often hindered in my journey
By the ghosts of doubts and fears;
Naked, thirsty, faint and weary
Through the desert I had strayed,
But a blessed, friendly Hand
Held me in its loving shade.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O the cross has wondrous glory!
Oft I've proved this to be true:
When I'm in the way so narrow
I can see a pathway through;
And how sweetly Jesus whispers,
Take the cross, thou needst not fear,
I will ever be with thee,
I will always be so near.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
We shall see the King someday,
We shall see the King someday;
We shall see Him face to face
In His everlasting place,
We shall see the King someday.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Hover o'er me, Holy Spirit,
Bathe my trembling heart and brow;
Fill me with Thy hallowed presence,
Come, O come and fill me now.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Thou canst fill me, gracious Spirit,
Though I cannot tell Thee how;
But I need Thee, greatly need Thee,
Come, O come and fill me now.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I am weakness, full of weakness,
At Thy sacred feet I bow;
Blest divine eternal Spirit,
Fill with power, and fill me now.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Fill me now, fill me now,
Jesus, come and fill me now;
Fill me with Thy hallowed presence,
Come, O come and fill me now.

songs.title: Lord Lay Some Soul upon My Heart
songs.author: Leon Tucker, 1905

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Lord, lay some soul upon my heart
And love that soul through me;
And may I nobly do my part
To win that soul for Thee.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
And when the dear ones safely home
From out the desert roam,
O then the welcome voice will come
Well done, my child, well done.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
To win that soul for Thee, dear Lord,
To win that soul for Thee;
And may I faithfully declare
Thy message full and free.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Lord, lay some soul upon my heart
And love that soul through me;
And may I nobly do my part
To win that soul for Thee.

songs.title: Since I Can Read My Title Clear
songs.author: Isaac Watts, 1707

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
When I can read my title clear
To mansions in the skies,
I bid farewell to every fear
And wipe my weeping eyes.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Should earth against my soul engage,
And fiery darts be hurled,
Then I can smile at Satan's rage
And face a frowning world.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Let cares like a wild deluge come,
And storms of sorrow fall;
May I but safely reach my home,
My God, my heaven, my all.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
There shall I bathe my weary soul
In seas of heavenly rest,
And not a wave of trouble roll
Across my peaceful breast.

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
Señor Jesús, me postro ante Ti,
Busco de Ti limpieza y perdón;
Lávame en la fuente de Tu amor,
Más blanco que la nieve quiero ser.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
Rompe, Señor, la dureza de mí,
Humilla mi orgullo ante Tu altar;
En el poder de Tu Espíritu,
Más blanco que la nieve quiero ser.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
Llena mi alma de Tu santidad,
Quita el pecado que hay en mi ser;
Vive en mi vida con Tu plenitud,
Más blanco que la nieve quiero ser.

chorus.label: Coro
chorus.text:
Más blanco que la nieve,
sí, más blanco que la nieve;
lávame, Salvador,
más blanco que la nieve.

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
En el nombre de Cristo marchamos,
sin temor a la lucha seguiremos;
con la espada del Espíritu a mano,
en Su nombre la victoria veremos.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
El Señor es nuestra fortaleza,
Él nos guía en la oscura jornada;
con su brazo nos da su firmeza,
y su luz nos ilumina la entrada.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
Cuando el mal nos rodea y nos tienta,
en el nombre de Cristo vencemos;
con fe viva en Su gracia abundante,
hacia arriba en Su amor caminemos.

chorus.label: Coro
chorus.text:
En Su nombre, en Su nombre,
en el nombre de Cristo marchamos;
en Su nombre, en Su nombre,
hacia el cielo con gozo avanzamos.

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
Dios te llama hoy al arrepentimiento,
no dilates más la decisión;
su misericordia y su perdón
son para ti en este mismo instante.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
Ven al Salvador sin más tardar,
el camino estrecho te espera;
Jesús te promete la vida eterna
si a Él vienes con fe verdadera.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
¿Por qué vacilas? ¿Por qué demoras?
Hoy es el día de salvación;
abre tu corazón al Rey de reyes,
recibe de Él la redención.

chorus.label: Coro

songs.title: I Love to Tell the Story
songs.author: Arabella Katherine Hankey, 1866

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I love to tell the story
Of unseen things above,
Of Jesus and His glory,
Of Jesus and His love.
I love to tell the story,
Because I know it's true;
It satisfies my longings
As nothing else can do.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I love to tell the story;
More wonderful it seems
Than all the golden fancies
Of all our golden dreams.
I love to tell the story,
It did so much for me;
And that is just the reason
I tell it now to thee.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I love to tell the story;
'Tis pleasant to repeat
What seems, each time I tell it,
More wonderfully sweet.
I love to tell the story,
For some have never heard
The message of salvation
From God's own holy Word.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
I love to tell the story,
For those who know it best
Seem hungering and thirsting
To hear it like the rest.
And when, in scenes of glory,
I sing the new, new song,
I'll sing the old, old story
That I have loved so long.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I love to tell the story!
Twill be my theme in glory
To tell the old, old story
Of Jesus and His love.

songs.title: Blessed Be the God and Father
songs.author: Edward H. Bickersteth, 1875

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Blessed be the God and Father
Of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ!
Who of old the twelve did gather
At His table richly priced.
He has saved us by His power;
He has loved us from the first;
In our dark and bitter hour
He has quenched our spirit's thirst.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
He has sealed us by His Spirit,
Made us rich in heavenly things,
Given us our souls to merit
All the joy that heaven brings.
He shall lead us, He shall feed us,
Bring us to eternal day;
He shall meet each heart that needs him
All along the pilgrim way.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Pentecostal fire is falling,
Praise the Lord, it fell on me!
Pentecostal fire is falling,
Praise the Lord, it fell on me!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
With the Holy Ghost and power,
Praise the Lord, it fell on me!
With the Holy Ghost and power,
Praise the Lord, it fell on me!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Blessed be the name of Jesus,
Praise the Lord, it fell on me!
Blessed be the name of Jesus,
Praise the Lord, it fell on me!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Hail, Thou once despised Jesus!
Hail, Thou Galilean King!
Thou didst suffer to release us;
Thou didst free salvation bring.
Hail, Thou agonizing Savior,
Bearer of our sin and shame!
By Thy merits we find favor;
Life is given through Thy name.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
Jesus, hail! enthroned in glory,
There forever to abide!
All the heavenly hosts adore Thee,
Seated at Thy Father's side.
There for sinners Thou art pleading;
There Thou dost our place prepare;
Ever for us interceding
Till in glory we appear.

songs.title: I Know I Will See Jesus Someday
songs.author: Traditional

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I know I will see Jesus someday,
When life's weary journey is done;
When I reach that bright heavenly shore
And stand in the light of the sun.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Though shadows may darken my way,
And burdens may cause me to mourn;
Yet I know I will see Jesus someday
And lay my heavy burdens down.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
What joy it will be on that morning
To see His dear face shine above;
To hear His sweet voice gently calling
And dwell in His fathomless love.

chorus.label: Chorus

songs.title: Pues Si Vivimos
songs.titleEn: Whether We Live or Whether We Die
songs.author: Himno tradicional en español

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
Pues si vivimos para el Señor vivimos,
y si morimos para el Señor morimos;
Sea que vivamos o que muramos,
somos del Señor, somos del Señor.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
En esta vida frutos hemos de dar
de la vid verdadera que es Cristo el Señor;
Él es quien nos fortalece y alimenta,
en Su nombre hagamos hoy su voluntad.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
Al celebrar el día del Señor
juntos alabamos al Padre creador;
Cristo Jesús resucitó con gloria,
por siempre es el mismo: ayer, hoy y por los siglos.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
O Holy Father, who hast led Thy children
In all the ages, with the fire and cloud,
Through seas dry-shod, through weary wastes bewildering,
To Thee in reverent love our hearts are bowed.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O Triune God, with heart and voice adoring,
Praise we the goodness that doth crown our days;
Pray we that Thou wilt hear us, still imploring
Thy love and favor, kept to us always.

songs.title: Come Let Us Use the Grace Divine
songs.author: Charles Wesley, 1762

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Come, let us use the grace divine,
And all with one accord,
In a perpetual covenant join
Ourselves to Christ the Lord.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Give up ourselves, through Jesus' power,
His name to glorify;
And promise in this sacred hour
For God to live and die.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
The covenant we this moment make
Be ever kept in mind;
We will no more our God forsake,
Or cast His words behind.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
When morning gilds the skies,
My heart awaking cries,
May Jesus Christ be praised!
Alike at work and prayer
To Jesus I repair;
May Jesus Christ be praised!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
When sleep her balm denies,
My silent spirit sighs,
May Jesus Christ be praised!
When evil thoughts molest,
With this I shield my breast:
May Jesus Christ be praised!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Be this, while life is mine,
My canticle divine:
May Jesus Christ be praised!
Be this the eternal song,
Through all the ages long:
May Jesus Christ be praised!

songs.title: Children of the Heavenly Father
songs.author: Carolina Sandell-Berg, 1858; tr. Ernst W. Olson

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Children of the heavenly Father
Safely in His bosom gather;
Nestling bird nor star in heaven
Such a refuge e'er was given.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
God His own doth tend and nourish,
In His holy courts they flourish.
From all evil things He spares them,
In His mighty arms He bears them.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Neither life nor death shall ever
From the Lord His children sever;
Unto them His grace He showeth,
And their sorrows all He knoweth.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Though He giveth or He taketh,
God His children ne'er forsaketh;
His the loving purpose solely
To preserve them pure and holy.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I hear Thy welcome voice,
That calls me, Lord, to Thee,
For cleansing in Thy precious blood
That flowed on Calvary.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Though coming weak and vile,
Thou dost my strength assure;
Thou dost my vileness fully cleanse,
Till spotless all, and pure.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Tis Jesus calls me on
To perfect faith and love,
To perfect hope, and peace, and trust,
For earth and heaven above.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I am coming Lord!
Coming now to Thee!
Wash me, cleanse me in the blood
That flowed on Calvary!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
In heavenly love abiding,
No change my heart shall fear;
And safe is such confiding,
For nothing changes here.
The storm may roar without me,
My heart may low be laid;
But God is round about me,
And can I be dismayed?

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Wherever He may guide me,
No want shall turn me back;
My Shepherd is beside me,
And nothing can I lack.
His wisdom ever waking,
His sight is never dim;
He knows the way He's taking,
And I will walk with Him.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Green pastures are before me,
Which yet I have not seen;
Bright skies will soon be o'er me,
Where darkest clouds have been.
My hope I cannot measure,
My path to life is free,
My Savior has my treasure,
And He will walk with me.

songs.title: My Sins Are Blotted Out I Know
songs.author: Merrill T. MacPherson, 1923

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
What a wondrous message in God's Word!
My sins are blotted out, I know!
If I trust in His redeeming blood,
My sins are blotted out, I know!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Once my heart was black, but now what joy,
My sins are blotted out, I know!
I have peace that nothing can destroy,
My sins are blotted out, I know!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I shall stand someday before my King,
My sins are blotted out, I know!
With the ransomed host I then shall sing,
My sins are blotted out, I know!

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
My sins are blotted out, I know!
My sins are blotted out, I know!
They are buried in the depths of the deepest sea;
My sins are blotted out, I know!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Trust in the Lord and do good,
So shalt thou dwell in the land;
Delight thyself also in the Lord
And He shall give thee thy heart's command.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Commit thy way unto the Lord,
Trust also in Him and He will do;
He shall bring forth thy righteousness
As the light and thy judgment as noonday too.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Rest in the Lord and wait patiently,
Fret not thyself because of evil men;
For evildoers shall be cut off
But those who wait on the Lord shall flourish again.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
He lives! He lives! Christ Jesus lives today!
He walks with me and talks with me
Along life's narrow way.
He lives! He lives! Salvation to impart!
You ask me how I know He lives?
He lives within my heart.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
In all the world around me I see His loving care,
And though my heart grows weary I never will despair;
I know that He is leading through all the stormy blast,
The day of His appearing will come at last.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Rejoice, rejoice, O Christian, lift up your voice and sing
Eternal hallelujahs to Jesus Christ the King!
The hope of all who seek Him, the help of all who find,
None other is so loving, so good and kind.

songs.title: Tell Me the Story of Jesus
songs.author: Fanny J. Crosby, 1880

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Tell me the story of Jesus,
Write on my heart every word;
Tell me the story most precious,
Sweetest that ever was heard.
Tell how the angels in chorus
Sang as they welcomed His birth:
Glory to God in the highest!
Peace and good tidings to earth.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Fasting alone in the desert,
Tell of the days that are past;
How for our sins He was tempted,
Yet did not yield to the last.
Tell of the years of His labor,
Tell of the sorrow He bore,
He was despised and afflicted,
Homeless, rejected, and poor.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Tell of the cross where they nailed Him,
Writhing in anguish and pain;
Tell of the grave where they laid Him,
Tell how He liveth again.
Love in that story so tender,
Clearer than ever I see;
Stay, let me weep while you whisper,
Love paid the ransom for me.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Tell me the story of Jesus,
Write on my heart every word;
Tell me the story most precious,
Sweetest that ever was heard.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Come, every soul by sin oppressed,
There's mercy with the Lord;
And He will surely give you rest,
By trusting in His Word.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
For Jesus shed His precious blood
Rich blessings to bestow;
Plunge now into the crimson flood
That washes white as snow.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Yes, Jesus is the Truth, the Way,
That leads you into rest;
Believe in Him without delay
And you are fully blest.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Only trust Him, only trust Him,
Only trust Him now;
He will save you, He will save you,
He will save you now.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Turn back, O man, forswear thy foolish ways.
Old now is earth and none may count her days,
Yet thou, her child, whose head is crowned with flame,
Still wilt not hear thine inner God proclaim,
Turn back, O man, forswear thy foolish ways.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Earth might be fair and all men glad and wise.
Age after age their tragic empires rise,
Built while they dream and in that dreaming weep:
Would man but wake from out his haunted sleep,
Earth might be fair and all men glad and wise.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Earth shall be fair and all her folk be one,
Nor till that hour shall God's whole will be done;
Now, even now, once more from earth to sky
Peals forth in joy man's old undaunted cry:
Earth shall be fair and all her folk be one.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Seek ye the Lord while He may be found,
Call upon Him while He is near;
Let the wicked forsake his way,
And the unrighteous man his thought.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Let him return unto the Lord our God,
And He will have mercy upon him;
And to our God for He will abundantly pardon,
Abundantly pardon the sinner.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
For my thoughts are not your thoughts,
Neither are your ways my ways;
For as the heavens are higher than the earth,
So are my ways higher than your ways.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Sunset and evening star,
And one clear call for me!
And may there be no moaning of the bar,
When I put out to sea.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
But such a tide as moving seems asleep,
Too full for sound and foam,
When that which drew from out the boundless deep
Turns again home.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Twilight and evening bell,
And after that the dark!
And may there be no sadness of farewell,
When I embark.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
For though from out our bourne of Time and Place
The flood may bear me far,
I hope to see my Pilot face to face
When I have crossed the bar.

songs.title: The Light of the World Is Jesus
songs.author: Philip P. Bliss, 1875

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
The whole world was lost in the darkness of sin,
The Light of the world is Jesus;
Like sunshine at noonday His glory shone in,
The Light of the world is Jesus.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
No darkness have we who in Jesus abide,
The Light of the world is Jesus;
We walk in the light when we follow our Guide,
The Light of the world is Jesus.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Ye dwellers in darkness with sin-blinded eyes,
The Light of the world is Jesus;
Go, wash at His bidding, and light will arise,
The Light of the world is Jesus.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
No need of the sunlight in heaven, we're told,
The Light of the world is Jesus;
The Lamb is the light of the city of gold,
The Light of the world is Jesus.

chorus.label: Chorus

songs.title: Give of Your Best to the Master
songs.author: Howard B. Grose, 1902

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3

chorus.label: Chorus

songs.title: Living Below in This Old World
songs.author: Traditional

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Living below in this old world of woe,
Living for Jesus wherever I go;
Waiting the time when He calls me away,
Living for Jesus each moment each day.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Trusting the Lord while I walk in the light,
Praying and watching and fighting the fight;
Fearing no foe while my Savior is near,
Living for Jesus throughout the year.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Living for Jesus who died in my place,
Bearing on Calvary my sin and disgrace;
Such love constrains me to answer His call,
Living for Jesus my Lord and my all.

songs.title: The Half Has Never Been Told
songs.author: Arthur C. Barham-Gould, 1873

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I have read of a beautiful city
Far away in the Kingdom of God;
I have read how its walls are of jasper,
How its streets are all golden and broad.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I have read of bright mansions in heaven
Which the Savior has gone to prepare;
And I want to be one of the number
That shall enter those mansions so fair.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I have read of a Christ so forgiving,
Full of mercy and pity and love;
And I want to be like Him in living
And to dwell with Him in heav'n above.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
The half has never been told,
Of the glory the cross doth unfold,
Of the crimson flood, of the precious blood,
The half has never been told.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
For my life He bled and died,
Christ will hold me fast;
Justice has been satisfied;
He will hold me fast.
Raised with Him to endless life,
He will hold me fast
Till our faith is turned to sight,
When He comes at last.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
He will hold me fast,
He will hold me fast;
For my Savior loves me so,
He will hold me fast.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Years I spent in vanity and pride,
Caring not my Lord was crucified;
Knowing not it was for me He died
On Calvary.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
By God's Word at last my sin I learned;
Then I trembled at the law I'd spurned,
Till my guilty soul imploring turned
To Calvary.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Now I've giv'n to Jesus everything,
Now I gladly own Him as my King,
Now my raptured soul can only sing
Of Calvary.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
O the love that drew salvation's plan!
O the grace that brought it down to man!
O the mighty gulf that God did span
At Calvary!

chorus.label: Chorus

songs.title: O Thou Fount of Every Blessing
songs.author: Thomas Hastings, 1832

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee;
Let the water and the blood,
From Thy wounded side which flowed,
Be of sin the double cure:
Save from wrath and make me pure.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
verses.text:
While I draw this fleeting breath,
When my eyes shall close in death,
When I rise to worlds unknown
And behold Thee on Thy throne,
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
No shadows yonder! All light and song!
Each day I wonder, and say, How long
Shall time me sunder from that dear throng?
No shadows yonder, all light and song!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
No weeping yonder! All fled away!
While here I wander each weary day,
And sigh and ponder on life's decay;
No weeping yonder, all fled away!

verses.label: Verse 3
Verse 1
verses.text:
How can I say thanks for the things
You have done for me?
Things so undeserved, yet You gave
To prove Your love for me.
The voices of a million angels
Could not express my gratitude;
All that I am and ever hope to be,
I owe it all to Thee.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
To God be the glory,
To God be the glory,
To God be the glory
For the things He has done.
With His blood He has saved me,
With His power He has raised me;
To God be the glory
For the things He has done.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Leaning on Jesus, leaning on Jesus,
Safe and secure from all alarms;
Leaning on Jesus, leaning on Jesus,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
What have I to dread, what have I to fear,
Leaning on the everlasting arms?
I have blessed peace with my Lord so near,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Oh how sweet to walk in this pilgrim way,
Leaning on the everlasting arms;
Oh how bright the path grows from day to day,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
verses.text:
Lord, by the stripes which wounded Thee,
From death's dread sting Thy servants free,
That we may live and sing to Thee:
Alleluia!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Give me that old time religion,
Give me that old time religion,
Give me that old time religion,
It's good enough for me.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
It was good for our mothers,
It was good for our mothers,
It was good for our mothers,
And it's good enough for me.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Makes me love everybody,
Makes me love everybody,
Makes me love everybody,
And it's good enough for me.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
It will take us all to heaven,
It will take us all to heaven,
It will take us all to heaven,
And it's good enough for me.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Thou art the Potter;
I am the clay.
Mold me and make me
After Thy will,
While I am waiting,
Yielded and still.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Search me and try me,
Savior today!
Wash me just now, Lord,
Wash me just now,
As in Thy presence
Humbly I bow.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Held by Thy power,
Truly Thou art!
Fill with Thy Spirit
Till all shall see
Christ only, always,
Living in me!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee;
Let the water and the blood,
From Thy riven side which flowed,
Be of sin the double cure,
Cleanse me from its guilt and power.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
verses.text:
While I draw this fleeting breath,
When mine eyelids close in death,
When I soar to worlds unknown,
See Thee on Thy judgment throne,
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee.

songs.title: I Am Coming to the Cross
songs.author: William McDonald, 1870

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
Here I give my all to Thee,
Friends, and time, and earthly store;
Soul and body Thine to be,
Wholly Thine forevermore.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I am trusting, Lord, in Thee,
Blessed Lamb of Calvary;
Humbly at Thy cross I bow,
Save me, Jesus, save me now.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Shackled by a heavy burden
'Neath a load of guilt and shame,
Then the hand of Jesus touched me,
And now I am no longer the same.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Since I met this blessed Savior,
Since He cleansed and made me whole,
I will never cease to praise Him;
I'll shout it while eternity rolls.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
He touched me, oh, He touched me,
And oh, the joy that floods my soul!
Something happened, and now I know,
He touched me and made me whole.

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
El buen Pastor nos guía
por valles y por montes;
Su voz conocen las ovejas
y a Él siguen con amor.
Nos lleva a aguas tranquilas,
en verdes prados nos hace reposar;
restaurará nuestras almas
y por sendas justas nos hará caminar.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
Aunque ande en el valle
de sombra y de muerte,
no temeré ningún mal;
Tú estás conmigo siempre.
Tu vara y tu cayado
me infunden aliento y paz;
me preparas mesa
delante de mis enemigos ya.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
Ciertamente el bien y la misericordia
me seguirán todos los días;
en la casa del Señor
moraré por los siglos eternos.
Alabaré al buen Pastor
que me amó y se dio por mí,
que murió en la cruz
para rescatarme a mí.

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
Cristo me ama, me ama a mí,
su palabra dice así;
los pequeños son de Aquél
que es nuestro amigo fiel.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
Cristo me ama, pues murió
y el cielo me abrió;
Él mis culpas limpió
y al cielo me llevó.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
Cristo me ama, Él es mi Rey,
me gobierna con Su ley;
cuando muera al cielo iré
pues Él me amó a mí.

chorus.label: Coro

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
Venid a mí, dice el Señor,
todos los que estáis cansados;
yo os daré descanso y paz,
yo os daré refrigerio.
Mi yugo es suave y ligero,
mi carga es fácil de llevar;
aprendamos de Jesús
humildad y mansedumbre.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
Los que estáis cargados de pecado,
venid, que el Señor os perdonará;
los que estáis enfermos del corazón,
Jesús tiene bálsamo para vos.
No hay carga tan pesada
que Él no pueda sostener;
no hay dolor tan grande
que no pueda Él responder.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
Cansado del camino, ven a Cristo,
En Él hay reposo para el alma;
en Sus manos hay poder para salvarte,
en Su corazón hay amor sin fin.
Venid todos los sedientos,
el agua de vida beberéis;
venid a la fuente de vida,
vivid con Jesús por siempre.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Blessed is He that cometh in the name of the Lord,
Blessed is He that cometh in the name of the Lord;
Hosanna in the highest, hosanna in the highest,
Blessed is He that cometh in the name of the Lord.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Holy, holy, holy, Lord God of hosts,
Holy, holy, holy, Lord God of hosts;
Heaven and earth are full of His glory,
Blessed is He that cometh in the name of the Lord.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Lift up your voices, sing to the Lord,
Lift up your voices, sing to the Lord;
All the earth shall worship and praise Him,
Blessed is He that cometh in the name of the Lord.

songs.title: Go Tell It on the Mountain
songs.author: African American Spiritual, 1865

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
While shepherds kept their watching
O'er silent flocks by night,
Behold throughout the heavens
There shone a holy light.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
The shepherds feared and trembled
When lo! above the earth
Rang out the angel chorus
That hailed our Savior's birth.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Down in a lowly manger
The humble Christ was born,
And God sent us salvation
That blessed Christmas morn.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Go, tell it on the mountain,
Over the hills and everywhere;
Go, tell it on the mountain
That Jesus Christ is born!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Thou art worthy, Thou art worthy,
Thou art worthy, O Lord,
To receive glory, glory and honor,
Glory and honor and power.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
For Thou hast created, hast all things created,
For Thou hast created all things;
And for Thy pleasure they are created,
Thou art worthy, O Lord.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Jesus is coming to earth again,
What if it were today?
Coming in power and love to reign,
What if it were today?
Coming to claim His chosen bride,
All the redeemed and purified,
Over this whole earth scattered wide,
What if it were today?

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Satan's dominion will then be o'er,
O that it were today!
Sorrow and sighing shall be no more,
O that it were today!
Then shall the dead in Christ arise,
Caught up to meet Him in the skies,
When shall these glories meet our eyes?
What if it were today?

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Faithful and true would He find us here
If He should come today?
Watching in gladness and not in fear,
If He should come today?
Signs of His coming multiply,
Morning light breaks in eastern sky;
Watch, for the time is drawing nigh,
What if it were today?

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Glory, glory! Joy to my heart twill bring,
Glory, glory! When we shall crown Him King;
Glory, glory! Haste to prepare the way,
Glory, glory! Jesus will come someday.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Once in royal David's city
Stood a lowly cattle shed,
Where a mother laid her baby
In a manger for His bed:
Mary was that mother mild,
Jesus Christ her little Child.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
He came down to earth from heaven
Who is God and Lord of all,
And His shelter was a stable,
And His cradle was a stall;
With the poor, and mean, and lowly,
Lived on earth our Savior holy.

verses.label: Verse 3

songs.title: Beautiful Savior
songs.author: Silesian folk song, 17th c.; tr. Joseph A. Seiss

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Beautiful Savior, King of creation,
Son of God and Son of Man!
Truly I'd love Thee, truly I'd serve Thee,
Light of my soul, my joy, my crown.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Fair are the meadows, fair are the woodlands,
Robed in flowers of blooming spring;
Jesus is fairer, Jesus is purer,
He makes our sorrows cease to sing.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Fair is the sunshine, fair is the moonlight,
Bright the sparkling stars on high;
Jesus shines brighter, Jesus shines purer
Than all the angels in the sky.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Beautiful Savior, Lord of the nations,
Son of God and Son of Man!
Glory and honor, praise, adoration,
Now and forevermore be Thine!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Must Jesus bear the cross alone
And all the world go free?
No, there's a cross for everyone,
And there's a cross for me.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
How happy are the saints above
Who once went sorrowing here;
But now they taste unmingled love
And joy without a tear.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
The consecrated cross I'll bear
Till death shall set me free;
And then go home my crown to wear,
For there's a crown for me.

songs.title: There Is a Green Hill Far Away
songs.author: Cecil F. Alexander, 1848

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
There is a green hill far away,
Without a city wall,
Where the dear Lord was crucified,
Who died to save us all.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
We may not know, we cannot tell
What pains He had to bear;
But we believe it was for us
He hung and suffered there.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
He died that we might be forgiven,
He died to make us good,
That we might go at last to heaven,
Saved by His precious blood.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
O dearly, dearly has He loved,
And we must love Him too,
And trust in His redeeming blood,
And try His works to do.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Wonderful grace of Jesus,
Greater than all my sin;
How shall my tongue describe it,
Where shall its praise begin?
Taking away my burden,
Setting my spirit free;
For the wonderful grace of Jesus reaches me.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3

chorus.label: Chorus

songs.title: Work for the Night Is Coming
songs.author: Anna L. Walker, 1854

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3

songs.title: When the Saints Go Marching In
songs.author: Traditional Spiritual

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Oh when the saints go marching in,
Oh when the saints go marching in,
O Lord I want to be in that number
When the saints go marching in.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Oh when the sun refuses to shine,
Oh when the sun refuses to shine,
O Lord I want to be in that number
When the sun refuses to shine.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Oh when they crown Him Lord of all,
Oh when they crown Him Lord of all,
O Lord I want to be in that number
When they crown Him Lord of all.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Oh when the trumpet sounds the call,
Oh when the trumpet sounds the call,
O Lord I want to be in that number
When the trumpet sounds the call.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Into my heart, into my heart,
Come into my heart, Lord Jesus;
Come in today, come in to stay,
Come into my heart, Lord Jesus.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Out of my heart, out of my heart,
Shine out of my heart, Lord Jesus;
Shine out today, shine out alway,
Shine out of my heart, Lord Jesus.

songs.title: His Eye Is on the Sparrow
songs.author: Civilla D. Martin, 1905

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Why should I feel discouraged,
Why should the shadows come,
Why should my heart be lonely,
And long for heav'n and home,
When Jesus is my portion?
My constant Friend is He;
His eye is on the sparrow,
And I know He watches me.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Let not your heart be troubled,
His tender word I hear,
And resting on His goodness,
I lose my doubts and fears;
Though by the path He leadeth
But one step I may see:
His eye is on the sparrow,
And I know He watches me.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Whenever I am tempted,
Whenever clouds arise,
When songs give place to sighing,
When hope within me dies,
I draw the closer to Him,
From care He sets me free:
His eye is on the sparrow,
And I know He watches me.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I sing because I'm happy,
I sing because I'm free,
For His eye is on the sparrow,
And I know He watches me.

songs.title: Anywhere with Jesus I Can Go to Sleep
songs.author: Helen Cadbury, 1900

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I lay my sins on Jesus,
The spotless Lamb of God;
He bears them all and frees us
From the accursed load.
I bring my guilt to Jesus
To wash my crimson stains
White in His blood most precious
Till not a stain remains.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I lay my wants on Jesus,
All fullness dwells in Him;
He healeth my diseases,
He doth my soul redeem.
I lay my griefs on Jesus,
My burdens and my cares;
He from them all releases,
He all my sorrows shares.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I long to be like Jesus,
Meek, loving, lowly, mild;
I long to be like Jesus,
The Father's holy Child.
I long to be with Jesus,
Amid the heavenly throng,
To sing with saints His praises,
To learn the angels song.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
My Lord has garments so wondrous fine,
And myrrh their texture fills;
Its fragrance reached to this heart of mine
With joy my being thrills.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
His garments too were in cassia dipped
With healing in a touch;
Each time my feet in some sin have slipped
He took me from its clutch.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
In garments glorious He will come,
To open wide the door;
And I shall enter my heavenly home,
To dwell forevermore.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Out of the ivory palaces,
Into a world of woe,
Only His great eternal love
Made my Savior go.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
When I shall come to the end of my way,
When I shall rest at the close of life's day,
When Welcome Home I shall hear Jesus say,
O that will be sunrise for me.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
When I shall see the dear face of my Lord,
Praise Him forever and trust in His word;
Joy will be mine and the life He restored,
O that will be sunrise for me.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O what a sunrise that morning will be,
Glorious sunrise my Jesus to see;
Leaping and singing with heart full and free,
O that will be sunrise for me.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Sunrise tomorrow, sunrise tomorrow,
Sunrise in glory is waiting for me;
Sunrise tomorrow, sunrise tomorrow,
Sunrise with Jesus for eternity.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Is it well with your soul?
Is it well, is it well with your soul?
Do you walk in the light,
Does your conscience stay right?
Is it well, is it well with your soul?

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Is the Savior your friend?
Is He with you to life's very end?
When the shadows draw near,
Will His voice you then hear?
Is the Savior, the Savior your friend?

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Are you ready to go
Should the Lord call you home even now?
Is your life consecrate,
Are you watching and waiting?
Are you ready, are you ready to go?

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
We gather together to ask the Lord's blessing;
He chastens and hastens His will to make known.
The wicked oppressing now cease from distressing.
Sing praises to His name; He forgets not His own.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
We all do extol Thee, Thou leader triumphant,
And pray that Thou still our defender wilt be.
Let Thy congregation escape tribulation;
Thy name be ever praised! O Lord, make us free!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Ring the bells of heaven! there is joy today,
For a soul returning from the wild!
See, the Father meets him out upon the way,
Welcoming His weary, wandring child.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Ring the bells of heaven! there is joy today,
For the wanderer now is reconciled;
Yes, a soul is rescued from his sinful way,
And is born anew, a ransomed child.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Ring the bells of heaven! spread the feast today,
Angels, swell the glad triumphant strain!
Tell the joyful tidings, bear it far away!
For a precious soul is born again.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Glory! glory! how the angels sing;
Glory! glory! how the loud harps ring!
Tis the ransomed army, like a mighty sea,
Pealing forth the anthem of the free.

songs.title: O Happy Day That Fixed My Choice
songs.author: Philip Doddridge, 1755

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O happy day, that fixed my choice
On Thee, my Savior and my God!
Well may this glowing heart rejoice
And tell its raptures all abroad.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
O happy bond, that seals my vows
To Him who merits all my love!
Let cheerful anthems fill His house,
While to that sacred shrine I move.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Tis done, the great transaction's done!
I am my Lord's and He is mine;
He drew me and I followed on,
Charmed to confess the voice divine.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Now rest, my long-divided heart,
Fixed on this blissful center, rest;
Nor ever from my Lord depart,
With Him of every good possessed.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my sins away!
He taught me how to watch and pray,
And live rejoicing every day;
Happy day, happy day,
When Jesus washed my sins away!

songs.title: Nothing Is Too Hard for Jesus
songs.author: Traditional

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Nothing is too hard for Jesus,
No man can work like Him;
Nothing is too hard for Jesus,
No man can work like Him.
He healed the sick and lame,
He opened blinded eyes;
Nothing is too hard for Jesus,
No man can work like Him.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Nothing is too hard for Jesus,
He calmed the raging sea;
Nothing is too hard for Jesus,
He set the captive free.
He turned the water into wine,
Raised Lazarus from the dead;
Nothing is too hard for Jesus,
He is worthy to be praised.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Precious memories, unseen angels
Sent from somewhere to my soul;
How they linger, ever near me,
And the sacred past unfold.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Precious father, loving mother,
Fly across the lonely years;
And old home scenes of my childhood,
In fond memory appears.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
As I travel on life's pathway,
Know not what the years may hold;
As I ponder, hope grows fonder,
Precious memories flood my soul.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Precious memories, how they linger,
How they ever flood my soul;
In the stillness of the midnight,
Precious, sacred scenes unfold.

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
En Cristo solo pongo mi esperanza,
Él es mi luz, mi fuerza y salvación;
En Él encuentro paz y la confianza,
en Cristo solo está mi redención.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
Su gracia y amor me sostienen cada día,
Su Espíritu me guía en todo el caminar;
en los valles de sombra y de agonía,
mi buen Pastor me sigue siempre acompañar.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
Murió en la cruz para llevar mis culpas,
resucitó y está sentado a la diestra;
su sangre preciosa limpia todas mis manchas,
En Cristo solo está la vida nuestra.

chorus.label: Coro
chorus.text:
En Cristo solo, en Cristo solo,
en Él confío, Él es mi Salvador;
en Cristo solo, en Cristo solo,
en Él encuentro paz, amor y perdón.

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
Gracias, Señor, por Tu bondad sin fin,
gracias por el amor que me diste a mí;
por la vida y salud que me regalas hoy,
gracias, Señor, por todo lo que soy.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
Gracias por Tu Hijo que murió por mí,
por Tu Santo Espíritu que mora en mí;
por Tu Palabra que ilumina mi camino,
gracias, Señor, por Tu amor divino.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
Gracias por la iglesia donde juntos vas,
por los hermanos con quienes adorar;
por la esperanza del cielo que nos diste,
gracias, Señor, porque Tú siempre existe.

chorus.label: Coro
chorus.text:
Gracias, Señor, gracias, Señor,
gracias por tu inmenso amor;
gracias, Señor, gracias, Señor,
por tu gracia y tu perdón.

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
Jesús te está llamando hoy,
suavemente, con amor;
vete al Salvador, no tardes más,
Él te llama con fervor.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
Jesús te llama, ven a Él,
te perdonará el Señor;
Su gracia amplia alcanza a ti,
abre tu corazón.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
Jesús te llama, no demores,
hoy es el día de salvación;
el tiempo pasa, viene la hora
de responder a Su invitación.

chorus.label: Coro

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Lavdi Perëndisë në qiell
Glory to God in heaven
Paqe mbi dhe për njerëzit
Peace on earth to all people
Në emrin e Jezu Krishtit
In the name of Jesus Christ
Lavdi, lavdi, lavdi
Glory, glory, glory

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I lartë, i shenjtë, i denjë
Exalted, holy, worthy
Mbreti i mbretërve është Ai
He is the King of kings
Adhurojmë me gjithë zemrën
We worship with all our hearts
Lavdi, lavdi, lavdi
Glory, glory, glory

songs.title: Zoti Im është Bari Im (The Lord Is My Shepherd)
songs.author: Based on Psalm 23, traditional

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Zoti im është bari im
The Lord is my shepherd
S'kam të nevojshme asgjë
I shall not want
Më bën të rri në kullosa të gjelbra
He makes me lie in green pastures
Më çon pranë ujërave të qeta
He leads me beside still waters

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Shpirtin tim e rimëkëmb
He restores my soul
Më udhëzon në shtigje të drejta
He guides me in right paths
Edhe nëpër luginën e hijes
Even through the valley of shadow
Nuk kam frikë, Ti je me mua
I will fear no evil, You are with me

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Mirësia dhe mëshira ndjekin
Goodness and mercy follow me
Të gjitha ditët e jetës sime
All the days of my life
Dhe do të banoj në shtëpinë e Zotit
And I will dwell in God's house
Përjetë, përjetë
Forever, forever

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Krishti u ngjall nga të vdekurit
Christ is risen from the dead
Me vdekjen shkel vdekjen
Trampling death by death
Edhe atyre në varre
And to those in the tombs
U dhuroi jetën
Granting them life

verses.label: Chorus
verses.text:
Krishti u ngjall!
Christ is risen!
Vërtet u ngjall!
Truly He is risen!
Aleluja, aleluja!
Alleluia, alleluia!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Jezusi më do, e di mirë
Jesus loves me, this I know
Sepse Bibla thotë kjo
For the Bible tells me so
Vogëlushët i takon Atij
Little ones to Him belong
Janë të dobët por Ai i forton
They are weak but He is strong

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Jezusi më do, më ka shpëtuar
Jesus loves me, He has saved me
Gjaku i Tij çmimin e pagoi
His blood has paid the price
Çdo mëkat timin ka larë
He has washed every sin of mine
Dhe tani mund të flas me Atë
And now I can speak with Him

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Po, Jezusi më do
Yes, Jesus loves me
Po, Jezusi më do
Yes, Jesus loves me
Po, Jezusi më do
The Bible tells me so

songs.title: Lum Ai Njeri (Blessed Is the Man)
songs.author: Based on Psalm 1, traditional

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Lum ai njeri që nuk ecën
Blessed is the man who walks not
Në këshillin e të pabesëve
In the counsel of the wicked
As nuk qëndron në rrugën e mëkatarëve
Nor stands in the way of sinners
As nuk ulet në vendin e tallësve
Nor sits in the seat of mockers

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Por kënaqësia e tij është
But his delight is
Në ligjin e Zotit
In the law of the Lord
Dhe ditë e natë ai mediton
And day and night he meditates
Në ligjin e Tij
On His law

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Perëndia është dashuri
God is love
Ai dërgoi Birin e Tij
He sent His Son
Që të shpëtojë botën
To save the world
Në dashuri të pafund
In endless love

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Kaq e deshi Perëndia botën
So loved God the world
Saqë dha Birin e Tij të vetëm
That He gave His only Son
Që kush beson në Të
That whoever believes in Him
Të ketë jetë të përjetshme
May have eternal life

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Lavdi Perëndisë Atit
Glory to God the Father
Lavdi Jezu Krishtit Birit
Glory to Jesus Christ the Son
Lavdi Frymës së Shenjtë
Glory to the Holy Spirit
Përjetë dhe përjetë
Forever and ever

songs.title: Vij te Ti, Zot (I Come to Thee, Lord)
songs.author: Traditional Albanian

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Vij te Ti, Zot, me gjithë barrën time
I come to You, Lord, with all my burdens
Ti i mban barrët e rënda
You carry heavy burdens
Vij te Ti me lotë sysh
I come to You with tears
Dhe Ti i fshin të gjitha
And You wipe them all away

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Thirrje dëgjoj, zërin Tënd
I hear a call, Your voice
Ti po me thërret me dashuri
You are calling me with love
Nuk mund të rri larg Teje
I cannot stay far from You
Vij, vij, Zot, te Ti
I come, I come, Lord, to You

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Vij te Ti, vij te Ti
I come to You, I come to You
Shpëtimtar, Zot i imi
Savior, my Lord
Prano zemrën time sot
Accept my heart today
Vij te Ti
I come to You

songs.title: 奇异恩典 (Qíyì Ēndiǎn)
songs.author: 约翰·牛顿 John Newton, 1779; tr. traditional
songs.scripture: 以弗所书 2:8-9; 提摩太前书 1:15

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
奇异恩典，何等甘甜
Qíyì ēndiǎn, héděng gāntián
我罪已得赦免
Wǒ zuì yǐ dé shèmiǎn
前我失丧，今被寻回
Qián wǒ shīsàng, jīn bèi xún huí
瞎眼今得看见
Xiā yǎn jīn dé kànjiàn

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
如此恩典，教我敬畏
Rúcǐ ēndiǎn, jiào wǒ jìngwèi
使我心得安慰
Shǐ wǒ xīn dé ānwèi
初信之时，何等宝贵
Chū xìn zhī shí, héděng bǎoguì
恩典何其丰沛
Ēndiǎn héqí fēngpèi

verses.label: 第三节
verses.text:
我身疲乏，前途艰险
Wǒ shēn pífá, qiántú jiān xiǎn
主恩保守扶持
Zhǔ ēn bǎoshǒu fúchí
此身行路，经过万苦
Cǐ shēn xínglù, jīngguò wàn kǔ
恩典引我回归
Ēndiǎn yǐn wǒ huí guī

verses.label: 第四节
verses.text:
将来见主，面对面时
Jiānglái jiàn zhǔ, miànduì miàn shí
颂赞声不绝止
Sòng zàn shēng bù jué zhǐ
在那荣耀，永恒国度
Zài nà róngyào, yǒnghéng guódù
永远赞美主名
Yǒngyuǎn zànměi zhǔ míng

songs.title: 耶稣爱我 (Yēsū Ài Wǒ)
songs.author: 安娜·华纳 Anna Warner, 1859; tr. traditional

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
耶稣爱我，我知道
Yēsū ài wǒ, wǒ zhīdào
因为圣经这样说
Yīnwèi shèngjīng zhèyàng shuō
凡小孩子都属祂
Fán xiǎo háizi dōu shǔ Tā
软弱者祂能保护
Ruǎnruò zhě Tā néng bǎohù

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
耶稣爱我，祂曾死
Yēsū ài wǒ, Tā céng sǐ
洗净我一切罪污
Xǐ jìng wǒ yīqiè zuì wū
天堂之门祂开了
Tiāntáng zhī mén Tā kāi le
接我进入荣耀处
Jiē wǒ jìnrù róngyào chù

chorus.label: 副歌
chorus.text:
我主爱我，我主爱我
Wǒ zhǔ ài wǒ, wǒ zhǔ ài wǒ
我主爱我，圣经这样说
Wǒ zhǔ ài wǒ, shèngjīng zhèyàng shuō

songs.title: 圣哉圣哉圣哉 (Shèng Zāi Shèng Zāi)
songs.author: 赖纳德·赫伯 Reginald Heber, 1826; tr. traditional

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
圣哉，圣哉，圣哉
Shèng zāi, shèng zāi, shèng zāi
全能上主，清晨早起
Quánnéng shàngzhǔ, qīngchén zǎo qǐ
我们来把颂赞归于祢
Wǒmen lái bǎ sòng zàn guīyú nǐ
三位一体，同尊同荣
Sān wèi yī tǐ, tóng zūn tóng róng

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
圣哉，圣哉，圣哉
Shèng zāi, shèng zāi, shèng zāi
众天使俯伏在主前
Zhòng tiānshǐ fǔfú zài zhǔ qián
将他们的冠冕投在宝座前
Jiāng tāmen de guānmiǎn tóu zài bǎozuò qián
颂扬那昔在今在永在的主
Sòng yáng nà xī zài jīn zài yǒng zài de zhǔ

verses.label: 第三节
verses.text:
圣哉，圣哉，圣哉
Shèng zāi, shèng zāi, shèng zāi
黑暗或罪恶不能遮蔽祢
Hēiàn huò zuìè bùnéng zhēbì nǐ
唯有祢是圣洁，唯有祢是全能
Wéiyǒu nǐ shì shèngjié, wéiyǒu nǐ shì quánnéng
慈爱大能，三位一体真神
Cíài dànéng, sān wèi yī tǐ zhēn shén

songs.title: 主是我牧者 (Zhǔ Shì Wǒ Mùzhě)
songs.author: 基于诗篇23篇 Based on Psalm 23, traditional

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
主是我牧者，我必不缺乏
Zhǔ shì wǒ mùzhě, wǒ bì bù quēfá
祂使我躺卧在青草地上
Tā shǐ wǒ tǎngwò zài qīngcǎo dì shàng
领我到可安歇的水边
Lǐng wǒ dào kě ān xiē de shuǐ biān
祂使我的灵魂苏醒
Tā shǐ wǒ de línghún sūxǐng

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
我虽然行过死荫的幽谷
Wǒ suīrán xíngguò sǐ yīn de yōu gǔ
也不怕遭害
Yě bù pà zāo hài
因为祢与我同在
Yīnwèi nǐ yǔ wǒ tóng zài
祢的杖，祢的竿，都安慰我
Nǐ de zhàng, nǐ de gǎn, dōu ānwèi wǒ

verses.label: 第三节
verses.text:
我一生一世必有恩惠慈爱
Wǒ yīshēng yīshì bì yǒu ēnhuì cíài
随着我
Suí zhe wǒ
我且要住在主的殿中
Wǒ qiě yào zhù zài zhǔ de diàn zhōng
Zhí dào yǒngyuǎn
直到永远

songs.title: 万古磐石 (Wàngǔ Pánshí)
songs.author: 奥古斯都·托普拉迪 Augustus Toplady, 1776; tr. traditional

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
万古磐石，为我辟开
Wàngǔ pánshí, wèi wǒ pì kāi
让我藏入磐石里面
Ràng wǒ cáng rù pánshí lǐmiàn
让那水和血
Ràng nà shuǐ hé xuè
从祢肋旁流出
Cóng nǐ lèi páng liúchū
洗我罪，使我心洁
Xǐ wǒ zuì, shǐ wǒ xīn jié

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
手中无善可献你
Shǒu zhōng wú shàn kě xiàn nǐ
只能紧抱十字架
Zhǐ néng jǐn bào shízìjià
赤身、来祢处求衣
Chì shēn, lái nǐ chù qiú yī
Wú zhù lái kào ēn diǎn
无助、来靠恩典
Láng bài qiú nǐ cí bēi
污秽、来向泉洗
Wūhuì, lái xiàng quán xǐ

verses.label: 第三节
verses.text:
主啊，当我气断身亡
Zhǔ ā, dāng wǒ qì duàn shēn wáng
主啊，当我升往天堂
Zhǔ ā, dāng wǒ shēng wǎng tiāntáng
见祢宝座审判之前
Jiàn nǐ bǎozuò shěnpàn zhī qián
万古磐石，收纳我心
Wàngǔ pánshí, shōunà wǒ xīn

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
感谢主，感谢主
Gǎnxiè zhǔ, gǎnxiè zhǔ
感谢祢的慈爱与怜悯
Gǎnxiè nǐ de cíài yǔ liánmǐn
感谢主，感谢主
Gǎnxiè zhǔ, gǎnxiè zhǔ
祢的恩典每日都更新
Nǐ de ēndiǎn měi rì dōu gēngxīn

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
赞美主，赞美主
Zànměi zhǔ, zànměi zhǔ
赞美祢在万民中的荣耀
Zànměi nǐ zài wànmín zhōng de róngyào
赞美主，赞美主
Zànměi zhǔ, zànměi zhǔ
永永远远颂扬祢圣名
Yǒng yǒngyuǎn yuǎn sòng yáng nǐ shèng míng

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
哈利路亚，赞美主
Hālìlùyà, zànměi zhǔ
哈利路亚，赞美主
Hālìlùyà, zànměi zhǔ
哈利路亚，赞美主
Hālìlùyà, zànměi zhǔ
哈利路亚，阿们
Hālìlùyà, āmen

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
诸天述说神的荣耀
Zhū tiān shùshuō shén de róngyào
穹苍传扬祂手所做的
Qióng cāng chuányáng Tā shǒu suǒ zuò de
我们举起圣洁的手
Wǒmen jǔqǐ shèngjié de shǒu
赞美祂的名直到永远
Zànměi Tā de míng zhídào yǒngyuǎn

songs.title: 信靠耶稣 (Xìn Kào Yēsū)
songs.author: 约翰·萨蒙迪 John Sammis, 1887; tr. traditional

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
当我们行走，跟随耶稣
Dāng wǒmen xíngzǒu, gēnsuí Yēsū
走在祂光明的道路上
Zǒu zài Tā guāngmíng de dàolù shàng
欢乐充满我们的心
Huānlè chōngmǎn wǒmen de xīn
信靠服从，别无他路
Xìn kào fúcóng, bié wú tā lù

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
不要疑惑，不要惧怕
Bùyào yíhuò, bùyào jùpà
只要信靠祂的话语
Zhǐyào xìn kào Tā de huàyǔ
祂必引领我们前行
Tā bì yǐn lǐng wǒmen qián xíng
信靠服从，一生欢欣
Xìn kào fúcóng, yīshēng huānxīn

chorus.label: 副歌
chorus.text:
信靠顺服，别无他路
Xìn kào shùnfú, bié wú tā lù
得主喜悦与保护
Dé zhǔ xǐyuè yǔ bǎohù
信靠顺服，方能喜乐
Xìn kào shùnfú, fāng néng xǐlè
走在主耶稣道上
Zǒu zài zhǔ Yēsū dào shàng

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Knocking, knocking, who is there?
Waiting, waiting, oh how fair!
Tis a Pilgrim, strange and kingly,
Never such was seen before;
Ah, my soul, for such a wonder
Wilt thou not undo the door?

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Knocking, knocking, still He's there!
Waiting, waiting, wondrous fair!
But the door is hard to open,
For the weeds and ivy-vine,
With their dark and clinging tendrils,
Ever round the hinges twine.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Knocking, knocking, what! still there?
Waiting, waiting, grand and fair!
Yes, the pierced hand still knocketh,
And beneath the crownèd hair
Glow the patient eyes, so tender,
Of thy Savior waiting there.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Time is filled with swift transition,
Naught of earth unmoved can stand;
Build your hopes on things eternal,
Hold to God's unchanging hand.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Trust in Him who will not leave you,
Whatsoever years may bring;
If by earthly friends forsaken
Still more closely to Him cling.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Covet not this world's vain riches
That so rapidly decay,
Seek to gain the heav'nly treasures,
They will never pass away.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
When your journey is completed,
If to God you have been true,
Fair and bright the home in glory
Your enraptured soul will view.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Hold to God's unchanging hand,
Hold to God's unchanging hand;
Build your hopes on things eternal,
Hold to God's unchanging hand.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Jesus wants me for a sunbeam,
To shine for Him each day;
In every way try to please Him,
At home, at school, at play.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Jesus wants me to be loving,
And kind to all I see;
Showing how pleasant and happy
His little one can be.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I will ask Jesus to help me
To keep my heart from sin,
Ever reflecting His goodness,
And always shine for Him.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
A sunbeam, a sunbeam,
Jesus wants me for a sunbeam;
A sunbeam, a sunbeam,
I'll be a sunbeam for Him.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
There is a fountain filled with blood
Drawn from Immanuel's veins;
And sinners plunged beneath that flood
Lose all their guilty stains.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
The dying thief rejoiced to see
That fountain in his day;
And there have I, though vile as he,
Washed all my sins away.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Dear dying Lamb, Thy precious blood
Shall never lose its power
Till all the ransomed church of God
Be saved to sin no more.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
E'er since by faith I saw the stream
Thy flowing wounds supply,
Redeeming love has been my theme
And shall be till I die.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Lift every voice and sing,
Till earth and heaven ring,
Ring with the harmonies of liberty;
Let our rejoicing rise
High as the listening skies,
Let it resound loud as the rolling sea.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Stony the road we trod,
Bitter the chastening rod,
Felt in the days when hope unborn had died;
Yet with a steady beat,
Have not our weary feet
Come to the place for which our fathers sighed?

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
God of our weary years,
God of our silent tears,
Thou who has brought us thus far on the way;
Thou who has by Thy might
Led us into the light,
Keep us forever in the path, we pray.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Master, the tempest is raging!
The billows are tossing high!
The sky is o'ershadowed with blackness,
No shelter or help is nigh;
Carest Thou not that we perish?
How canst Thou lie asleep
When each moment so madly is threatening
A grave in the angry deep?

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
The winds and the waves shall obey My will,
Peace, be still!
Whether the wrath of the storm-tossed sea,
Or demons or men, or whatever it be,
No waters can swallow the ship where lies
The Master of ocean and earth and skies;
They all shall sweetly obey My will:
Peace, peace, be still!

songs.title: I Bless the Christ of God
songs.author: Horatius Bonar, 1855

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
His cross dispels each doubt;
I bury in His tomb
Each thought of unbelief and fear,
Each lingering shade of gloom.

verses.label: Verse 3

songs.title: I Will Sing the Wondrous Story
songs.author: Francis H. Rowley, 1886

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I will sing the wondrous story
Of the Christ who died for me,
How He left His home in glory
For the cross on Calvary.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I was lost but Jesus found me,
Found the sheep that went astray,
Threw His loving arms around me,
Drew me back into His way.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Days of darkness still come o'er me,
Sorrow's paths I often tread;
But His presence still is with me,
By His guiding hand I'm led.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
He will keep me till the river
Rolls its waters at my feet;
Then He'll bear me safely over,
Where the loved ones I shall meet.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Yes, I'll sing the wondrous story
Of the Christ who died for me,
Sing it with the saints in glory,
Gathered by the crystal sea.

songs.title: O Love That Will Not Let Me Go
songs.author: George Matheson, 1882

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O Love that will not let me go,
I rest my weary soul in Thee;
I give Thee back the life I owe,
That in Thine ocean depths its flow
May richer, fuller be.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
O Light that foll'west all my way,
I yield my flick'ring torch to Thee;
My heart restores its borrowed ray,
That in Thy sunshine's blaze its day
May brighter, fairer be.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O Joy that seekest me through pain,
I cannot close my heart to Thee;
I trace the rainbow through the rain,
And feel the promise is not vain
That morn shall tearless be.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
O Cross that liftest up my head,
I dare not ask to fly from Thee;
I lay in dust life's glory dead,
And from the ground there blossoms red
Life that shall endless be.

songs.title: Open the Eyes of My Heart
songs.author: Based on Ephesians 1:18, traditional

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Open the eyes of my heart, Lord,
Open the eyes of my heart;
I want to see You,
I want to see You.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
To see You high and lifted up,
Shining in the light of Your glory;
Pour out Your power and love
As we sing holy, holy, holy.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Holy, holy, holy,
Holy, holy, holy,
Holy, holy, holy,
I want to see You.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Faith of our fathers, living still
In spite of dungeon, fire, and sword;
O how our hearts beat high with joy
Whene'er we hear that glorious Word!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Our fathers, chained in prisons dark,
Were still in heart and conscience free;
How sweet would be their children's fate
If they, like them, could die for thee!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Faith of our fathers, we will love
Both friend and foe in all our strife;
And preach thee, too, as love knows how,
By kindly words and virtuous life.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Faith of our fathers, holy faith!
We will be true to thee till death.

songs.title: Sweet Peace the Gift of God's Love
songs.author: Peter P. Bilhorn, 1888

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
There comes to my heart one sweet strain,
A glad and a joyous refrain;
I sing it again and again—
