Sweet peace, the gift of God's love.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Through Christ on the cross peace was made,
My debt by His death was all paid;
No other foundation is laid
For peace, the gift of God's love.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
When Jesus as Lord I had crowned,
My heart with this peace did abound;
In Him the rich blessing I found—
Sweet peace, the gift of God's love.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Peace, peace, sweet peace!
Wonderful gift from above!
Oh, wonderful, wonderful peace!
Sweet peace, the gift of God's love!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Zion stands with hills surrounded,
Zion, kept by power divine;
All her foes shall be confounded,
Though the world in arms combine.
Happy Zion, happy Zion,
What a favored lot is thine!

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
Estrofa 1
verses.text:
Dios de promesas, fiel es tu Palabra,
todo lo que dices Tú lo cumplirás;
en el tiempo bueno o en la tribulación,
tu promesa es mi sustento y mi canción.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
Cuando el camino se pone oscuro y duro,
cuando el corazón ya no puede más;
aferro mi alma a tu fiel promesa,
que nunca me dejarás ni me desampararás.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
Así que marcho con fe y esperanza,
sabiendo que Tú estás a mi favor;
cada promesa es segura en Cristo Jesús,
Amén y Amén, gloria a Dios mi Señor.

chorus.label: Coro
chorus.text:
Fiel es Dios, fiel es Dios,
fiel en todas sus promesas es;
fiel es Dios, fiel es Dios,
hoy, mañana y siempre fiel será.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Gëzimi im është Jezusi
Jesus is my joy
Zoti im dhe Shpëtimtari im
My Lord and my Savior
Në Të besoj me gjithë zemrën
In You I trust with all my heart
Je gjithçka për mua
You are everything to me

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Lavdi Tij kudo në botë
Praise to Him everywhere in the world
Emri i Tij është mbi çdo emër
His name is above every name
Çdo gju do t'i bëhet qark
Every knee will bow before Him
Çdo gjuhë do të rrëfejë
Every tongue will confess

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Jezusi, Jezusi
Jesus, Jesus
Je Zoti im dhe gëzimi im
You are my Lord and my joy
Të lavdëroj përjetë
I will praise You forever
Jezusi, Jezusi
Jesus, Jesus

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Falënderoj Perëndinë
I thank God
Për dashurinë e Tij të madhe
For His great love
Për Birin e Tij të dhënë
For His Son given
Që mua sot shpëtoi
Who saved me today

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Falënderoj për çdo ditë
I thank for every day
Që jeton dhe mbush me gëzim
That He fills with joy
Për Frymën e Shenjtë brenda
For the Holy Spirit within
Që udhëheq rrugën time
Who guides my way

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Falënderoj, falënderoj
I thank, I thank
Perëndinë çdo ditë
God every day
Falënderoj, lavdëroj
I thank, I praise
Emrin e Tij të shenjtë
His holy name

songs.title: 主耶稣是好牧人 (Zhǔ Yēsū Shì Hǎo Mùrén)
songs.author: 中文传统 Chinese traditional

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
主耶稣是好牧人
Zhǔ Yēsū shì hǎo mùrén
祂为羊舍命
Tā wèi yáng shě mìng
我是祂羊群中的一只
Wǒ shì Tā yáng qún zhōng de yī zhī
祂认识我的声音
Tā rènshi wǒ de shēngyīn

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
好牧人引我走义路
Hǎo mùrén yǐn wǒ zǒu yì lù
为祂名的缘故
Wèi Tā míng de yuángù
我虽行过死荫幽谷
Wǒ suī xíngguò sǐ yīn yōu gǔ
祂与我同在不缺乏
Tā yǔ wǒ tóng zài bù quēfá

chorus.label: 副歌
chorus.text:
哈利路亚，赞美主
Hālìlùyà, zànměi zhǔ
好牧人爱护我
Hǎo mùrén àihù wǒ
哈利路亚，跟随祂
Hālìlùyà, gēnsuí Tā
直到永永远远
Zhídào yǒng yǒngyuǎn yuǎn

songs.title: 我主是活的 (Wǒ Zhǔ Shì Huó De)
songs.author: 中文传统 Chinese traditional

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
耶稣从死里复活
Yēsū cóng sǐ lǐ fùhuó
胜过死亡与坟墓
Shèngguò sǐwáng yǔ fénmù
祂是首先复活的
Tā shì shǒuxiān fùhuó de
也是末后得荣耀的
Yě shì mò hòu dé róngyào de

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
因祂活着我也活
Yīn Tā huózhe wǒ yě huó
有盼望有永生
Yǒu pànwàng yǒu yǒngshēng
死亡啊你的刺在哪里
Sǐwáng a nǐ de cì zài nǎlǐ
阴间啊你的胜利在哪里
Yīnjiān a nǐ de shènglì zài nǎlǐ

chorus.label: 副歌
chorus.text:
我主是活的
Wǒ zhǔ shì huó de
复活的救主
Fùhuó de jiùzhǔ
哈利路亚，哈利路亚
Hālìlùyà, hālìlùyà
我主活到永远
Wǒ zhǔ huó dào yǒngyuǎn

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Praise the Savior, ye who know Him!
Who can tell how much we owe Him?
Gladly let us render to Him
All we are and have.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Jesus is the name that charms us,
He for conflict fits and arms us;
Nothing moves and nothing harms us
While we trust in Him.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Trust in Him, ye saints, forever,
He is faithful, changing never;
Neither force nor guile can sever
Those He loves from Him.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Keep us, Lord, oh keep us cleaving
To Thyself, and still believing,
Till the hour of our receiving
Promised joys with Thee.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Come, Thou long-expected Jesus,
Born to set Thy people free;
From our fears and sins release us,
Let us find our rest in Thee.
Israel's strength and consolation,
Hope of all the earth Thou art;
Dear desire of every nation,
Joy of every longing heart.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Born Thy people to deliver,
Born a child, and yet a king;
Born to reign in us forever,
Now Thy gracious kingdom bring.
By Thine own eternal Spirit
Rule in all our hearts alone;
By Thine all-sufficient merit
Raise us to Thy glorious throne.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I am so happy in Christ today
That I go singing along my way;
Yes, I am happy since Jesus came,
I'll praise the glory of His name.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Wondrous it is how He came to me,
Opened my eyes so that I could see;
Showed me my sins now washed away,
Showing His grace from day to day.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Happy in Jesus and glad within,
Free from the power and guilt of sin;
Waiting the day when I too shall come
Into that bright and glorious home.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
He included me, He included me,
When the Lord said whosoever, He included me;
He included me, He included me,
When the Lord said whosoever, He included me.

songs.title: There Is Sunshine in My Soul
songs.author: Eliza E. Hewitt, 1887

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
There is sunshine in my soul today,
More glorious and bright
Than glows in any earthly sky,
For Jesus is my light.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
There is music in my soul today,
A carol to my King;
And Jesus, listening, can hear
The songs I cannot sing.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
There is springtime in my soul today,
For when the Lord is near,
The dove of peace sings in my heart,
The flowers of grace appear.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
There is gladness in my soul today,
And hope and praise and love;
For blessings which He gives me now,
For joys laid up above.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
O there's sunshine, blessed sunshine,
When the peaceful happy moments roll;
When Jesus shows His smiling face,
There is sunshine in my soul.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Jesus! what a Friend for sinners!
Jesus! Lover of my soul;
Friends may fail me, foes assail me,
He, my Savior, makes me whole.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Jesus! what a strength in weakness!
Let me hide myself in Him;
Tempted, tried, and sometimes failing,
He, my strength, my vict'ry wins.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Jesus! what a help in sorrow!
While the billows o'er me roll;
Even when my heart is breaking,
He, my comfort, helps my soul.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Jesus! I do now receive Him,
More than all in Him I find;
He hath granted me forgiveness,
I am His, and He is mine.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Hallelujah! what a Savior!
Hallelujah! what a Friend!
Saving, helping, keeping, loving,
He is with me to the end.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Does Jesus care when my heart is pained
Too deeply for mirth or song;
As the burdens press, and the cares distress,
And the way grows weary and long?

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Does Jesus care when my way is dark
With a nameless dread and fear?
As the daylight fades into deep night shades,
Does He care enough to be near?

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Does Jesus care when I've tried and failed
To resist some temptation strong;
When for my deep grief I find no relief,
Though my tears flow all the night long?

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Does Jesus care when I've said goodbye
To the dearest on earth to me,
And my sad heart aches till it nearly breaks,
Is it ought to Him? Does He see?

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
O yes, He cares—I know He cares!
His heart is touched with my grief;
When the days are weary, the long nights dreary,
I know my Savior cares.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
Saved to the uttermost! Cheerfully I sing
Praises to Jesus, my Savior and King;
He who so wondrously saved my poor soul
Cleansed and made whole by the blood that He gave.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Saved to the uttermost! This is my song,
All the day long and at night I will raise
Songs of thanksgiving and joyful refrain,
Saved, yes, saved to the uttermost.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Saved to the uttermost!
Saved to the uttermost!
Saved, saved, saved,
Saved to the uttermost!

songs.title: Since Jesus Came into My Heart
songs.author: Rufus H. McDaniel, 1914

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
What a wonderful change in my life has been wrought
Since Jesus came into my heart!
I have light in my soul for which long I had sought,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I have ceased from my wand'ring and going astray,
Since Jesus came into my heart!
And my sins which were many are all washed away,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I shall go there to dwell in that City, I know,
Since Jesus came into my heart!
And I'm happy, so happy, as onward I go,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Since Jesus came into my heart!
Since Jesus came into my heart!
Floods of joy o'er my soul
Like the sea billows roll,
Since Jesus came into my heart.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
When all my labors and trials are o'er,
And I am safe on that beautiful shore,
Just to be near the dear Lord I adore
Will through the ages be glory for me.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
When by the gift of His infinite grace
I am accorded in heaven a place,
Just to be there and to look on His face
Will through the ages be glory for me.

verses.label: Verse 3

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
O that will be glory for me,
Glory for me, glory for me;
When by His grace I shall look on His face,
That will be glory, be glory for me!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Jesus shall reign where'er the sun
Does his successive journeys run;
His kingdom spread from shore to shore,
Till moons shall wax and wane no more.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
From north to south the princes meet
To pay their homage at His feet;
While western empires own their Lord,
And savage tribes attend His Word.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
To Him shall endless prayer be made,
And praises throng to crown His head;
His name like sweet perfume shall rise
With every morning sacrifice.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
People and realms of every tongue
Dwell on His love with sweetest song,
And infant voices shall proclaim
Their early blessings on His name.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Worthy of praise is Christ our Redeemer,
Worthy of glory, honor and power;
Worthy of all our soul's adoration,
Worthy of praise each day and each hour.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Worthy of love is Christ our Redeemer,
Worthy of all the gifts that we bring;
Worthy the Lord of earth and of heaven,
Worthy of praise, eternal our King.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Worthy of trust is Christ our Redeemer,
Worthy the name of Jesus, the Lord;
Worthy to reign forever and ever,
Worthy our praise through death and the sword.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I am so glad that our Father in heaven
Tells of His love in the Book He has given;
Wonderful things in the Bible I see,
This is the dearest, that Jesus loves me.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Though I forget Him and wander away,
Still He doth love me wherever I stray;
Back to His dear loving arms would I flee,
When I remember that Jesus loves me.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O if there's only one song I can sing,
When in His beauty I see the great King,
This shall my song in eternity be:
O what a wonder that Jesus loves me!

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves me, Jesus loves me;
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves even me.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Shout, shout aloud for Jesus,
Sing aloud, sing aloud for Jesus;
Shout, shout aloud for Jesus,
He saves, He saves today.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Led by the Master's hand,
All the way, all the way;
Safe in this glorious land,
All the way, all the way;
Following where He leads,
He supplies all my needs,
Jesus my Savior indeed,
All the way.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Led through the valley deep,
All the way, all the way;
He never fails to keep,
All the way, all the way;
Though storms around me blow,
Through the deepest woe,
Still His love overflows,
All the way.

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
Dios es amor, Dios es amor,
cantemos todos con fervor;
su amor eterno nos salvó,
Dios es amor, Dios es amor.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
En la cruz su amor mostró,
cuando Jesucristo allí murió;
con su sangre nos redimió,
Dios es amor, Dios es amor.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
Día y noche canta el corazón,
de Su gracia y gran salvación;
no hay en el mundo otro igual,
Dios es amor eterno y leal.

chorus.label: Coro
chorus.text:
¡Dios es amor!
¡Dios es amor!
¡Aleluya, gloria a Dios!
¡Dios es amor!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Ngjisemi lart te Perëndia
We ascend on high to God
Me zemra të pastra dhe të drejta
With hearts that are pure and upright
Në praninë e Tij të shenjtë
In His holy presence
Këndojmë lavdinë e Tij
We sing His glory

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Zoti është i madh dhe i lartë
The Lord is great and exalted
Në shenjtëri dhe madhështi
In holiness and majesty
Adhurojmë Ty, Perëndisë
We worship You, O God
Me gëzim dhe me lavdërim
With joy and with praise

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Lart, lart te Perëndia
Up, up to God
Këndojmë lavdinë e Tij
We sing His glory
Lart, lart te Perëndia
Up, up to God
Përjetë dhe gjithmonë
Forever and always

songs.title: 主啊我爱你 (Zhǔ Ā Wǒ Ài Nǐ)
songs.author: 中文传统 Chinese traditional
songs.scripture: 约翰福音 21:17; 马太福音 22:37

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
主啊我爱你，我爱你
Zhǔ ā wǒ ài nǐ, wǒ ài nǐ
用我的全心全意
Yòng wǒ de quán xīn quán yì
主啊我爱你，我爱你
Zhǔ ā wǒ ài nǐ, wǒ ài nǐ
直到永远永永远
Zhídào yǒngyuǎn yǒng yǒngyuǎn

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
主啊我跟你，我跟你
Zhǔ ā wǒ gēn nǐ, wǒ gēn nǐ
走那窄路和险径
Zǒu nà zhǎi lù hé xiǎn jìng
主啊我信你，我信你
Zhǔ ā wǒ xìn nǐ, wǒ xìn nǐ
你的话语是真实
Nǐ de huàyǔ shì zhēnshí

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
赞美主名，赞美主名
Zànměi zhǔ míng, zànměi zhǔ míng
赞美那配得颂赞的主
Zànměi nà pèi dé sòng zàn de zhǔ
从日出到日落之处
Cóng rì chū dào rì luò zhī chù
祂的名当受称颂
Tā de míng dāng shòu chēng sòng

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
我要赞美祢，我要颂扬祢
Wǒ yào zànměi nǐ, wǒ yào sòng yáng nǐ
直到永永远远
Zhídào yǒng yǒngyuǎn yuǎn
以我的全心全意
Yǐ wǒ de quán xīn quán yì
尊崇祢的圣名
Zūnchóng nǐ de shèng míng

chorus.label: 副歌
chorus.text:
赞美主，赞美主
Zànměi zhǔ, zànměi zhǔ
大声赞美祂
Dàshēng zànměi Tā
赞美主，赞美主
Zànměi zhǔ, zànměi zhǔ
永远荣耀归于祂
Yǒngyuǎn róngyào guīyú Tā

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
All this day Thy hand has led me,
And I thank Thee for Thy care;
Thou hast warmed me, clothed and fed me,
Listen to my evening prayer.

verses.label: Verse 3
Verse 1
verses.text:
Thou, my everlasting portion,
More than friend or life to me;
All along my pilgrim journey,
Savior, let me walk with Thee.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Not for ease or worldly pleasure,
Nor for fame my prayer shall be;
Gladly will I toil and suffer,
Only let me walk with Thee.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Lead me through the vale of shadows,
Bear me o'er life's fitful sea;
Then the gate of life eternal
May I enter, Lord, with Thee.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Close to Thee, close to Thee,
Close to Thee, close to Thee;
All along my pilgrim journey,
Savior, let me walk with Thee.

songs.title: Come Ye Sinners Poor and Needy
songs.author: Joseph Hart, 1759

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Come, ye sinners, poor and needy,
Weak and wounded, sick and sore;
Jesus ready stands to save you,
Full of pity, love, and power.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Come, ye thirsty, come, and welcome,
God's free bounty glorify;
True belief and true repentance,
Every grace that brings you nigh.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Come, ye weary, heavy-laden,
Bruised and mangled by the fall;
If you tarry till you're better,
You will never come at all.

verses.label: Verse 4

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I will arise and go to Jesus,
He will embrace me in His arms;
In the arms of my dear Savior,
O there are ten thousand charms.

songs.title: My Soul Be on Thy Guard
songs.author: George Heath, 1781

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
Ne'er think the vict'ry won,
Nor lay thine armor down;
Thine arduous work will not be done
Till thou obtain thy crown.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Fight on, my soul, till death
Shall bring thee to thy God;
He'll take thee, at thy parting breath,
To His divine abode.

songs.title: Awake My Soul and with the Sun
songs.author: Thomas Ken, 1695

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Awake, my soul, and with the sun
Thy daily stage of duty run;
Shake off dull sloth, and joyful rise
To pay thy morning sacrifice.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
Direct, control, suggest this day
All I design or do or say;
That all my powers, with all their might,
In Thy sole glory may unite.

songs.title: All People That on Earth Do Dwell
songs.author: William Kethe, 1561

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
All people that on earth do dwell,
Sing to the Lord with cheerful voice;
Him serve with mirth, His praise forth tell,
Come ye before Him and rejoice.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
O enter then His gates with praise,
Approach with joy His courts unto;
Praise, laud, and bless His name always,
For it is seemly so to do.

verses.label: Verse 4

songs.title: I Lay My Sins on Jesus
songs.author: Horatius Bonar, 1843

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I lay my sins on Jesus,
The spotless Lamb of God;
He bears them all and frees us
From the accursed load.
I bring my guilt to Jesus,
To wash my crimson stains
White in His blood most precious,
Till not a stain remains.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
I long to be like Jesus,
Meek, loving, lowly, mild;
I long to be like Jesus,
The Father's holy child.
I long to be with Jesus,
Amid the heav'nly throng,
To sing with saints His praises,
To learn the angels' song.

songs.title: Now Thank We All Our God
songs.author: Martin Rinkart, c.1636; tr. Catherine Winkworth

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Now thank we all our God
With heart and hands and voices,
Who wondrous things hath done,
In whom His world rejoices;
Who from our mothers' arms
Hath blessed us on our way
With countless gifts of love,
And still is ours today.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
O may this bounteous God
Through all our life be near us,
With ever-joyful hearts
And blessed peace to cheer us;
And keep us in His grace,
And guide us when perplexed,
And free us from all ills
In this world and the next.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
All praise and thanks to God
The Father now be given,
The Son, and Him who reigns
With them in highest heaven,
The one eternal God,
Whom earth and heaven adore;
For thus it was, is now,
And shall be evermore.

songs.title: Hark the Voice of Jesus Calling
songs.author: Daniel March, 1868

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Hark, the voice of Jesus calling,
Who will go and work today?
Fields are white and harvests waiting,
Who will bear the sheaves away?
Loud and long the Master calleth,
Rich reward He offers thee;
Who will answer, gladly saying,
Here am I, O Lord, send me?

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
If you cannot cross the ocean
And the heathen lands explore,
You can find the heathen nearer,
You can help them at your door;
If you cannot give your thousands,
You can give the widow's mite;
And the least you do for Jesus
Will be precious in His sight.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Let none hear you idly saying,
There is nothing I can do,
While the souls of men are dying
And the Master calls for you;
Take the task He gives you gladly,
Let His work your pleasure be;
Answer quickly when He calleth,
Here am I, O Lord, send me!

songs.title: I Heard the Voice of Jesus Say
songs.author: Horatius Bonar, 1846

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I heard the voice of Jesus say,
Come unto Me and rest;
Lay down, thou weary one, lay down
Thy head upon My breast.
I came to Jesus as I was,
Weary and worn and sad;
I found in Him a resting place,
And He has made me glad.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I heard the voice of Jesus say,
Behold, I freely give
The living water, thirsty one;
Stoop down and drink and live.
I came to Jesus and I drank
Of that life-giving stream;
My thirst was quenched, my soul revived,
And now I live in Him.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I heard the voice of Jesus say,
I am this dark world's Light;
Look unto Me, thy morn shall rise,
And all thy day be bright.
I looked to Jesus and I found
In Him my Star, my Sun;
And in that light of life I'll walk
Till trav'ling days are done.

songs.title: The King of Love My Shepherd Is
songs.author: Henry W. Baker, 1868

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
The King of love my Shepherd is,
Whose goodness faileth never;
I nothing lack if I am His
And He is mine forever.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Where streams of living water flow
My ransomed soul He leadeth,
And where the verdant pastures grow
With food celestial feedeth.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Perverse and foolish, oft I strayed,
But yet in love He sought me,
And on His shoulder gently laid,
And home, rejoicing, brought me.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
And so through all the length of days
Thy goodness faileth never;
Good Shepherd, may I sing Thy praise
Within Thy house forever.

songs.title: Christ for the World We Sing
songs.author: Samuel Wolcott, 1869

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Christ for the world we sing!
The world to Christ we bring
With loving zeal;
The poor and them that mourn,
The faint and overborne,
Sin-sick and sorrow-worn,
Whom Christ doth heal.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Christ for the world we sing!
The world to Christ we bring
With fervent prayer;
The wayward and the lost,
By restless passions tossed,
Redeemed at countless cost,
From dark despair.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Christ for the world we sing!
The world to Christ we bring
With one accord;
With us the work to share,
With us reproach to dare,
With us the cross to bear,
For Christ our Lord.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
God the Omnipotent! King who ordainest
Thunder Thy clarion, the lightning Thy sword;
Show forth Thy pity on high where Thou reignest:
Give to us peace in our time, O Lord.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
God the All-merciful! Earth hath forsaken
Thy ways all holy and slighted Thy word;
Bid not Thy wrath in its terrors awaken:
Give to us peace in our time, O Lord.

verses.label: Verse 3

songs.title: Praise My Soul the King of Heaven
songs.author: Henry F. Lyte, 1834

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
Praise Him for His grace and favor
To our fathers in distress;
Praise Him still the same as ever,
Slow to chide and swift to bless.
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Glorious in His faithfulness.

verses.label: Verse 3
Verse 4

songs.title: Angels from the Realms of Glory
songs.author: James Montgomery, 1816

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Angels from the realms of glory,
Wing your flight o'er all the earth;
Ye who sang creation's story,
Now proclaim Messiah's birth.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Shepherds in the field abiding,
Watching o'er your flocks by night,
God with man is now residing,
Yonder shines the infant light.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Sages, leave your contemplations,
Brighter visions beam afar;
Seek the great Desire of nations,
Ye have seen His natal star.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Saints before the altar bending,
Watching long in hope and fear,
Suddenly the Lord, descending,
In His temple shall appear.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Come and worship, come and worship,
Worship Christ the newborn King!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
While shepherds watched their flocks by night,
All seated on the ground,
The angel of the Lord came down,
And glory shone around.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Fear not, said he, for mighty dread
Had seized their troubled mind;
Glad tidings of great joy I bring
To you and all mankind.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
To you, in David's town this day,
Is born of David's line,
A Savior who is Christ the Lord,
And this shall be the sign.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Thus spake the seraph and forthwith
Appeared a shining throng
Of angels praising God, who thus
Addressed their joyful song.

verses.label: Verse 5
verses.text:
All glory be to God on high
And to the earth be peace;
Goodwill henceforth from heaven to men
Begin and never cease.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
What sweeter music can we bring
Than a carol for to sing
The birth of this our heav'nly King?
Awake the voice! Awake the string!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Dark and dull night, fly hence away,
And give the honor to this day,
That sees December turned to May,
If we may ask the reason, say:

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
The darling of the world is come,
And fit it is we find a room
To welcome Him. The nobler part
Of all the house here is the heart.

songs.title: Savior Again to Thy Dear Name
songs.author: John Ellerton, 1866

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Savior, again to Thy dear name we raise
With one accord our parting hymn of praise;
We stand to bless Thee ere our worship cease,
Then, lowly kneeling, wait Thy word of peace.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
verses.text:
Grant us Thy peace throughout our earthly life,
Our balm in sorrow and our stay in strife;
Then, when Thy voice shall bid our conflict cease,
Call us, O Lord, to Thine eternal peace.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Ten thousand times ten thousand
In sparkling raiment bright,
The armies of the ransomed saints
Throng up the steeps of light;
Tis finished, all is finished,
Their fight with death and sin;
Fling open wide the golden gates
And let the victors in.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
What rush of alleluias
Fills all the earth and sky!
What ringing of a thousand harps
Bespeaks the triumph nigh!
O day for which creation
And all its tribes were made;
O joy, for all its former woes
A thousand-fold repaid!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O then what raptured greetings
On Canaan's happy shore;
What knitting severed friendships up
Where partings are no more!
Then eyes with joy shall sparkle,
That brimmed with tears of late;
Orphans no longer fatherless,
Nor widows desolate.

songs.title: The Day Thou Gavest Lord Is Ended
songs.author: John Ellerton, 1870

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
The day Thou gavest, Lord, is ended,
The darkness falls at Thy behest;
To Thee our morning hymns ascended,
Thy praise shall sanctify our rest.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
We thank Thee that Thy church unsleeping,
While earth rolls onward into light,
Through all the world her watch is keeping,
And rests not now by day or night.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
As o'er each continent and island
The dawn leads on another day,
The voice of prayer is never silent,
Nor dies the strain of praise away.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
So be it, Lord; Thy throne shall never,
Like earth's proud empires, pass away;
Thy kingdom stands and grows forever,
Till all Thy creatures own Thy sway.

songs.title: Christ Who Knows All His Sheep
songs.author: Richard Baxter, 1681

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3

songs.title: There Is No Name So Sweet on Earth
songs.author: George W. Bethune, 1858

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
There is no name so sweet on earth,
No name so sweet in heaven,
The name, before His wondrous birth,
To Christ the Savior given.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
And when He hung upon the tree,
They wrote His name above Him,
That all might see the reason we
Forevermore must love Him.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
So now, upon His Father's throne,
Almighty to release us
From sin and pain, He ever reigns,
The Prince and Savior, Jesus.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
We love to sing of Christ our King,
And hail Him blessèd Jesus;
For there's no word ear ever heard
So dear, so sweet, as Jesus.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Hail to the Lord's Anointed,
Great David's greater Son!
Hail, in the time appointed,
His reign on earth begun!
He comes to break oppression,
To set the captive free,
To take away transgression
And rule in equity.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
He comes with succor speedy
To those who suffer wrong,
To help the poor and needy,
And bid the weak be strong;
To give them songs for sighing,
Their darkness turn to light,
Whose souls, condemned and dying,
Were precious in His sight.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Kings shall bow down before Him,
And gold and incense bring;
All nations shall adore Him,
His praise all people sing;
To Him shall prayer unceasing
And daily vows ascend,
His kingdom still increasing,
A kingdom without end.

songs.title: Ye Holy Angels Bright
songs.author: Richard Baxter, 1681; rev. John Hampden Gurney

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Ye holy angels bright,
Who wait at God's right hand,
Or through the realms of light
Fly at your Lord's command,
Assist our song,
For else the theme
Too high doth seem
For mortal tongue.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Ye blessed souls at rest,
Who ran this earthly race,
And now, from sin released,
Behold the Savior's face,
His praises sound,
As in His light,
With sweet delight
Ye do abound.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
My soul bear thou thy part,
Triumph in God above;
And with a well-tuned heart
Sing thou the songs of love;
Let all thy days
Till life shall end,
Whate'er He send,
Be filled with praise.

songs.title: O Bless the Lord My Soul
songs.author: James Montgomery, 1819

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O bless the Lord, my soul!
His grace to thee proclaim!
And all that is within me join
To bless His holy name!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
O bless the Lord, my soul!
His mercies bear in mind!
Forget not all His benefits!
The Lord to thee is kind.

verses.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
verses.text:
High as the heav'ns above
This earth His mercies tower;
His grace, on all who fear His name,
Grows every hour.

songs.title: Lord of All Being Throned Afar
songs.author: Oliver Wendell Holmes, 1848

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Lord of all being, throned afar,
Thy glory flames from sun and star;
Center and soul of every sphere,
Yet to each loving heart how near!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Sun of our life, Thy quickening ray
Sheds on our path the glow of day;
Star of our hope, Thy softened light
Cheers the long watches of the night.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Lord of all life, below, above,
Whose light is truth, whose warmth is love,
Before Thy ever-blazing throne
We ask no luster of our own.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Grant us Thy truth to make us free,
And kindling hearts that burn for Thee,
Till all Thy living altars claim
One holy light, one heavenly flame.

songs.title: There Is a Land of Pure Delight
songs.author: Isaac Watts, 1707

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
There is a land of pure delight,
Where saints immortal reign;
Infinite day excludes the night,
And pleasures banish pain.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
There everlasting spring abides,
And never-withering flowers;
Death, like a narrow sea, divides
This heavenly land from ours.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Sweet fields beyond the swelling flood
Stand dressed in living green;
So to the Jews old Canaan stood
While Jordan rolled between.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Could we but climb where Moses stood
And view the landscape o'er,
Not Jordan's stream nor death's cold flood
Should fright us from the shore.

songs.title: The Head That Once Was Crowned
songs.author: Thomas Kelly, 1820

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
The head that once was crowned with thorns
Is crowned with glory now;
A royal diadem adorns
The mighty Victor's brow.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
The highest place that heaven affords
Is His, is His by right;
The King of kings and Lord of lords,
And heaven's eternal Light.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
The joy of all who dwell above,
The joy of all below,
To whom He manifests His love,
And grants His name to know.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
To them the cross, with all its shame,
With all its grace, is given;
Their name an everlasting name,
Their joy the joy of heaven.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Hosanna, loud hosanna,
The little children sang;
Through pillared court and temple
The lovely anthem rang;
To Jesus, who had blessed them
Close folded to His breast,
The children sang their praises,
The simplest and the best.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
From Olivet they followed
Mid an exultant crowd,
The victor palm branch waving,
And chanting clear and loud;
The Lord of earth and heaven
Rode on in lowly state,
Nor scorned that little children
Should on His bidding wait.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Hosanna in the highest!
That ancient song we sing,
For Christ is our Redeemer,
The Lord of heaven our King;
O may we ever praise Him
With heart and life and voice,
And in His blissful presence
Eternally rejoice!

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
Cuando el Señor venga por los suyos,
cuando El aparezca en las nubes;
con gran poder y gloria vendrá,
y los redimidos con Él estarán.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
Los que durmieron resucitarán,
y los que viven serán transformados;
juntos con Cristo siempre vivirán,
en esa morada que Él preparó.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
¡Qué gloria inmensa cuando Él llegue!
¡Qué alegría ver Su rostro amado!
Con cánticos de gozo Le recibiremos,
Aleluya, gloria al Señor.

chorus.label: Coro
chorus.text:
¡Ven, Señor Jesús, pronto ven!
¡Tu pueblo Te espera con amor!
¡Ven, Señor Jesús, pronto ven!
¡Maranata, ven Señor!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Zgjohuni, o Krishterë, ditët kanë ardhur
Awake, O Christians, the days have come
Koha e shpëtimit shumë afër është
The time of salvation is very near
Ngrihuni dhe ndriçoni me dritën e Krishtit
Rise up and shine with the light of Christ
Se gloria e Tij mbi ju ka lindur
For His glory has risen upon you

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Mos fjetur, mos lodhet, por punoni me zell
Do not sleep, do not tire, but work with zeal
Sepse dita shpëtimit është afër shumë
For the day of salvation draws very near
Krishtit i besoni me gjithë zemrën tuaj
Trust in Christ with all your heart
Dhe Ai do t'ju çojë deri në fund
And He will lead you to the very end

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Zgjohuni, zgjohuni
Awake, awake
Krishterë me besë
Christians with faith
Koha është afër
The time is near
Lavdërojeni Krishtin
Praise Christ

songs.title: 生命圣道 (Shēngmìng Shèngdào)
songs.author: 中文传统 Chinese traditional
songs.scripture: 约翰福音 6:63; 约翰福音 1:1

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
生命的道路在神的话语中
Shēngmìng de dàolù zài shén de huàyǔ zhōng
光明与真理在祂的话语里
Guāngmíng yǔ zhēnlǐ zài Tā de huàyǔ lǐ
每天读神圣洁的话
Měitiān dú shén shèngjié de huà
心灵得滋养得力量
Xīnlíng dé zīyǎng dé lìliàng

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
神的话语是灯照亮我脚步
Shén de huàyǔ shì dēng zhào liàng wǒ jiǎobù
神的话语是路引导我前行
Shén de huàyǔ shì lù yǐndǎo wǒ qiánxíng
我要将祢的话存在心里
Wǒ yào jiāng nǐ de huà cún zài xīn lǐ
免得我得罪祢
Miǎndé wǒ dézuì nǐ

chorus.label: 副歌
chorus.text:
神的话语是我的喜乐
Shén de huàyǔ shì wǒ de xǐlè
神的话语是我的力量
Shén de huàyǔ shì wǒ de lìliàng
直到永永远远
Zhídào yǒng yǒngyuǎn yuǎn
我要信靠神的话
Wǒ yào xìn kào shén de huà

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Joys are flowing like a river
Since the Comforter has come;
He abides with us forever,
Makes the trusting heart His home.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Bringing life and health and gladness
All around, this heav'nly Guest;
Banished unbelief and sadness,
Changed our weariness to rest.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Like the rain that falls from heaven,
Like the sunlight from the sky,
So the Holy Ghost is given,
Coming on us from on high.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
See, a fruitful field is growing,
Blessed fruit of righteousness;
And the streams of life are flowing
In the lonely wilderness.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Blessed quietness, holy quietness,
What assurance in my soul!
On the stormy sea He speaks peace to me,
How the billows cease to roll!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I'll go where You want me to go, dear Lord,
O'er mountain, or plain, or sea;
I'll say what You want me to say, dear Lord,
I'll be what You want me to be.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Perhaps today there are loving words
Which Jesus would have me speak;
There may be now in the paths of sin
Some wanderer whom I should seek.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
There's surely somewhere a lowly place
In earth's harvest fields so wide,
Where I may labor through life's short day
For Jesus the Crucified.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I'll go where You want me to go, dear Lord,
I'll be what You want me to be;
I'll say what You want me to say, dear Lord,
I'll be what You want me to be.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Only a step to Jesus!
Then why not take it now?
Come, and thy sin confessing,
To Him thy Savior bow.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Only a step to Jesus!
Believe, and thou shalt live;
Lovingly now He's waiting,
And ready to forgive.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Only a step to Jesus!
O why not come, and say,
Gladly to Thee, my Savior,
I give myself away.

chorus.label: Chorus

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O they tell me of a home far beyond the skies,
O they tell me of a home far away;
O they tell me of a home where no storm clouds rise,
O they tell me of an uncloudy day.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
O they tell me of a home where my friends have gone,
O they tell me of that land far away;
Where the tree of life in eternal bloom
Sheds its fragrance through the uncloudy day.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O they tell me of a King in His beauty there,
And they tell me that mine eyes shall behold
Where He sits on the throne that is whiter than snow,
In the city that is made of gold.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
O the land of cloudless day,
O the land of an uncloudy day;
O they tell me of a home where no storm clouds rise,
O they tell me of an uncloudy day.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
What a wonderful, wonderful Savior,
Who would die on the cross for me;
Giving up all the glories of heaven,
That a sinner like me might be free.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
What a wonderful, wonderful story,
That He came from the realms above;
Left the mansions of glory to save me
With His infinite, matchless love.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
What a wonderful change in my nature,
When I gave Him my heart and my will;
Now I live in the sunshine of glory
And my soul with His presence is filled.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Wonderful, wonderful, Jesus is to me,
Counselor, Prince of Peace, Mighty God is He;
Saving me, keeping me from all sin and shame,
Wonderful is my Redeemer, praise His name!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
There's a church in the valley by the wildwood,
No lovelier spot in the dale;
No place is so dear to my childhood
As the little brown church in the vale.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
How sweet on a clear Sabbath morning
To list to the clear ringing bell;
Its tones so sweetly are calling,
O come to the church in the vale.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
From the church in the valley by the wildwood,
When day fades away into night,
I would fain from this spot of my childhood
Wing my way to the mansions of light.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
O come, come, come, come,
Come to the church in the wildwood,
O come to the church in the dale;
No spot is so dear to my childhood
As the little brown church in the vale.

songs.title: O How He Loves You and Me
songs.author: Traditional, pre-1920

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
For me it was in the garden
He prayed: Not my will but Thine;
He had no tears for His own griefs,
But sweat drops of blood for mine.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
O how He loves you and me!
O how He loves you and me!
He gave His life, what more could He give?
O how He loves you, O how He loves me,
O how He loves you and me!

songs.title: In My Heart There Rings a Melody
songs.author: Elton Menno Roth, 1923

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I have a song that Jesus gave me,
It was sent from heav'n above;
There never was a sweeter melody,
'Tis the melody of love.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I love the Christ who died on Calvary,
For He washed my sins away;
He put within my heart a melody,
And I know it's there to stay.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
'Twill be my endless theme in glory,
With the angels I will sing;
'Twill be a song with glorious harmony,
When the courts of heaven ring.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
In my heart there rings a melody,
There rings a melody with heaven's harmony;
In my heart there rings a melody,
There rings a melody of love!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O land of rest, for thee I sigh,
When will the moment come
When I shall lay my armor by
And dwell in peace at home?

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
We'll work till Jesus comes,
We'll work till Jesus comes,
We'll work till Jesus comes,
And we'll be gathered home.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
No tranquil joys on earth I know,
No peaceful sheltering dome;
This world's a wilderness of woe,
This world is not my home.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
We'll work till Jesus comes,
We'll work till Jesus comes,
We'll work till Jesus comes,
And we'll be gathered home.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
There's a land that is fairer than day,
And by faith we can see it afar;
For the Father waits over the way
To prepare us a dwelling place there.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
We shall sing on that beautiful shore
The melodious songs of the blessed;
And our spirits shall sorrow no more,
Not a sigh for the blessing of rest.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
To our bountiful Father above
We will offer our tribute of praise
For the glorious gift of His love
And the blessings that hallow our days.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on that beautiful shore;
In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on that beautiful shore.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I'm dwelling in Canaan,
The happy land of Canaan;
I'm pressing onward toward the goal,
The kingdom of my God.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
The streams of Canaan
Are flowing full and free;
The fruit of Canaan,
The richest gift for me.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
The valleys of Canaan
Are fair and wide and long;
The mountains of Canaan
Ring out with praise and song.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Whosoever heareth, shout, shout the sound!
Spread the blessed tidings all the world around;
Tell the joyful news wherever man is found:
Whosoever will may come.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
Whosoever will, the promise is secure:
Whosoever will, forever must endure;
Whosoever will, 'tis life forevermore:
Whosoever will may come.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Whosoever will, whosoever will!
Send the proclamation over vale and hill;
'Tis a loving Father calls the wand'rer home:
Whosoever will may come.

songs.title: Brighten the Corner Where You Are
songs.author: Ina Duley Ogdon, 1913

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Do not wait until some deed of greatness you may do,
Do not wait to shed your light afar;
To the many duties ever near you now be true,
Brighten the corner where you are.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Just above are clouded skies that you may help to clear,
Let not narrow self your way debar;
Though into one heart alone may fall your song of cheer,
Brighten the corner where you are.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Here for all your talent you may surely find a need,
Here reflect the bright and Morning Star;
Even from your humble hand the Bread of Life may feed,
Brighten the corner where you are.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Brighten the corner where you are!
Brighten the corner where you are!
Someone far from harbor you may guide across the bar,
Brighten the corner where you are!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Buried in the deepest sea,
Yes, that's good enough for me;
I shall live eternally,
Praise God, my sins are gone!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Gone from my heart the terrible load,
Gone are my sins and now I know
God reconciled me through His blood,
Praise God, my sins are gone!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I shall not fear the judgment day,
No condemnation now I dread;
For God so loved He gave His Son
To bear my guilt upon the tree.

chorus.label: Chorus

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
There was a time on earth when in the book of heaven
An old account was standing for sins yet unforgiven;
My name was at the top and many things below,
I went unto the Keeper and settled long ago.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
The old account was large, and growing every day,
For I was always sinning and never tried to pay;
But when I looked ahead and saw such pain and woe,
I said that I would settle — settled long ago.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
When at the judgment bar I stand before my King,
And He the book will open, He cannot find a thing;
Then will my heart be glad while tears of joy will flow,
Because I had it settled — settled long ago.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Long ago, long ago,
Yes, the old account was settled long ago;
And the record's clear today,
For He washed my sins away,
When the old account was settled long ago.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
All my life long I had panted
For a drink from some cool spring
That I hoped would quench the burning
Of the thirst I felt within.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Feeding on the husks around me,
Till my strength was almost gone,
Longed my soul for something better,
Only still to hunger on.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Poor I was and sought for riches,
Something that would satisfy;
But the dust I gathered 'round me
Only mocked my soul's sad cry.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Hallelujah! I have found Him
Whom my soul so long has craved!
Jesus satisfies my longings;
Through His blood I now am saved.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Ho, my comrades! See the signal
Waving in the sky!
Reinforcements now appearing,
Victory is nigh!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
See the mighty host advancing,
Satan leading on;
Mighty men around us falling,
Courage almost gone!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
See the glorious banner waving!
Hear the trumpet blow!
In our Leader's name we triumph
Over every foe!

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Fierce and long the battle rages,
But our help is near;
Onward comes our great Commander,
Cheer, my comrades, cheer!

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Hold the fort, for I am coming,
Jesus signals still;
Wave the answer back to heaven,
By your faith and will.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Conquering now and still to conquer,
Rideth a King in His might;
Leading the host of all the faithful
Into the midst of the fight;
See them with courage advancing,
Clad in their brilliant array,
Shouting the name of their Leader,
Hear them exultingly say:

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Conquering now and still to conquer,
Jesus, Thou Ruler of all;
Thrones and their scepters all shall perish,
Crowns and their splendor shall fall;
Yet shall the armies Thou leadest
Faithful and true to Thee be,
Joyfully singing Thy praises,
Victorious through Thee.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Not to the strong is the battle,
Not to the swift is the race,
Yet to the true and the faithful
Victory is promised through grace.

songs.title: There's a Song in the Air
songs.author: Josiah G. Holland, 1872

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
There's a song in the air!
There's a star in the sky!
There's a mother's deep prayer
And a baby's low cry!
And the star rains its fire
While the beautiful sing,
For the manger of Bethlehem
Cradles a King!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
There's a tumult of joy
O'er the wonderful birth,
For the virgin's sweet Boy
Is the Lord of the earth.
Ay! the star rains its fire
And the beautiful sing,
For the manger of Bethlehem
Cradles a King!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
In the light of that star
Lie the ages impearled;
And that song from afar
Has swept over the world.
Every hearth is aflame,
And the beautiful sing
In the homes of the nations
That Jesus is King!

songs.title: Infant Holy Infant Lowly
songs.author: Polish carol, 17th c.; tr. Edith Reed, 1921

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Infant holy, infant lowly,
For His bed a cattle stall;
Oxen lowing, little knowing
Christ the babe is Lord of all.
Swift are winging angels singing,
Nowells ringing, tidings bringing:
Christ the babe is Lord of all!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Flocks were sleeping, shepherds keeping
Vigil till the morning new
Saw the glory, heard the story,
Tidings of a gospel true.
Thus rejoicing, free from sorrow,
Praises voicing, greet the morrow:
Christ the babe was born for you!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
In the bleak midwinter, frosty wind made moan,
Earth stood hard as iron, water like a stone;
Snow had fallen, snow on snow, snow on snow,
In the bleak midwinter, long, long ago.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 1
verses.text:
I hear the Savior say,
Thy strength indeed is small,
Child of weakness, watch and pray,
Find in Me thine all in all.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
For nothing good have I
Whereby Thy grace to claim;
I'll wash my garments white
In the blood of Calv'ry's Lamb.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
And when before the throne
I stand in Him complete,
Jesus died and paid it all,
All to Him I owe.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Jesus paid it all,
All to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain,
He washed it white as snow.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Revive Thy work, O Lord!
Thy mighty arm make bare;
Speak with the voice that wakes the dead,
And make Thy people hear.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Revive Thy work, O Lord!
Disturb this sleep of death;
Quicken the smoldering embers now
By Thine almighty breath.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Revive Thy work, O Lord!
Create soul-thirst for Thee;
And hung'ring for the Bread of life,
O may our spirits be.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Revive Thy work, O Lord!
Exalt Thy precious name;
And by the Holy Ghost our love
For Thee and Thine inflame.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
What can wash away my sin?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
What can make me whole again?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
For my pardon this I see:
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
For my cleansing this my plea:
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Nothing can for sin atone:
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
Naught of good that I have done:
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
O precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow;
No other fount I know:
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Each day I'll do a golden deed
By helping those who are in need;
My life on earth is but a span
And so I'll do the best I can.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
To be a child of God each day,
My light must shine along the way;
I'll sing His praise while ages roll
And strive to help some troubled soul.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
The only life that will endure
Is one that's kind and good and pure;
And so for God and right I'll stand,
The world's a better place and grand.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Life's evening sun is sinking low,
A few more days and I must go
To meet the deeds that I have done
Where there will be no setting sun.

songs.title: Low in the Grave He Lay
songs.author: Robert Lowry, 1874

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Low in the grave He lay, Jesus my Savior!
Waiting the coming day, Jesus my Lord!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Vainly they watch His bed, Jesus my Savior!
Vainly they seal the dead, Jesus my Lord!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Death cannot keep his prey, Jesus my Savior!
He tore the bars away, Jesus my Lord!

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Up from the grave He arose,
With a mighty triumph o'er His foes!
He arose a Victor from the dark domain,
And He lives forever with His saints to reign!
He arose! He arose!
Hallelujah! Christ arose!

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
En Jesús confío,
Él es mi Salvador;
En Sus brazos vivo
seguro en Su amor.
Ni la muerte temo
ni me turba el mal,
pues Jesús me guarda
y es mi eternal.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
Cuando el camino es
oscuro y difícil,
en Jesús confío,
Él es fiel y hábil.
Su Palabra es luz
que ilumina mi senda;
en Jesús confío,
Él mi alma defiende.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
Un día llegaré
a la gloria eterna,
en Jesús confío,
esa es mi esperanza.
Ver Su rostro amado
será mi galardón;
en Jesús confío,
Él es mi canción.

chorus.label: Coro
chorus.text:
En Jesús confío,
Él es mi Señor;
en Jesús confío
para siempre, amén.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Besimi im është guri i fortë
My faith is the firm rock
Mbi të cilin ndërtoj shtëpinë time
On which I build my house
Asnjë stuhi nuk mund ta shkundë
No storm can shake it
Sepse Krishti është themeli im
Because Christ is my foundation

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Besimi im buron nga Fjala
My faith comes from the Word
E Perëndisë që s'ndryshon kurrë
Of God that never changes
Çdo premtim i Tij qëndron i lartë
Every promise of His stands firm
Besimi im është i sigurt
My faith is secure

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Besimi im, besimi im
My faith, my faith
Në Krishtin e Perëndisë
In the Christ of God
Besimi im, besimi im
My faith, my faith
Jet përjetësisht
Lives forever

songs.title: 祢是我的力量 (Nǐ Shì Wǒ De Lìliàng)
songs.author: 中文传统 Chinese traditional

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
祢是我的力量，祢是我的盾牌
Nǐ shì wǒ de lìliàng, nǐ shì wǒ de dùnpái
祢是我的避难所，我高山上的城
Nǐ shì wǒ de bìnàn suǒ, wǒ gāo shān shàng de chéng
当我软弱的时候，祢是我的力量
Dāng wǒ ruǎnruò de shíhòu, nǐ shì wǒ de lìliàng
靠着祢我能行一切事
Kào zhe nǐ wǒ néng xíng yīqiè shì

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
祢的爱比天更高，比海更深更广
Nǐ de ài bǐ tiān gèng gāo, bǐ hǎi gèng shēn gèng guǎng
祢的恩典够用，每天都更新
Nǐ de ēndiǎn gòu yòng, měitiān dōu gēngxīn
我要倚靠祢，直到永永远远
Wǒ yào yǐkào nǐ, zhídào yǒng yǒngyuǎn yuǎn
祢是我永远的力量
Nǐ shì wǒ yǒngyuǎn de lìliàng

chorus.label: 副歌
chorus.text:
祢是我的力量
Nǐ shì wǒ de lìliàng
祢是我的歌
Nǐ shì wǒ de gē
我要赞美祢
Wǒ yào zànměi nǐ
直到永远
Zhídào yǒngyuǎn

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Abide, O dearest Jesus,
Among us with Thy grace,
That Satan may not harm us
Nor we to sin give place.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Abide, O dear Redeemer,
Among us with Thy Word,
And thus now and hereafter
True peace and joy afford.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Abide with heav'nly brightness
Among us, precious Light;
Thy truth direct and keep us
From error's gloomy night.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Abide with richest blessings
Among us, bounteous Lord;
Let us in grace and wisdom
Grow daily through Thy Word.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
At the name of Jesus
Every knee shall bow,
Every tongue confess Him
King of Glory now;
Tis the Father's pleasure
We should call Him Lord,
Who from the beginning
Was the mighty Word.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Humbled for a season,
To receive a name
From the lips of sinners
Unto whom He came,
Faithfully He bore it
Spotless to the last,
Brought it back victorious
When from death He passed.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Name Him, brothers, name Him,
With love as strong as death,
But with awe and wonder
And with bated breath!
He is God the Savior,
He is Christ the Lord,
Ever to be worshipped,
Trusted and adored.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Be still and know that I am God,
Be still and know that I am God,
Be still and know that I am God.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I am the Lord that healeth thee,
I am the Lord that healeth thee,
I am the Lord that healeth thee.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
In Thee, O Lord, I put my trust,
In Thee, O Lord, I put my trust,
In Thee, O Lord, I put my trust.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Come, Holy Spirit, heavenly Dove,
With all Thy quickening powers;
Kindle a flame of sacred love
In these cold hearts of ours.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Look how we grovel here below,
Fond of these trifling toys;
Our souls can neither fly nor go
To reach eternal joys.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Dear Lord! and shall we ever live
At this poor dying rate?
Our love so faint, so cold to Thee,
And Thine to us so great?

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Come, Holy Spirit, heavenly Dove,
With all Thy quickening powers;
Come, shed abroad a Savior's love
And that shall kindle ours.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Only a step to Jesus!
Then why not take it now?
Come, and thy sin confessing,
To Him thy Savior bow.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Eternal life is given
To every soul that turns
From sin to seek forgiveness
And for His glory yearns.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
The gift of God is freely
To those who ask and seek;
Come find salvation, surely,
For strong and for the weak.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Give me thy heart, says the Father above,
No gift so precious to Him as our love;
Softly He whispers wherever thou art,
Gratefully trust Me and give Me thy heart.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Give me thy heart, says the Savior of men,
Calling in mercy again and again;
Turn now from sin and from evil depart,
Have I not died for thee? Give Me thy heart.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Give me thy heart, says the Spirit divine,
All that thou hast to My keeping resign;
Grace more abounding is mine to impart,
Make full surrender and give Me thy heart.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Give Him thy heart, give Him thy heart,
Hear the soft whisper wherever thou art;
From this dark world He would draw thee apart,
Speaking so tenderly, give Him thy heart.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
In looking through my tears one day
I saw Mount Calvary;
Beneath the cross there flowed a stream
Of grace enough for me.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
While standing there my trembling heart
Once full of agony,
Could feel the healing, cleansing stream,
O grace enough for me!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
When I am safe within the veil
And all His glory see,
I'll praise His name through endless days
For grace enough for me.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Grace enough for me,
Grace enough for me;
A stream from Calvary's mountain flows,
Grace enough for me!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I have a Savior, He's pleading in glory,
A dear, loving Savior, though earth-friends be few;
And now He is watching in tenderness o'er me,
And oh, that my Savior were your Savior too!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I have a Father; to me He has given
A hope for eternity, blessed and true;
And soon will He call me to meet Him in heaven,
But oh, that He'd let me bring you with me too!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I have a robe; 'tis resplendent in whiteness,
Awaiting in glory my wondering view;
Oh, when I receive it all shining in brightness,
Dear friend, could I see you receiving one too!

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
For you I am praying,
For you I am praying,
For you I am praying,
I'm praying for you.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
It is truly wonderful what the Lord has done!
Buried all my sins away, hallelujah!
It is truly wonderful, truly wonderful,
It is truly wonderful what the Lord has done!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
It is truly wonderful how He set me free!
Saved from all my sins and shame, hallelujah!
It is truly wonderful, truly wonderful,
It is truly wonderful what the Lord has done!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
It is truly wonderful, He will come again!
Glory, hallelujah to the Lamb!
It is truly wonderful, truly wonderful,
It is truly wonderful what the Lord has done!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Earthly friends may prove untrue,
Doubt and fears assail;
One still loves and cares for you:
One who will not fail.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Though the sky be dark and drear,
Fierce and strong the gale,
Just remember He is near
And He will not fail.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
In life's dark and bitter hour
Love will still prevail;
Trust His everlasting power,
Jesus will not fail.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Jesus never fails,
Jesus never fails;
Heav'n and earth may pass away
But Jesus never fails.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
There's a dark and a troubled side of life,
There's a bright and a sunny side too;
Though we meet with the darkness and strife
The sunny side we also may view.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Though the storm and its fury broke today,
Crushing hopes that we cherished so dear,
Clouds and storms will in time pass away
The sun again will shine bright and clear.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Let us greet with the song of hope each day,
Though the moment be cloudy or fair;
Let us trust in our Savior always
To keep us, every one, in His care.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Keep on the sunny side, always on the sunny side,
Keep on the sunny side of life;
It will help us every day, it will brighten all the way
If we keep on the sunny side of life.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
In the land of fadeless day
Lies the city four-square;
It shall never pass away
And there is no night there.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
All the gates of pearl are made,
In the city four-square;
All the streets with gold are laid,
And there is no night there.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
And the gates shall never close
To the city four-square;
There life's crystal river flows
And there is no night there.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
There they need no sunshine bright,
In that city four-square;
For the Lamb is all the light,
And there is no night there.

chorus.label: Chorus

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Praise ye the Lord, hallelujah!
Everybody praise the Lord;
Praise ye the Lord, hallelujah!
Everybody praise the Lord.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Praise Him in the morning, praise Him in the noon time,
Praise Him, praise Him, praise Him when the sun goes down.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Love Him in the morning, love Him in the noon time,
Love Him, love Him, love Him when the sun goes down.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Serve Him in the morning, serve Him in the noon time,
Serve Him, serve Him, serve Him when the sun goes down.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Redeemed, how I love to proclaim it!
Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
Redeemed through His infinite mercy,
His child, and forever, I am.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Redeemed, and so happy in Jesus,
No language my rapture can tell;
I know that the light of His presence
With me doth continually dwell.

verses.label: Verse 3

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Redeemed, redeemed,
Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
Redeemed through His infinite mercy,
His child, and forever, I am.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O Lord, send a revival,
O Lord, send a revival,
O Lord, send a revival,
And let it begin in me.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
O Lord, send Thy Spirit,
O Lord, send Thy Spirit,
O Lord, send Thy Spirit,
And let it begin in me.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O Lord, we are waiting,
O Lord, we are waiting,
O Lord, we are waiting,
Please send it now to me.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
A pilgrim was I and a wandering,
In the cold night of sin I did roam,
When Jesus the kind Shepherd found me,
And now I am on my way home.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
He restores my soul when I'm weary,
He gives me strength day by day;
He leads me beside the still waters,
He guards me each step of the way.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
When I walk through the dark lonesome valley,
My Savior will walk with me there;
And safely His great hand will lead me
To the mansions He's gone to prepare.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me
All the days, all the days of my life;
Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me
All the days, all the days of my life.

songs.title: The Lord Is in His Holy Temple
songs.author: Based on Habakkuk 2:20, traditional

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
The Lord is in His holy temple,
The Lord is in His holy temple;
Let all the earth keep silence,
Let all the earth keep silence before Him,
Keep silence, keep silence before Him.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
How can I help but love Him
When He loves me so?
He suffered, bled and died for me
On Calvary long ago.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
He sought me when I wandered
Far, far from His side;
He found me in my sin and shame
And for me bled and died.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
He walks beside me daily,
My closest, dearest Friend;
He'll never leave me, never,
Through all life to the end.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
O the way He loves me,
O the way He loves me!
I never can explain the way He loves me so;
O the way He loves me,
O the way He loves me!
How wonderful, how marvelous His love for me!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I want to tell the story
Of Jesus and His love,
How He came down from glory
The blessed home above;
To save a world of sinners
He gave His life for me,
And now He reigns in triumph
Through all eternity.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I want to sing His praises
Throughout the coming years,
To cheer the heart of sorrow
And dry the falling tears;
To scatter seeds of kindness
Wherever I may be,
Till men shall know the Savior
Who died on Calvary.

chorus.label: Chorus

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Walking with Jesus, walking every day,
Walking all the journey through;
If I walk with Him, He will find the way,
He will take me safely through.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Walking with Jesus through the vale of tears,
Walking when the shadows fall;
Every step is safer as it onward nears
To the place beyond it all.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Walking with Jesus, till the journey's done,
Walking till I reach the shore;
When I see His face and I hear, well done,
I will walk with Him forevermore.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Walking with Jesus, walking every day,
Walking all the journey through;
He who walks with Jesus never goes astray,
He will lead me safely through.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
If you cannot on the ocean
Sail among the swiftest fleet,
Rocking on the highest billows,
Laughing at the storms you meet;
You can stand among the sailors,
Anchored yet within the bay,
You can lend a hand to help them
As they launch their boats away.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
If you are too weak to journey
Up the mountain steep and high,
You can stand within the valley
While the multitudes go by;
You can chant in happy measure,
As they slowly pass along;
Though they may forget the singer,
They will not forget the song.

verses.label: Verse 3
Estrofa 1
verses.text:
Amarte solo a Ti, Señor,
con todo el corazón;
amarte solo a Ti, Señor,
es mi mayor honor.
No hay nadie como Tú,
no hay amor como el Tuyo;
amarte solo a Ti, Señor,
es lo que quiero yo.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
Seguirte solo a Ti, Señor,
en todo mi caminar;
seguirte solo a Ti, Señor,
hasta el final.
No miro hacia atrás,
ni temo al porvenir;
seguirte solo a Ti, Señor,
es mi razón de vivir.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
Alabarte solo a Ti, Señor,
con toda mi voz;
alabaré Tu nombre, Señor,
en unidad con Dios.
Padre, Hijo y Espíritu
son uno en amor;
alabaré por siempre
al único Señor.

chorus.label: Coro
chorus.text:
Solo a Ti, solo a Ti,
solo a Ti, mi Señor;
con mi vida entera
te daré mi amor.

songs.title: Nesha Ime Ka Krishtin (My Soul Is with Christ)
songs.author: Traditional Albanian

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Nesha ime është me Krishtin
My soul is with Christ
Ai e mban në duart e Tij
He holds it in His hands
Asnjë frikë nuk ka kuptim
No fear has any meaning
Kur Krishti është me mua
When Christ is with me

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Jeta ime i takon Atij
My life belongs to Him
Vdekja ime është fitim
My death is gain
Sepse të jetoj është Krishti
For to live is Christ
Dhe të vdes është fitim
And to die is gain

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Me Krishtin, me Krishtin
With Christ, with Christ
Nesha ime është e sigurt
My soul is secure
Me Krishtin, gjithmonë
With Christ, always
Në dashuri të Tij
In His love

songs.title: 耶稣来了 (Yēsū Lái Le)
songs.author: 中文传统 Chinese traditional
songs.scripture: 约翰福音 1:14; 以赛亚书 9:6

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
耶稣来了，荣耀的君王
Yēsū lái le, róngyào de jūnwáng
从天降临在伯利恒城
Cóng tiān jiànglín zài Bólìhéng chéng
天使欢呼，牧人惊奇
Tiānshǐ huānhū, mùrén jīngqí
救主降生在马槽里
Jiùzhǔ jiàngshēng zài mǎcáo lǐ

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
耶稣来了，世界的光明
Yēsū lái le, shìjiè de guāngmíng
照亮每一个黑暗的心
Zhào liàng měi yīgè hēiàn de xīn
祂是道路，祂是真理
Tā shì dàolù, Tā shì zhēnlǐ
祂是生命，永远的主
Tā shì shēngmìng, yǒngyuǎn de zhǔ

chorus.label: 副歌
chorus.text:
耶稣来了，哈利路亚
Yēsū lái le, hālìlùyà
我们欢迎救主来
Wǒmen huānyíng jiùzhǔ lái
耶稣来了，哈利路亚
Yēsū lái le, hālìlùyà
赞美祂的圣名
Zànměi Tā de shèng míng

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Holy Bible, book divine,
Precious treasure, thou art mine;
Mine to tell me whence I came,
Mine to teach me what I am.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Mine to chide me when I rove,
Mine to show a Savior's love;
Mine thou art to guide my feet,
Mine to judge, condemn, acquit.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Mine to comfort in distress,
If the Holy Spirit bless;
Mine to show by living faith,
Man can triumph over death.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Holy Bible, book divine,
Precious treasure, thou art mine;
Mine to tell me whence I came,
Mine to teach me what I am.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O the blood of Jesus,
O the blood of Jesus,
O the blood of Jesus,
It washes white as snow.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
O the word of Jesus,
O the word of Jesus,
O the word of Jesus,
It cleanses white as snow.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O the love of Jesus,
O the love of Jesus,
O the love of Jesus,
It makes His body whole.

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
Cantemos alabanzas a Dios,
nuestro grande Creador;
cantemos alabanzas a Dios,
al eterno Salvador.
Su amor y Su gracia nos llena de gozo,
Su nombre por siempre alabemos los dos.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
Su gloria proclaman los cielos,
la tierra también cantará;
los ángeles cantan Sus glorias eternas,
nosotros también cantaremos.
Alabemos a Dios con toda nuestra vida,
su nombre bendito por siempre ensalzad.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
En el día de gloria final,
cuando Cristo regrese en poder;
toda rodilla se doblará ante Él,
toda lengua Le confesará.
Alabaré al Señor por siempre jamás,
en Su reino eterno Él reinará.

chorus.label: Coro
chorus.text:
Alabanzas, alabanzas,
elevar a Dios;
Alabaré, alabaré,
al Señor con voz.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
My Father is rich in houses and lands,
He holdeth the wealth of the world in His hands!
Of rubies and diamonds, of silver and gold,
His coffers are full — He has riches untold.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
My Father's own Son, the Savior of men,
Once wandered on earth as the poorest of them;
But now He is reigning forever on high,
And will give me a home in the by and by.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I once was an outcast stranger on earth,
A sinner by choice and an alien by birth;
But I've been adopted, my name's written down —
An heir to a mansion, a robe, and a crown.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
A tent or a cottage, why should I care?
They're building a palace for me over there;
Though exiled from home, yet still I may sing:
All glory to God, I'm a child of the King!

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I'm a child of the King,
A child of the King!
With Jesus my Savior,
I'm a child of the King!

songs.title: Anywhere with Jesus I Can Safely Go
songs.author: Jessie H. Brown / D.B. Towner, 1887

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Anywhere with Jesus I can safely go,
Anywhere He leads me in this world below;
Anywhere without Him dearest joys would fade,
Anywhere with Jesus I am not afraid.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Anywhere with Jesus I am not alone,
Other friends may fail me, He is still my own;
Though His hand may lead me over dreary ways,
Anywhere with Jesus is a house of praise.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Anywhere with Jesus over land and sea,
Telling souls in darkness of salvation free;
Ready as He summons me to go or stay,
Anywhere with Jesus when He points the way.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Anywhere! Anywhere! Fear I cannot know;
Anywhere with Jesus I can safely go.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Sinners Jesus will receive:
Sound this word of grace to all
Who the heav'nly pathway leave,
All who linger, all who fall.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
Now my heart condemns me not,
Pure before the law I stand;
He who cleansed me from all spot,
Satisfied its last demand.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Christ receiveth sinful men,
Even me with all my sin;
Purged from ev'ry spot and stain,
Heav'n with Him I enter in.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Sing it o'er and o'er again:
Christ receiveth sinful men;
Make the message clear and plain:
Christ receiveth sinful men.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Ho, everyone that thirsteth, come to the water!
Come to the water, come to the water;
Ho, everyone that thirsteth, come to the water!
Ye that have no money, come.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
And he that hath no money, come ye, buy and eat!
Come ye, buy and eat; come ye, buy and eat;
Yea, come, buy wine and milk without money,
Without price, come and be fed.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Seek ye the Lord while He may be found,
Call ye upon Him while He is near;
Let the wicked forsake his evil way,
And return unto the Lord.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Emmanuel, Emmanuel,
His name is called Emmanuel;
God with us, revealed in us,
His name is called Emmanuel.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
He came to earth that we might know
The love of God above;
The gift of life He came to give,
Emmanuel is love.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
One day He'll come in glory bright
To take us home to stay;
Emmanuel our God with us
Forever and a day.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Once I was bound by sin's galling fetters,
Chained like a slave I struggled in vain;
But I received a glorious freedom
When Jesus broke every chain.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Freedom from all the carnal affections,
Freedom from envy, hatred and strife;
Freedom from vain and worldly ambitions,
Freedom to walk the new life.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Freedom from pride and all evil passions,
Freedom from love of glory and gold;
Freedom from doubt and fearful forebodings,
Freedom while ages shall roll.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Glorious freedom! Wonderful freedom!
No more in chains of sin I repine;
Jesus the glorious Emancipator —
Now and forever He's mine!

songs.title: God Moves in a Mysterious Way
songs.author: William Cowper, 1774

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
God moves in a mysterious way
His wonders to perform;
He plants His footsteps in the sea
And rides upon the storm.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Deep in unfathomable mines
Of never-failing skill
He treasures up His bright designs
And works His sovereign will.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Ye fearful saints, fresh courage take;
The clouds ye so much dread
Are big with mercy and shall break
In blessings on your head.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Judge not the Lord by feeble sense,
But trust Him for His grace;
Behind a frowning providence
He hides a smiling face.

verses.label: Verse 5
verses.text:
Blind unbelief is sure to err
And scan His work in vain;
God is His own interpreter
And He will make it plain.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Have you been to Jesus for the cleansing power?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Are you fully trusting in His grace this hour?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Are you walking daily by the Savior's side?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Do you rest each moment in the Crucified?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
When the Bridegroom cometh will your robes be white?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Will your soul be ready for the mansions bright?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Are you washed in the blood,
In the soul-cleansing blood of the Lamb?
Are your garments spotless?
Are they white as snow?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
God never moves without purpose or plan
When trying His servant and molding a man;
Give thanks to the Lord though your testing seems long,
In darkness He giveth a song.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I could not see through the shadows ahead,
So I looked at the cross of my Savior instead;
I bowed to the will of the Master that day,
Then peace came and tears fled away.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Now I can see testing comes from above,
God strengthens His children and purges in love;
My Father knows best, and I trust in His care,
Through purging more fruit I will bear.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
O rejoice in the Lord, He makes no mistake,
He knoweth the end of each path that I take;
For when I am tried and purified,
I shall come forth as gold.

songs.title: Hide Me O My Savior Hide Me
songs.author: Fanny J. Crosby, 1890

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Hide me, O my Savior, hide me
In Thy holy place;
Resting there beneath Thy glory,
O let me see Thy face.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Hide me, when the storm is raging
O'er life's troubled sea;
Like a dove on ocean's billow,
O let me fly to Thee.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Hide me, when my heart is breaking
With its weight of woe;
When in tears I seek the comfort
Thou canst alone bestow.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Hide me, hide me, O blessed Savior, hide me!
O my Savior, keep me near Thy side;
Hide me, hide me, O my blessed Savior,
In Thy bosom let me ever hide.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
His yoke is easy, His burden is light,
I've found it so, I've found it so;
He leadeth me by day and by night,
Where living waters flow.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I cast my care on Jesus today,
I cast my care on Jesus;
He bore my load, He showed me the way,
Now I will trust Him more.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Come unto me, He gently calls,
All ye who labor on;
He bears your load through life's darkened halls
And leads His children home.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Jesus saves me every day,
Every day and all the way;
Fills my heart with joy and peace,
Makes my doubts and troubles cease.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Jesus keeps me day by day,
On the straight and narrow way;
