He is all the world to me,
In Him only can I be free.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Jesus leads me all the way,
Through the night and through the day;
One day He will call me home,
No more sorrow, no more roam.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Hallelujah, saved am I!
Hallelujah, by and by!
Jesus saves me every day,
Every day and all the way!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Looking to Jesus, ever serener,
Working or resting, going or still;
Speaking or silent, this is my motto:
Not my own will, Lord, but Thine be done.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Looking to Jesus, casting my burden,
Lay it all down at the merciful feet;
He who has borne it, He who has shared it,
Makes every sorrow and trial complete.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Looking to Jesus, trusting and resting,
Peace like a river fills all my soul;
Though I am weak and heavy-burdened,
He makes the wounded and broken whole.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Out in the highways and byways of life,
Many are weary and sad;
Carry the sunshine where darkness is rife,
Making the sorrowing glad.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Tell the sweet story of Christ and His love,
Tell of His power to forgive;
Others will trust Him if only you prove
True every moment you live.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Give as 'twas given to you in your need,
Love as the Master loved you;
Be to the helpless a helper indeed,
Unto your mission be true.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Make me a blessing, make me a blessing,
Out of my life may Jesus shine;
Make me a blessing, O Savior, I pray,
Make me a blessing to someone today.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3

songs.title: O That I Had a Thousand Voices
songs.author: Johann Mentzer, 1704; tr. Catherine Winkworth

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O that I had a thousand voices
To praise my God with thousand tongues!
My heart, which in the Lord rejoices,
Would then proclaim in grateful songs
To all, wherever I might be,
What great things God hath done for me.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
O all ye pow'rs that He implanted,
Arise, keep silence now no more;
Put forth the strength that God has granted!
Your noblest work is to adore.
O soul and body, join to raise
With heart and voice your Maker's praise.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Spirit of the living God, fall fresh on me,
Spirit of the living God, fall fresh on me;
Melt me, mold me, fill me, use me,
Spirit of the living God, fall fresh on me.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Come unto Me, I will give you rest,
Trust Me and you shall be blest;
Come unto Me, lay your burdens down,
I will give you rest.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Let not your heart be troubled or afraid,
Trust in God and trust in Me;
I am the Way, the Truth, the Life,
Come and follow Me.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I am the Resurrection and the Life,
He that believeth in Me
Though he were dead, yet shall he live,
Live eternally.

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
Tú eres fiel, Señor, tú eres fiel,
nuevas son tus misericordias;
cada mañana veo Tu amor,
grande es Tu fidelidad.
No me abandonas ni en el dolor,
Tu gracia siempre me sustentará;
en Ti confío, Señor mi Dios,
grande es Tu fidelidad.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
En los valles oscuros Tú estás,
en las cumbres más altas también;
en la tormenta me das Tu paz,
no hay lugar donde no estés.
Tu amor eterno jamás fallará,
Tu Palabra es verdad y nunca pasará;
glorificarte quiero por siempre, Señor,
grande es Tu fidelidad.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
Cuando llegue el final de mi vida
y delante de Ti yo esté,
Ver Tu rostro será mi corona,
la recompensa que esperé.
Hasta ese día seguiré cantando
de Tu amor eterno que me ha redimido;
grande eres Tú, fiel eres Tú, Señor,
grande es Tu fidelidad.

chorus.label: Coro
chorus.text:
Grande es Tu fidelidad,
grande es Tu fidelidad;
mañana tras mañana nuevas misericordias
veo, Señor, en Ti.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Shpresa ime është tek Zoti
My hope is in the Lord
Ai nuk mund të dështojë kurrë
He can never fail
Çdo premtim i Tij qëndron i fortë
Every promise of His stands firm
Në Të Zot besoj dhe shpresoj
In You Lord I believe and hope

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Shpresa ime nuk ka turp
My hope is not ashamed
Sepse dashuria e Perëndisë është shpërndarë
Because God's love has been poured out
Në zemrat tona nga Fryma e Shenjtë
In our hearts by the Holy Spirit
Shpresa ime është e sigurt
My hope is sure

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Shpresoj tek Ti, Zoti im
I hope in You, my Lord
Ti je ndihmësi im
You are my helper
Shpresoj tek Ti gjithmonë
I hope in You always
Për jetë dhe për vdekje
In life and in death

songs.title: 主的恩典 (Zhǔ De Ēndiǎn)
songs.author: 中文传统 Chinese traditional
songs.scripture: 约翰福音 1:17; 以弗所书 2:8

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
主的恩典何等丰盛
Zhǔ de ēndiǎn héděng fēngshèng
每日赐给我新的力量
Měi rì cì gěi wǒ xīn de lìliàng
祂的爱永不改变
Tā de ài yǒng bù gǎibiàn
直到永远，永远
Zhídào yǒngyuǎn, yǒngyuǎn

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
主的恩典宽广无边
Zhǔ de ēndiǎn kuānguǎng wúbiān
覆盖我所有的软弱
Fùgài wǒ suǒyǒu de ruǎnruò
在祂里面我得胜
Zài Tā lǐmiàn wǒ déshèng
靠着祂的大能
Kào zhe Tā de dànéng

chorus.label: 副歌
chorus.text:
感谢祢的恩典
Gǎnxiè nǐ de ēndiǎn
感谢祢的大爱
Gǎnxiè nǐ de dài ài
我要颂扬祢的名
Wǒ yào sòng yáng nǐ de míng
直到永永远远
Zhídào yǒng yǒngyuǎn yuǎn

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
יְהוָה רֹעִי לֹא אֶחְסָר
Adonai ro'i lo echsar
בִּנְאוֹת דֶּשֶׁא יַרְבִּיצֵנִי
Bin'ot deshe yarbitzeni
עַל מֵי מְנֻחוֹת יְנַהֲלֵנִי
Al mei menuchot y'nahaleni
נַפְשִׁי יְשׁוֹבֵב
Nafshi y'shovev

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
גַּם כִּי אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת
Gam ki elech b'gei tzalmavet
לֹא אִירָא רָע
Lo ira ra
כִּי אַתָּה עִמָּדִי
Ki atah imadi
שִׁבְטְךָ וּמִשְׁעַנְתֶּךָ הֵמָּה יְנַחֲמֻנִי
Shivt'cha umish'ant'cha hema y'nachaman

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
אַךְ טוֹב וָחֶסֶד יִרְדְּפוּנִי
Ach tov vachesed yird'funi
כָּל יְמֵי חַיָּי
Kol y'mei chayai
וְשַׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית יְהוָה
V'shavti b'veit Adonai
לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים
L'orech yamim

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
הִנֵּה מַה טּוֹב וּמַה נָּעִים
Hinei ma tov uma na'im
שֶׁבֶת אַחִים גַּם יָחַד
Shevet achim gam yachad
הִנֵּה מַה טּוֹב
Hinei ma tov
שֶׁבֶת אַחִים גַּם יָחַד
Shevet achim gam yachad

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
כַּשֶּׁמֶן הַטּוֹב עַל הָרֹאשׁ
Kashemen hatov al harosh
יֹרֵד עַל הַזָּקָן
Yored al hazakan
זְקַן אַהֲרֹן
Z'kan Aharon
שֶׁיֹּרֵד עַל פִּי מִדּוֹתָיו
Sheyored al pi midotav

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
אֵל שַׁדַּי אֵל שַׁדַּי
El Shaddai El Shaddai
אֵל אֶלְיוֹן נָא אֲדוֹנָי
El Elyon na Adonai
אָגֶּה אֶשְׁמֶחָה
Ageh eshm'chah
אֵל שַׁדַּי
El Shaddai

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
בְּיַד חֲזָקָה
B'yad chazakah
בִּזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה
Bizro'a n'tuyah
פָּדִיתָ אֶת עַמְּךָ
Paditah et amcha
מִצְּרַיִם
Mimitz'rayim

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
כָּל הָאָרֶץ מְלֵאָה כְבוֹדֶךָ
Kol ha'aretz m'le'ah ch'vodecha
קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ
Kadosh kadosh kadosh
יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת
Adonai Tz'vaot
מְלֹא כָל הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ
M'lo chol ha'aretz k'vodo

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
יָהּ רִבּוֹן עָלַם וְעָלְמַיָּא
Yah ribbon alam v'almaya
אַנְתְּ הוּא מַלְכָּא מֶלֶךְ מַלְכַּיָּא
Ant hu malka melech malchaya
עוֹבַד גְּבוּרְתֵּךְ וְתִמְהַיָּא
Ovad g'vurtach v'timhaya
שְׁפַר קֳדָמָךְ לְהַחֲוַיָּא
Sh'far kodamach l'hachavaya

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
שְׁבָחִין אֲסַדֵּר צַפְרָא וְרַמְשָׁא
Sh'vachin asader tzafra v'ramsha
לָךְ אֱלָהָא קַדִּישָׁא דִּי בְרָא כָּל נַפְשָׁא
Lach Elaha kadisha di v'ra kol nafsha
עִירִין קַדִּישִׁין וּבְנֵי אֱנָשָׁא
Irin kadishin ub'nei enasha
חֵיוַת בָּרָא וְעוֹפֵי שְׁמַיָּא
Cheyat bara v'ofei sh'maya

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
אָנָּא יְהוָה הוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא
Anna Adonai hoshi'ah na
אָנָּא יְהוָה הַצְלִיחָה נָּא
Anna Adonai hatzlichah na
בָּרוּךְ הַבָּא בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה
Baruch haba b'shem Adonai
בֵּרַכְנוּכֶם מִבֵּית יְהוָה
Berachnu'chem mibeit Adonai

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי טוֹב
Hodu l'Adonai ki tov
כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ
Ki l'olam chasdo
יֹאמְרוּ נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל
Yomru na Yisrael
כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ
Ki l'olam chasdo

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
לְךָ יְהוָה הַגְּדֻלָּה
L'cha Adonai hag'dulah
וְהַגְּבוּרָה וְהַתִּפְאֶרֶת
V'hag'vurah v'hatif'eret
וְהַנֵּצַח וְהַהוֹד
V'hanetzach v'hahod
כִּי כֹל בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ
Ki chol bashamayim uva'aretz

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
לְךָ יְהוָה הַמַּמְלָכָה
L'cha Adonai hamamlachah
וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂא לְכֹל לְרֹאשׁ
V'hamitnaseh l'chol l'rosh
וְהָעֹשֶׁר וְהַכָּבוֹד מִלְּפָנֶיךָ
V'ha'osher v'hakavod milfanecha
וְאַתָּה מוֹשֵׁל בַּכֹּל
V'atah moshel bakol

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ
Shiru l'Adonai shir chadash
שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה כָּל הָאָרֶץ
Shiru l'Adonai kol ha'aretz
שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה בָּרֲכוּ שְׁמוֹ
Shiru l'Adonai bar'chu sh'mo
בַּשְּׂרוּ מִיּוֹם לְיוֹם יְשׁוּעָתוֹ
Bas'ru miyom l'yom y'shuato

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
סַפְּרוּ בַגּוֹיִם כְּבוֹדוֹ
Sap'ru vagoyim k'vodo
בְּכָל הָעַמִּים נִפְלְאוֹתָיו
B'chol ha'amim nifl'otav
כִּי גָדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד
Ki gadol Adonai um'hulal m'od
נוֹרָא הוּא עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִים
Nora hu al kol Elohim

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Θεὸς ἀγάπη ἐστίν
Theos agape estin
καὶ ὁ μένων ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ
kai ho menon en te agape
ἐν τῷ Θεῷ μένει
en to Theo menei
καὶ ὁ Θεὸς ἐν αὐτῷ
kai ho Theos en auto

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Ἠγαπήσαμεν αὐτὸν
Egapesamen auton
ὅτι αὐτὸς πρῶτος ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς
hoti autos protos egapesen hemas
ἐν τούτῳ ἐγνώκαμεν τὴν ἀγάπην
en touto egnokamen ten agapen
ὅτι ἐκεῖνος ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἔθηκεν
hoti ekeinos hyper hemon ten psychen autou etheken

verses.label: Doxology
verses.text:
Δόξα Πατρὶ καὶ Υἱῷ
Doxa Patri kai Huio
καὶ Ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι
kai Hagio Pneumati
καὶ νῦν καὶ ἀεὶ
kai nyn kai aei
καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων
kai eis tous aionas ton aionon
Ἀμήν
Amen

songs.title: Ἐν Ἀρχῇ Ἦν ὁ Λόγος (En Arche En ho Logos)
songs.titleEn: In the Beginning Was the Word
songs.author: Based on John 1:1-4, traditional

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Ἐν ἀρχῇ ἦν ὁ Λόγος
En arche en ho Logos
καὶ ὁ Λόγος ἦν πρὸς τὸν Θεόν
kai ho Logos en pros ton Theon
καὶ Θεὸς ἦν ὁ Λόγος
kai Theos en ho Logos
οὗτος ἦν ἐν ἀρχῇ πρὸς τὸν Θεόν
houtos en en arche pros ton Theon

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Πάντα δι᾽ αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο
Panta di autou egeneto
καὶ χωρὶς αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο
kai choris autou egeneto
οὐδὲ ἕν
oude hen
ὃ γέγονεν ἐν αὐτῷ ζωὴ ἦν

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Hiri i mrekullueshëm, sa e ëmbël melodia

Që shpëtoi një mëkatar si unë

Isha i humbur dhe u gjeta
I once was lost but now am found

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Ky hir më mësoi zemrën time të frikësohet

Dhe hiri im lehtësoi frikërat e mia

Sa çmuar u duk ky hir

Në orën që besova

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Nëpër shumë rreziqe, mundime dhe grackë

verses.label: Estrofa 1

¡Gózate, tierra, ya el Señor viene!

Recíbele tu Rey;

y alaben los cielos
And heaven and nature sing
al Señor, y alaben al Señor.
And heaven and nature sing.

¡Gózate, tierra, ya el Rey llegó!
Joy to the world, the Savior reigns!
Cantad con voz de amor;
Let men their songs employ;
los campos y ríos, los montes y valles
While fields and floods, rocks, hills and plains
repitan el gozo
Repeat the sounding joy
al Señor, repitan el gozo.
Repeat the sounding joy.

verses.label: Estrofa 3

He comes to make His blessings flow

Far as the curse is found

Far as the curse is found.

Dhe qiejt dhe natyra këndojnë
And heaven and nature sing

And heaven and nature sing

verses.label: Verse 2

Njerëzit le të këndojnë

Fushërat dhe lumenjtë dhe kodrat
While fields and floods and hills
Përsërisin gëzimin

Gëzimin, gëzimin

verses.text:
Ai vjen për të bërë bekimet e Tij të rrjedhin
He comes to make His blessings flow
Aq larg sa gjindet mallkimi
Far as the curse is found
Nuk ka më mëkat e hidhërim

Far as the curse is found

verses.label: 第二节

songs.title: A Charge to Keep I Have
songs.author: Charles Wesley, 1762

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
A charge to keep I have,
A God to glorify,
A never-dying soul to save,
And fit it for the sky.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
To serve the present age,
My calling to fulfill;
O may it all my powers engage
To do my Master's will!

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Arm me with jealous care,
As in Thy sight to live;
And O Thy servant, Lord, prepare
A strict account to give.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Help me to watch and pray
And on Thyself rely,
Assured if I my trust betray,
I shall forever die.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Encamped along the hills of light,
Ye Christian soldiers, rise,
And press the battle ere the night
Shall veil the glowing skies.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
To him that overcometh, God
Gives a crown of life;
Be faithful to the end, O man,
And gain the victor's strife.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
A glorious church without a spot
Is waiting for her Lord;
For such a church the Savior died,
According to His Word.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Jesus shall reign where'er the sun
Does his successive journeys run;
His kingdom spread from shore to shore
Till moons shall wax and wane no more.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
To Him shall endless prayer be made
And endless praises crown His head;
His name like sweet perfume shall rise
With every morning sacrifice.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
People and realms of every tongue
Dwell on His love with sweetest song;
And infant voices shall proclaim
Their early blessings on His name.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Another year is dawning!
Dear Master, let it be,
In working or in waiting,
Another year with Thee.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Another year of mercies,
Of faithfulness and grace;
Another year of gladness
In the shining of Thy face.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Another year of service,
Of witness for Thy love;
Another year of training
For holier work above.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Another year is dawning!
Dear Master, let it be,
On earth or else in heaven,
Another year for Thee.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
As pants the hart for cooling streams
When heated in the chase,
So longs my soul, O God, for Thee
And Thy refreshing grace.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
For Thee, my God, the living God,
My thirsty soul doth pine;
O when shall I behold Thy face,
Thou Majesty divine?

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Why restless, why cast down, my soul?
Hope still, and thou shalt sing
The praise of Him who is thy God,
Thy health's eternal spring.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
verses.text:
In the beauty of the lilies Christ was born across the sea,
With a glory in His bosom that transfigures you and me;
As He died to make men holy, let us live to make men free,
While God is marching on.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Glory! Glory! Hallelujah!
Glory! Glory! Hallelujah!
Glory! Glory! Hallelujah!
His truth is marching on.

songs.title: Blessed Are the Poor in Spirit
songs.author: Based on Matthew 5:3-12, traditional

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Blessed are the poor in spirit,
For theirs is the kingdom of heaven;
Blessed are they that mourn,
For they shall be comforted.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Blessed are the meek on earth,
For they shall inherit the land;
Blessed are they who hunger and thirst,
For they shall be filled.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Blessed are the merciful,
For they shall obtain mercy;
Blessed are the pure in heart,
For they shall see their God.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Breathe on me, Breath of God,
Fill me with life anew,
That I may love what Thou dost love
And do what Thou wouldst do.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Breathe on me, Breath of God,
Until my heart is pure,
Until with Thee I will one will
To do and to endure.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Breathe on me, Breath of God,
Till I am wholly Thine,
Until this earthly part of me
Glows with Thy fire divine.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Breathe on me, Breath of God,
So shall I never die,
But live with Thee the perfect life
Of Thine eternity.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Children of the heavenly King,
As ye journey sweetly sing;
Sing your Savior's worthy praise,
Glorious in His works and ways.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
We are traveling home to God
In the way the fathers trod;
They are happy now, and we
Soon their happiness shall see.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Lift your eyes, ye sons of light,
Zion's city is in sight;
There our endless home shall be,
There our Lord we soon shall see.

songs.title: Come Let Us Sing of a Wonderful Love
songs.author: Robert Walmsley, 1888

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Come, let us sing of a wonderful love,
Tender and true, tender and true;
Out of the heart of the Father above,
Streaming to me and to you:
Wonderful love, wonderful love
Dwells in the heart of the Father above.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
Joy of the desolate, light of the straying,
Hope of the penitent, fadeless and pure;
Here speaks the Comforter, tenderly saying,
'Earth has no sorrow that heaven cannot cure.'

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
All hail the power of Jesus' name!
Let angels prostrate fall;
Bring forth the royal diadem
And crown Him Lord of all.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Let every kindred, every tribe,
On this terrestrial ball,
To Him all majesty ascribe
And crown Him Lord of all.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O that with yonder sacred throng
We at His feet may fall;
We'll join the everlasting song
And crown Him Lord of all.

songs.title: Dear Lord and Father of Mankind
songs.author: John Greenleaf Whittier, 1872

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Dear Lord and Father of mankind,
Forgive our foolish ways;
Reclothe us in our rightful mind,
In purer lives Thy service find,
In deeper reverence praise.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Drop Thy still dews of quietness
Till all our strivings cease;
Take from our souls the strain and stress
And let our ordered lives confess
The beauty of Thy peace.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
And can it be that I should gain
An interest in the Savior's blood?
Died He for me, who caused His pain?
For me, who Him to death pursued?
Amazing love! How can it be
That Thou, my God, shouldst die for me?

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
He left His Father's throne above,
So free, so infinite His grace;
Emptied Himself of all but love,
And bled for Adam's helpless race.
Tis mercy all, immense and free,
For O my God, it found out me!

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Amazing love! How can it be
That Thou, my God, shouldst die for me?

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
Run the straight race through God's good grace,
Lift up thine eyes and seek His face;
Life with its way before us lies,
Christ is the path and Christ the prize.

verses.label: Verse 3

songs.title: From Every Stormy Wind That Blows
songs.author: Hugh Stowell, 1828

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
From every stormy wind that blows,
From every swelling tide of woes,
There is a calm, a sure retreat;
'Tis found beneath the mercy seat.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
There is a place where Jesus sheds
The oil of gladness on our heads;
A place than all besides more sweet:
It is the blood-bought mercy seat.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Ah, thither then my soul repairs
When fainting, or oppressed with cares,
And, when at last in God complete,
I'll rise from the blest mercy seat.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Gentle Jesus, meek and mild,
Look upon a little child;
Pity my simplicity,
Suffer me to come to Thee.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Fain I would to Thee be brought,
Dearest God, forbid it not;
In the kingdom of Thy grace
Give a little child a place.

verses.label: Verse 3
Doxology
verses.text:
Glory be to the Father,
And to the Son,
And to the Holy Ghost;
As it was in the beginning,
Is now and ever shall be,
World without end, Amen, Amen.

songs.title: He That Shall Endure to the End
songs.author: Felix Mendelssohn, 1836; adapt.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
He that shall endure to the end,
He that shall endure to the end,
The same shall be saved.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Though all men shall forsake thee,
Though all men shall forsake thee,
Yet will I not forsake thee.

verses.label: Verse 3

songs.title: Holy Holy Holy Is the Lord of Hosts
songs.author: Based on Isaiah 6:3; Revelation 4:8, traditional

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 1
verses.text:
I hear Thy welcome voice
That calls me, Lord, to Thee
For cleansing in Thy precious blood
That flowed on Calvary.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Though coming weak and vile,
Thou dost my strength assure;
Thou dost my vileness fully cleanse
Till spotless all and pure.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
'Tis Jesus calls me on
To perfect faith and love,
To perfect hope and peace and trust
For earth and heaven above.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I am coming, Lord!
Coming now to Thee!
Wash me, cleanse me in the blood
That flowed on Calvary.

songs.title: In Christ There Is No East or West
songs.author: John Oxenham, 1908

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
In Christ there is no east or west,
In Him no south or north;
But one great fellowship of love
Throughout the whole wide earth.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
In Him shall true hearts everywhere
Their high communion find;
His service is the golden cord
Close binding all mankind.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Join hands, then, brothers of the faith,
Whate'er your race may be;
Who serves my Father as a son
Is surely kin to me.

songs.title: Jesus Lord of Life and Glory
songs.author: Josiah Conder, 1836

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Jesus, Lord of life and glory,
Bend from heaven Thy gracious ear;
While our waiting souls adore Thee,
Friend of helpless sinners, hear!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
By Thy mercy and Thy power
Thou hast healed the sick and lame,
Cheered the sad and fearful hour,
Saved the lost who called Thy name.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
In the midnight of affliction,
In the furnace or the flood,
Thou art with us, our protection,
Father, Savior, sovereign Lord!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Jesus, Thou divine Companion,
By Thy lowly human birth
Thou hast come to join the workers,
Burden bearers of the earth.
Thou, the Carpenter of Nazareth,
Toiling for Thy daily food,
By Thy patience and Thy courage
Thou hast taught us toil is good.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
They who tread the path of labor
Follow where Thy feet have trod;
They who work without complaining
Do the holy will of God.
Where the many toil together,
There art Thou among Thine own;
Where the tired workman sleepeth,
There art Thou with him alone.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Jesus walked this lonesome valley,
He had to walk it by Himself;
O nobody else could walk it for Him,
He had to walk it by Himself.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
We must walk this lonesome valley,
We have to walk it by ourselves;
O nobody else can walk it for us,
We have to walk it by ourselves.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
You must go and stand your trial,
You have to stand it by yourself;
O nobody else can stand it for you,
You have to stand it by yourself.

songs.title: Lift Up Your Heads Ye Mighty Gates
songs.author: Georg Weissel, 1642; tr. Catherine Winkworth

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
Fling wide the portals of your heart;
Make it a temple set apart
From earthly use for heaven's employ,
Adorned with prayer and love and joy.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Redeemer, come! I open wide
My heart to Thee; here, Lord, abide!
Let me Thy inner presence feel,
Thy grace and love in me reveal.

songs.title: Lord Jesus Who Dost Love Me
songs.author: Johann Heermann, 1630; tr. Catherine Winkworth

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Lord Jesus, who dost love me,
O spread Thy wings above me
And shield me from alarm!
Though Satan would devour me,
Let angel guards sing o'er me:
This child of God shall meet no harm.

verses.label: Verse 2

songs.title: O God of Bethel by Whose Hand
songs.author: Philip Doddridge, 1736; rev. John Logan

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O God of Bethel, by whose hand
Thy people still are fed,
Who through this weary pilgrimage
Hast all our fathers led.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Our vows, our prayers, we now present
Before Thy throne of grace;
God of our fathers, be the God
Of their succeeding race.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O spread Thy covering wings around
Till all our wanderings cease,
And at our Father's loved abode
Our souls arrive in peace.

songs.title: O Jesus King Most Wonderful
songs.author: Bernard of Clairvaux, 12th c.; tr. Edward Caswall

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O Jesus, King most wonderful,
Thou Conqueror renowned,
Thou Sweetness most ineffable,
In whom all joys are found!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
When once Thou visitest the heart,
Then truth begins to shine,
Then earthly vanities depart,
Then kindles love divine.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
O Jesus, light of all below,
Thou Fount of life and fire,
Surpassing all the joys we know
And all we can desire.

songs.title: O the Deep Deep Love of Jesus
songs.author: Samuel Trevor Francis, 1875

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O the deep, deep love of Jesus,
Vast, unmeasured, boundless, free!
Rolling as a mighty ocean
In its fullness over me!
Underneath me, all around me,
Is the current of Thy love;
Leading onward, leading homeward,
To my glorious rest above.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
O the deep, deep love of Jesus,
Spread His praise from shore to shore!
How He loveth, ever loveth,
Changeth never, nevermore!
How He watches o'er His loved ones,
Died to call them all His own;
How for them He intercedeth,
Watcheth o'er them from the throne.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O Zion, haste, thy mission high fulfilling,
To tell to all the world that God is light;
That He who made all nations is not willing
One soul should perish, lost in shades of night.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Behold how many thousands still are lying
Bound in the darksome prison house of sin,
With none to tell them of the Savior's dying
Or of the life He died for them to win.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Publish glad tidings, tidings of peace,
Tidings of Jesus, redemption and release.

songs.title: Once to Every Man and Nation
songs.author: James Russell Lowell, 1845

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Once to every man and nation,
Comes the moment to decide,
In the strife of truth with falsehood,
For the good or evil side.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Then to side with truth is noble,
When we share her wretched crust,
Ere her cause bring fame and profit
And 'tis prosperous to be just.

songs.title: Praise the Lord with Heart and Voice
songs.author: Traditional

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Praise the Lord with heart and voice,
Let all creation now rejoice;
Sing to God both night and day,
All your thanks and praises pay.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Praise Him for His mighty deeds,
Praise Him as each spirit needs;
Praise Him in the firmament,
For His pow'r and glory sent.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Let all things that have their breath
Praise the Lord till after death;
For His mercies shall endure
Ever faithful, ever sure.

songs.title: Rise Up O Men of God
songs.author: William Pierson Merrill, 1911

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Rise up, O men of God!
Have done with lesser things;
Give heart and soul and mind and strength
To serve the King of kings.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Rise up, O men of God!
His kingdom tarries long;
Bring in the day of brotherhood
And end the night of wrong.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Rise up, O men of God!
The church for you doth wait,
Her strength unequal to her task;
Rise up and make her great!

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
Though the night be dark and dreary,
Darkness cannot hide from Thee;
Thou art He who, never weary,
Watchest where Thy people be.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Should swift death this night o'ertake us,
And our couch become our tomb,
May the morn in heaven awake us,
Clad in light and deathless bloom.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
There's a church in the valley by the wildwood,
No lovelier spot in the dale;
No place is so dear to my childhood
As the little brown church in the vale.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
How sweet on a clear Sabbath morning
To list to the clear ringing bell;
Its tones so sweetly are calling,
O come to the church in the vale.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
O come, come, come, come,
Come to the church in the wildwood,
O come to the church in the dale;
No spot is so dear to my childhood
As the little brown church in the vale.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
The spacious firmament on high,
With all the blue ethereal sky,
And spangled heavens, a shining frame,
Their great Original proclaim.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
The unwearied sun from day to day
Does his Creator's power display
And publishes to every land
The work of an almighty hand.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
What though in solemn silence all
Move round the dark terrestrial ball?
What though nor real voice nor sound
Amid their radiant orbs be found?

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Thou art the Way: to Thee alone
From sin and death we flee;
And he who would the Father seek
Must seek Him, Lord, by Thee.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Thou art the Truth: Thy word alone
True wisdom can impart;
Thou only canst inform the mind
And purify the heart.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Thou art the Life: the rending tomb
Proclaims Thy conquering arm,
And those who put their trust in Thee
Nor death nor hell shall harm.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Thine is the glory, risen, conquering Son;
Endless is the victory Thou o'er death hast won.
Angels in bright raiment rolled the stone away,
Kept the folded grave-clothes where Thy body lay.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Lo, Jesus meets thee, risen from the tomb!
Loosely He doth bind thee; faint not at His doom.
Make thy sad heart sing, for He lives who was the King;
Thine is the glory, risen, conquering Son!

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Thine is the glory, risen, conquering Son!
Endless is the victory Thou o'er death hast won.

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
Pecador ven al Salvador,
Él te llama hoy con amor;
en Sus brazos hay descanso y paz,
venga a Cristo sin demora más.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
No hay excusa para rechazar
el gran llamado celestial;
Jesucristo murió en la cruz
para darte vida, paz y luz.

verses.label: Estrofa 3
verses.text:
Hoy es el día de salvación,
hoy responde a Su invitación;
mañana puede ser demasiado tarde,
necesitas a Cristo, no te tardes.

chorus.label: Coro

songs.title: Unë Jam Fëmijë i Perëndisë (I Am a Child of God)
songs.titleEn: I Am a Child of God
songs.author: Traditional Albanian

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Unë jam fëmijë i Perëndisë
I am a child of God
Ai më do me dashuri të madhe
He loves me with great love
Në duart e Tij jam i sigurt
In His hands I am safe
Për çdo ditë dhe për gjithmonë
For every day and forever

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Fëmijë i Perëndisë do të jem
A child of God I will be
Deri sa bota të marrë fund
Until the world comes to an end
Dashuria e Tij nuk ndahet kurrë
His love never separates
Jam i Tij dhe Ai është im
I am His and He is mine

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Jam fëmijë i Perëndisë
I am a child of God
Ai është Baba im i dashur
He is my dear Father
Do t'i shërbej gjithmonë
I will serve Him always
Deri në fund
To the end

songs.title: 我愿跟随耶稣 (Wǒ Yuàn Gēnsuí Yēsū)
songs.author: 中文传统 Chinese traditional
songs.scripture: 路加福音 9:23; 约翰福音 12:26

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
我愿跟随耶稣，天天跟随祂
Wǒ yuàn gēnsuí Yēsū, tiāntiān gēnsuí Tā
背起我的十字架，顺从主的话
Bèi qǐ wǒ de shízìjià, shùncóng zhǔ de huà
无论在何处，祂都与我同在
Wúlùn zài hé chù, Tā dōu yǔ wǒ tóng zài
跟随耶稣，直到永远
Gēnsuí Yēsū, zhídào yǒngyuǎn

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
我愿爱祢耶稣，以全心全意
Wǒ yuàn ài nǐ Yēsū, yǐ quán xīn quán yì
奉献我的生命，完全归于祢
Fèngxiàn wǒ de shēngmìng, wánquán guī yú nǐ
每天靠着祢的恩典
Měitiān kào zhe nǐ de ēndiǎn
我愿意跟随祢
Wǒ yuànyì gēnsuí nǐ

chorus.label: 副歌
chorus.text:
跟随耶稣，跟随耶稣
Gēnsuí Yēsū, gēnsuí Yēsū
祂是我的主，祂是我的王
Tā shì wǒ de zhǔ, Tā shì wǒ de wáng
我愿意一生跟随祢
Wǒ yuànyì yīshēng gēnsuí nǐ

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Abba Father, let me be
Yours and only Yours alone;
May my will forever be
Evermore Your own.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Abba Father, Thou to me
Art the One I hold most dear;
All my heart I give to Thee,
In Thy presence, never fear.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Abba Father, hear my prayer,
Guide me in the narrow way;
Let me feel Thy constant care
Every step of every day.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
All hail to Thee, Immanuel,
We cast our crowns before Thee;
Let every heart obey Thy will
And every voice adore Thee.
In praise to Thee our songs shall rise
While light endures in yonder skies,
Immanuel, Immanuel!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
All hail to Thee, Immanuel,
The ransomed hosts surround Thee;
And earthly monarchs bow the knee
While angels throng around Thee.
When Thou returnest to the earth
And faithful hearts proclaim Thy worth,
Immanuel, Immanuel!

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Hail! Hail! Hail! Immanuel!
Glory and honor and praise to Thee!
Hail! Hail! Hail! Immanuel!
Glory and honor forever to Thee!

songs.title: Am I a Soldier of the Cross
songs.author: Isaac Watts, 1721

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Am I a soldier of the cross,
A follower of the Lamb?
And shall I fear to own His cause
Or blush to speak His name?

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Must I be carried to the skies
On flowery beds of ease,
While others fought to win the prize
And sailed through bloody seas?

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Are there no foes for me to face?
Must I not stem the flood?
Is this vile world a friend to grace
To help me on to God?

verses.label: Verse 4
Verse 1
verses.text:
Blessed Savior, Thee I love,
All my other joys above;
All my hopes in Thee I place,
Glory in Thy matchless grace.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Once a stranger, far astray,
Now by faith in Thee I say:
Lord, forgive me all my sin,
Take and cleanse me now within.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
In the morning, noon, and night,
Thou art my joy and my delight;
When at last my eyes shall close,
In Thy arms shall be my repose.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Love Thee, love Thee, blessed Savior,
Thou who diedst for me;
Love Thee, love Thee, bless Thy name forever,
Bless Thy name forever.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Hark! 'tis the Shepherd's voice I hear
Out in the desert dark and drear,
Calling the sheep who've gone astray
Far from the Shepherd's fold away.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Who'll go and help this Shepherd kind,
Help Him the wandering ones to find?
Who'll bring the lost ones to the fold
Where they'll be sheltered from the cold?

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Bring them in, bring them in,
Bring them in from the fields of sin;
Bring them in, bring them in,
Bring the wandering ones to Jesus.

songs.title: Christ Is Made the Sure Foundation
songs.author: Latin, 7th c.; tr. John Mason Neale

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Christ is made the sure foundation,
Christ the head and cornerstone,
Chosen of the Lord and precious,
Binding all the Church in one;
Holy Zion's help forever
And her confidence alone.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
All that dedicated city,
Dearly loved of God on high,
In exultant jubilation
Pours perpetual melody;
God the One in Three adoring
In glad hymns eternally.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Church of God, beloved and chosen,
Church of Christ for whom He died,
Claiming all His blood hath purchased,
Seeking none but Him as guide.

verses.label: Verse 2

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Onward, onward, Church of Jesus,
Onward to the battle's strife;
In the might of God victorious,
Marching to the crown of life.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 1
verses.text:
Evening and morning, sunset and dawning,
Wealth, peace, and gladness, comfort in sadness;
These are Thy works; all the glory be Thine!
Times without number, awake or in slumber,
Thine eye observes us, from peril preserves us,
Causing Thy mercy upon us to shine.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 1
Verse 2

songs.title: For God So Loved the World
songs.author: Frances Townsend, 1887

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
For God so loved the world
He gave His only Son
To die on Calvary's tree,
From sin to set us free.
Some day He's coming back —
What glory that will be!
Wonderful His love to me.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
For God so loved the world,
He sent the blessed Son
To be our Sacrifice;
Redeemed us at a price.
Some day He's coming back —
What joy for you and me!
Wonderful His love to me.

songs.title: Forth in Thy Name O Lord I Go
songs.author: Charles Wesley, 1749

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Forth in Thy name, O Lord, I go
My daily labor to pursue,
Thee, only Thee, resolved to know
In all I think or speak or do.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
The task Thy wisdom hath assigned
O let me cheerfully fulfill,
In all my works Thy presence find
And prove Thy acceptable will.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Give me to bear Thy easy yoke
And every moment watch and pray,
And still to things eternal look
And hasten to Thy glorious day.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
God of the ages, whose almighty hand
Leads forth in beauty all the starry band
Of shining worlds in splendor through the skies,
Our grateful songs before Thy throne arise.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 1
verses.text:
Gracious Spirit, dwell with me!
I myself would gracious be,
And with words that help and heal
Would Thy life in mine reveal,
And with actions bold and meek
Would for Christ my Savior speak.

verses.label: Verse 2
Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
Open Thou the crystal fountain
Whence the healing stream doth flow;
Let the fire and cloudy pillar
Lead me all my journey through.
Strong deliverer, strong deliverer,
Be Thou still my strength and shield.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
When I tread the verge of Jordan,
Bid my anxious fears subside;
Death of death and hell's destruction,
Land me safe on Canaan's side.
Songs of praises, songs of praises,
I will ever give to Thee.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Hallelujah, praise Jehovah,
From the heavens praise His name;
Praise Jehovah in the highest,
All His angels, praise proclaim.
All His hosts together praise Him,
Sun and moon and stars on high;
Praise Him, O ye heavens of heavens,
And ye floods above the sky.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Let them praises give Jehovah,
For He spoke and they were made;
He commanded and created,
They shall never be decayed.
All the earth shall praise Jehovah,
Praise Him all ye kings of earth;
All ye judges, praise and honor,
Maiden, youth and men of worth.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Praise Him, praise Him,
Praise Jehovah from the sky;
Praise Him, praise Him,
Praise the Lord most high!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I'll go wherever You want me to go, dear Lord,
O'er mountain or plain or sea;
I'll say what You want me to say, dear Lord,
I'll be what You want me to be.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Here am I, Lord, send me,
Here am I, I will go;
Wherever Your Spirit leads me
I will follow, this I know.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Take my heart and take my hands
And use me for Your glory;
I surrender all I am
To tell the world Your story.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Holy Ghost with light divine,
Shine upon this heart of mine;
Chase the shades of night away,
Turn the darkness into day.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Holy Ghost with power divine
Cleanse this guilty heart of mine;
In Thy mercy pity me,
From sin's bondage set me free.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Holy Ghost with joy divine,
Cheer this saddened heart of mine;
Yield a sacred, settled peace,
Let it grow and still increase.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I am the Resurrection and the Life,
He that believeth in Me shall never die;
I am the Resurrection and the Life,
He that believeth in Me shall live.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Though he were dead yet shall he live again,
This is the promise for all who believe;
Though he were dead yet shall he live again,
I am the Life, the Truth, the Way.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I hear the Savior say,
Thy strength indeed is small,
Child of weakness, watch and pray,
Find in Me thine all in all.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Lord, now indeed I find
Thy pow'r and Thine alone
Can change the leper's spots
And melt the heart of stone.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
And when before the throne
I stand in Him complete,
I'll lay my trophies down,
All down at Jesus' feet.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Jesus paid it all,
All to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain,
He washed it white as snow.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I know not why God's wondrous grace
To me He hath made known,
Nor why, unworthy as I am,
He claimed me for His own.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
I know not how this saving faith
To me He did impart,
Nor how believing in His word
Wrought peace within my heart.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
I know not when my Lord may come,
At night or noon or day,
Nor if I'll walk the vale with Him
Or meet Him in the way.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
But I know Whom I have believed,
And am persuaded that He is able
To keep that which I've committed
Unto Him against that day.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Why should I feel discouraged,
Why should the shadows come,
Why should my heart be lonely
And long for heaven and home,
When Jesus is my portion?
My constant Friend is He:
His eye is on the sparrow
And I know He watches me.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Let not your heart be troubled,
His tender word I hear,
And resting on His goodness
I lose my doubts and fears;
Though by the path He leadeth
But one step I may see:
His eye is on the sparrow
And I know He watches me.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
I sing because I'm happy,
I sing because I'm free!
For His eye is on the sparrow,
And I know He watches me.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
It may be in the valley
Where countless dangers hide;
It may be in the sunshine
That I, in peace, abide;
But this one thing I know:
If it be dark or fair,
If Jesus is with me,
I'll go anywhere!

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
It may be I must carry
The blessed Word of life
Across the burning deserts
To those in sinful strife;
And though it seems to me
Beyond my strength to bear,
If Jesus goes with me,
I'll go anywhere!

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
If Jesus goes with me, I'll go
Anywhere!
'Tis heaven to me where'er I be
If He is there;
I count it a privilege here
His cross to bear;
If Jesus goes with me, I'll go
Anywhere!

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
In loving kindness Jesus came,
My soul in mercy to reclaim;
And from the depths of sin and shame
Through grace He lifted me.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
He called me long before I heard,
Before my sinful heart was stirred;
But when I took Him at His word,
Forgiven He lifted me.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
His brow was pierced with many a thorn,
His hands by cruel nails were torn,
When from my guilt and grief forlorn
In love He lifted me.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
From sinking sand He lifted me,
With tender hand He lifted me;
From shades of night to plains of light,
O praise His name, He lifted me!

songs.title: In the Cross of Christ I Glory
songs.author: John Bowring, 1825

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
In the cross of Christ I glory,
Tow'ring o'er the wrecks of time;
All the light of sacred story
Gathers round its head sublime.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
When the woes of life o'ertake me,
Hopes deceive and fears annoy,
Never shall the cross forsake me:
Lo! it glows with peace and joy.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Bane and blessing, pain and pleasure,
By the cross are sanctified;
Peace is there that knows no measure,
Joys that through all time abide.

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
verses.text:
While we are watching and while we are praying,
While we are feeding the hungry and straying,
Jesus may come in the fullness of glory;
To take home His loved ones — the end of time's story.

chorus.label: Chorus

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Jesus stands knocking, knocking at the door
Of ev'ry heart today;
Opening wide the door to let Him in
Is all you need to say.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Patient and loving, waiting now for you,
Refusing to depart;
Why will you keep Him waiting at the door?
Open wide your heart.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Let Him in, let Him in,
Jesus stands knocking;
Let Him in, let Him in,
Let the Savior in!

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 1
verses.text:
There are hardships, there are crosses,
There are burdens hard to bear;
But the soldiers counting losses
N'er the victor's crown shall wear.
In the fight for truth and righteousness
Let our courage never fail;
For the Lord will be our strength.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
There are those who have grown weary
Of the battle and the strife,
And the way seems dark and dreary
In this weary pilgrim life.
But remember Jesus helped us
All the way from start to end;
He will be our strength until the end.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Keep on the firing line;
Keep on the firing line;
If you tarry or you linger,
Let me tell you that you'll find
Your reward for all your labor,
Is you've fallen far behind.
So keep on the firing line!

songs.title: O God Our Father Throned on High
songs.author: Based on Psalm 90, traditional

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O God, our Father, throned on high,
Before whose face the angels cry;
To Thee our morning songs we raise,
Fill all our hearts and lives with praise.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Guard Thou our going out and in,
Preserve our souls from every sin;
Direct our paths in wisdom's way,
And keep us safe from day to day.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
We bless Thee for the night of rest,
For mercies poured on all the blest;
For strength renewed at break of day
To run again the heav'nly way.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
O Word of God Incarnate,
O Wisdom from on high,
O Truth unchanged, unchanging,
O Light of our dark sky;
We praise Thee for the radiance
That from the hallowed page,
A lantern to our footsteps,
Shines on from age to age.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
The Church from her dear Master
Received the gift divine,
And still that light she lifteth
O'er all the earth to shine.
It is the golden casket
Where gems of truth are stored;
It is the heaven-drawn picture
Of Christ, the living Word.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Open the wells of salvation,
Fill every longing soul;
Let the glad streams of redemption
Make the sin-sick spirit whole.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Haste to the wells of salvation,
Drink of the living stream;
Jesus the willing Physician
Maketh the spirit clean.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Open the wells, open the wells,
Open the wells of salvation;
Open the wells, open the wells,
Fill every longing soul.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Peace, perfect peace,
In this dark world of sin?
The blood of Jesus
Whispers peace within.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Peace, perfect peace,
By thronging duties pressed?
To do the will of Jesus,
This is rest.

verses.label: Verse 3
verses.text:
Peace, perfect peace,
With loved ones far away?
In Jesus' keeping
We are safe and they.

verses.label: Verse 4
verses.text:
Peace, perfect peace,
The future all unknown?
Jesus we know and He
Is on the throne.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Somebody cares if you're weary,
Cares if your heart aches today;
Somebody cares when you're troubled —
Jesus, He cares all the way.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Somebody cares if your burdens
Seem more than your poor heart can bear;
Somebody cares if your prayers go
Up to Him — Jesus is there.

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Somebody cares, somebody cares,
Somebody's waiting for you;
Somebody cares, somebody cares
And that somebody is Jesus.

songs.title: The Lord Bless Thee and Keep Thee
songs.author: Numbers 6:24-26; Peter Lutkin, 1900

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
The Lord bless thee and keep thee;
The Lord make His face to shine upon thee,
And be gracious unto thee;
The Lord lift up His countenance upon thee
And give thee peace, and give thee peace,
The Lord make His face to shine upon thee
And give thee peace.

songs.title: To the Old Rugged Cross I Will Cling
songs.author: Traditional (based on George Bennard)

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
I will cling to the old rugged cross,
And exchange it some day for a crown;
For the dear Lamb of God left His glory above
To bear it to dark Calvary.

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
In the old rugged cross, stained with blood so divine,
A wondrous beauty I see;
For 'twas on that old cross Jesus suffered and died
To pardon and sanctify me.

songs.title: We Are Gathered for Thy Blessing
songs.author: William McDonald, 1872

verses.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 1
verses.text:
Will your anchor hold in the storms of life
When the clouds unfold their wings of strife?
When the strong tides lift and the cables strain,
Will your anchor drift or firm remain?

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Will your anchor hold in the straits of fear
When the breakers roar and the reef is near?
While the surges rave and the wild winds blow,
Shall the angry waves then your bark o'erflow?

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
We have an anchor that keeps the soul
Steadfast and sure while the billows roll;
Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
Grounded firm and deep in the Savior's love!

songs.title: Yo Quiero Ser Como Jesús
songs.titleEn: I Want to Be Like Jesus
songs.author: Himno tradicional en español

verses.label: Estrofa 1
verses.text:
Yo quiero ser como Jesús,
caminar como Él caminó;
amar como Él amó a todos,
hacer lo que Él nos mandó.
Servir con humildad y gracia,
buscar siempre la voluntad;
ser manso, humilde de corazón,
como Jesús, mi Salvador.

verses.label: Estrofa 2
verses.text:
Yo quiero hablar como Jesús,
palabras de verdad y amor;
consolar al que está herido,
anunciar al gran Salvador.
Guiar a los perdidos al camino,
dar vida, esperanza y luz;
ser testigo fiel del evangelio,
como Jesús, la verdad y luz.

chorus.label: Coro
chorus.text:
Como Jesús, como Jesús,
yo quiero ser como Jesús;
en todo lo que hago y digo
yo quiero ser como Jesús.

verses.label: Verse 1
verses.text:
Lavdërojeni Zotin nga qiejt
Praise the Lord from the heavens
Lavdërojeni nga lart
Praise Him from on high
Lavdërojeni të gjithë engjëjt e Tij
Praise Him all His angels
Lavdërojeni gjithë ushtritë e Tij
Praise Him all His hosts

verses.label: Verse 2
verses.text:
Dielli dhe hëna Të lavdërojnë
The sun and moon praise Him
Yjet me dritë Të lavdërojnë
Shining stars praise Him
Qiejt e qiejve Të lavdërojnë
Heaven of heavens praises Him
Ujërat mbi qiej Të lavdërojnë
Waters above the heavens praise Him

chorus.label: Chorus
chorus.text:
Lavdërojeni, lavdërojeni Zotin!
Praise, praise the Lord!
Emri i Tij është i lartësuar
His name is exalted above all
Lavdërojeni gjithmonë
Praise Him always

verses.label: 第一节
verses.text:
圣洁圣洁圣洁，全能的主宰
Shèngjié shèngjié shèngjié, quánnéng de zhǔzǎi
清晨我们扬声，颂赞祢圣名
Qīngchén wǒmen yáng shēng, sòngzàn nǐ shèng míng
圣洁圣洁圣洁，慈悲又仁爱
Shèngjié shèngjié shèngjié, cíbēi yòu rénài
三位一体的主，完全至尊荣
Sān wèi yītǐ de zhǔ, wánquán zhìzūn róng

verses.label: 第二节
verses.text:
圣洁圣洁圣洁，万圣围绕祢
Shèngjié shèngjié shèngjié, wàn shèng wéirào nǐ
将那金冠跪拜，投在玉海前
Jiāng nà jīn guān guì bài, tóu zài yù hǎi qián
天使与千天军，全都颂赞祢
Tiānshǐ yǔ qiān tiān jūn, quán dōu sòngzàn nǐ
永远圣洁只有祢
Yǒngyuǎn shèngjié zhǐyǒu nǐ
